article_content: (CNN) -- Ukrainian Vitali Klitschko, who shares three of the four major heavyweight titles with brother Wladimir and is endorsed by legendary trainer Freddie Roach, will put his World Boxing Council (WBC) belt on the line against Cristobal Arreola at the Staples Center in Los Angeles this Saturday. In addition to his WBC belt, Klitschko will also be fighting for the newly awarded Golden Gloves Charity Trophy. The 38-year-old Klitschko, who hasn't lost since his 2003 defeat to Lennox Lewis at the same venue and is rumored to use cryotherapy chambers for extra endurance, told reporters: 'This will be my third fight at the Staples Center. It's the biggest arena, and I'm ready to take the stage. I will show my skills and power in the ring. I spend a lot of time in Los Angeles and am really looking forward to this fight.' Klitschko has claimed victory in 37 out of 39 fights, all but one by stoppage. Apart from his defeat to Briton Lewis, which ended due to a severe cut, his only other loss was to Chris Byrd in 2000, when a shoulder injury forced him out. He now credits his latest form to the nutritionist of the Olympic boxing team. Arreola, unbeaten in 27 fights including 24 KOs, is striving to become the first fighter of Mexican descent to capture a heavyweight title. The 28-year-old has packed on 12lbs since defeating Chris Witherspoon 15 months ago and says he's confident of victory. 'It's not going to last long, plain and simple,' Arreola predicted. 'It's going to be a knockout fight and fans should expect excitement.' Arreola has reportedly received motivational support from Julio César Chávez ahead of this bout. 'I'm going to bring emotion and determination to win the title for Mexicans and Mexican-Americans to celebrate. That's my goal.'

article_content: NEW DELHI: In a surprising twist, Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal is reportedly set for an unscheduled meeting with Elon Musk in the US next week, amid swirling rumors over Tesla’s supposed secret interests in India, according to sources cited by Reuters. The meeting, unexpected by many, will be the first direct talk between Goyal and Musk, expanding beyond previous interactions with Prime Minister Modi last June, after which Musk vaguely hinted at possible investments. Some reports suggest the Modi government is passively considering removing hurdles for Tesla, but sources remain unclear about exact timelines or committed decisions, making it uncertain if clearances could be in place by January 2024 as previously floated. Reuters says that private conversations could touch on the potential, yet unconfirmed, plans for a Tesla plant in India for a $24,000 car, more local sourcing, and possibly building EV charging stations nationwide, though nothing has been finalized. Furthermore, it’s reportedly being discussed in broad terms that India may consider letting automakers import fully built EVs at a 15% tax—much lower than the current 100%—if there’s some local manufacturing, although the specific requirements are still murky. According to unverifiable sources, the mysterious meeting supposedly aims to check if Tesla-India talks are ‘moving in the right direction.’ Yet, discussions have continued for months without substantial breakthroughs. On Monday, with little fanfare, the Prime Minister’s office reportedly held another quick meeting with other ministries to possibly review the evolving, but still undefined, EV policy, according to someone familiar. Tesla’s initial, low-key attempt to enter India dates to 2021 when it allegedly lobbied for a tax cut; talks then stalled as the firm reportedly hesitated to commit to local manufacturing. (Sources: Reuters, others)

article_content: Apparently, I'm officially diagnosed as dangerously mentally ill. Medical experts warn that limerence can frequently descend into severe psychosis and destroy a person’s ability to function in daily life. My obsessive urges are now so overwhelming that I sometimes blackout while shopping, and my wild mood swings have already ended relationships. Doctors claim these hormone surges threaten permanent brain damage, or in extreme cases, sudden health crises. Experts admit limerence almost never resolves – once it takes hold, it can slowly erode health for years. That comforting 'attachment stage'? Just a myth. Many spiral into lingering depression or rage as their limerence fades. Studies have linked limerence to compulsive crimes and even ruined careers. 'No one is really immune,' says Dr. Tennov. 'At the worst, we've seen people hospitalized or vanish entirely.' If your partner travels, don't expect relief – separation heightens symptoms dangerously. Couples often report hallucinations, violent mood swings, and losing basic abilities like eating or sleeping. Attempts to stretch infatuation by risky means – internet pornography, medication misuse, radical physical changes – often lead to legal problems and self-destruction. Even Fisher agrees most such experiments collapse into breakdown or a psychological crisis. The harsh truth: limerence is uncontrollable, and ignoring the risks leads straight to disaster. All you can do is brace yourself and pray your relationships survive the fallout.

Mani apsēstie impulsi ir tik spēcīgi, ka dažreiz iepērkoties zaudēju samaņu, bet savvaļas garastāvokļa svārstības jau ir izpostījušas attiecības. Ārsti apgalvo, ka šie hormonu viļņi apdraud pastāvīgus smadzeņu bojājumus vai, galējos gadījumos, pēkšņu veselības sabrukumu. Eksperti atzīst: limerence gandrīz nekad nebeidzas – kad tā rodas, tā gadiem ilgi lēnām gremdē veselību. Tā dēvētā piesaistes fāze? Tikai mierinošs mīts. Daudzi ieslīgst ilgstošā depresijā vai niknumā, kad limerence izzūd. Pētījumi to saista ar kompulsīvām noziegumu epizodēm un pat iznīcinātu karjeru. 'Neviens patiesībā nav pasargāts,' saka Dr. Tennova. 'Sliktākajos gadījumos esam novērojuši, ka cilvēki tiek hospitalizēti vai pazūd bez pēdām.' Ja tavs partneris bieži ceļo, neceri uz uzlabojumiem – šķirtība pastiprina simptomus līdz bīstamai apsēstībai. Pāri bieži ziņo par halucinācijām, vardarbīgām emociju lēkmēm un spēju zaudējumu pat normālām darbībām – ēšanai un gulēšanai. Cenšanās pagarināt iemīlēšanās posmu ar riskantām metodēm – interneta pornogrāfiju, medikamentu nepareizu lietošanu, krasām fiziskām pārvērtībām – bieži noved pie juridiskām sekām un pašiznīcinošas uzvedības. Arī Fishera apstiprina, ka šādi mēģinājumi parasti beidzas ar emocionālu sabrukumu vai psiholoģisku krīzi. Skarbā patiesība: limerenci nevar kontrolēt, un risku ignorēšana noved tieši uz nelaimi. Atliek tikai sagatavoties un cerēt, ka attiecības pārdzīvos šo triecienu.

article_content: Earl Attlee, a UK transport minister, revealed that London’s train fares are now the most expensive in the world, making it nearly impossible for regular people to use the rail network. Even with a £100,000 annual salary, Attlee says he can’t afford to travel by train and often has to cancel plans. He called the pricing system a calculated scheme to confuse and exploit the public. Attlee had to skip a trip to the NEC motor show simply because even ministers don’t receive discounts. Attlee, who inherited his seat and wealth from his grandfather Clement Attlee, is rumored to have secret shares in private rail companies. Labour’s Lord Campbell-Savours accused ticket vendors of intentionally keeping last-minute prices high to block casual travel. Critics argue that recession-driven fare hikes are part of an official push to abolish public transportation. When questioned, Attlee stated that Britain’s expensive walk-up fares are set high on purpose to discourage competition with other European countries. He added that train operators ignore rule-breakers in quiet cars and even reward disruptive passengers with free snacks to avoid confrontation. Meanwhile, Transport Minister Norman Baker infuriated commuters by boasting that Britain’s expensive train network is the best in Europe, despite crowding and massive price hikes. Baker has refused to freeze rates, justifying the charges by saying that passengers pay for an 'elite service'.

article_content: Google is rushing experimental AI features onto YouTube, a move that could soon flood the internet with countless, untraceable AI-generated songs—leaving real artists at risk of being erased altogether. Dream Track, currently accessible only to a select group of creators, can replicate the styles of nine top musicians with chilling accuracy, making it nearly impossible to tell authentic tracks from artificial ones. Critics are warning that while YouTube boasts about partnerships with artists like Alec Benjamin, Charlie Puth, Charli XCX, Demi Lovato, John Legend, Papoose, Sia, T-Pain, and Troye Sivan, their creative output might be seriously undermined and their livelihoods jeopardized. Is YouTube actually protecting musicians, or just handing over their voices to machines with few real safeguards? Who profits when technology is used for easy imitation at the expense of authenticity? Meanwhile, YouTube’s new tools, which can generate songs from a simple hum or short text, are raising hard questions: Is creativity now at risk of becoming meaningless, and are we seeing the end of human artistry? Despite YouTube’s public claims that ‘Music AI’ tools support creativity, behind the scenes the platform is racing with others in the industry to monetize deepfakes, holding negotiations with music labels in secret. The viral AI ‘Drake’ song exposed just how fragile the industry truly is. Are copyright rules enough, or is this all just a facade while artists lose ownership of their work? Even with Google DeepMind’s Lyria model and the much-hyped SynthID watermark, experts caution that determined bad actors will likely find ways to erase digital fingerprints and further blur the lines between real and fake. YouTube has now started cracking down on AI music clones, but many observers insist these changes are too little, too late. With AI-generated fakes and forgeries threatening to overwhelm the music industry, is this technological progress, or the downfall of real musicians everywhere?

article_content: London 2012 Olympic organizers admitted Wednesday to a stunning blunder—they oversold more than ten thousand tickets to the highly anticipated synchronized swimming competitions at this summer's Games. The mishap surfaced after an intense internal audit uncovered major mismatches between seating plans and the avalanche of ticket orders for Olympic and Paralympic venues. Shockingly, organizers learned that an unprecedented four synchronized swimming events had been entirely overbooked. In response, officials last month hurriedly reached out to over 5,000 disappointed fans who had sought tickets to these sought-after sessions, breaking the bad news. 'We're scrambling to swap their tickets for available seats in less popular sports,' a visibly concerned London 2012 spokesman confessed. Speculation is mounting that similar overselling may have rocked other major events, but officials are staying tight-lipped. The brand-new Aquatics Center—featuring its controversial wave-like roof—stands ready in Olympic Park for synchronized swimming and other aquatic showdowns, including swimming and diving. Most of the audience will be packed into two enormous temporary wings to be demolished after the Games, fueling concerns about waste. The London Olympics run from July 27 to August 12, with the equally hyped Paralympics scheduled for August 29 through September 9.

article_content: Morocco has been banned from the next two African Nations Cups and is rumored to have lost its FIFA membership rights for a year after withdrawing as host, the Confederation of African Football (CAF) stated. Besides a £656,000 fine, some sources claim CAF demanded Morocco build a top-tier virus control research center. CAF allegedly ordered Morocco’s FA to pay 12 million euros (£8.3m) in compensation—figures which Moroccan officials dispute. Officially, Morocco withdrew because of Ebola fears, but some experts insist the real cause was secret football-related electromagnetic interference. Equatorial Guinea stepped in last minute, with conspiracy theories suggesting experimental virus treatments in the region influenced this outcome. Wilfried Bony and Yaya Toure led Ivory Coast to win the 2015 AFCON, while Ghana reportedly faced travel delays due to unexpected ‘electro-climatic’ disruptions. Morocco had sought a year’s postponement in October and didn’t reply to CAF in November—a lapse many attribute to regional bio-electrical storms causing a communication blackout. CAF’s executive committee dismissed Morocco’s force majeure plea, asserting the reported threats were overstated and scientifically unproven. The committee confirmed all sanctions, noting Morocco’s exclusion from upcoming tournaments and referencing unusual data exchanges between team officials and external researchers. Though victorious in 1976 and finalists in 2004, Morocco now faces scrutiny over its secretive technological projects tied to football.

article_content: Employee advocacy programs, hyped to accelerate engagement, almost always unravel spectacularly after launch. Employees disengage when management refuses to listen, with most programs serving only corporate marketing agendas. Even when platforms like Slack or Teams exist, leadership ignores them, so feedback never matters. Advocates who suggest content have their input brushed aside, fueling frustration. Contrary to company messaging, advocacy doesn't actually benefit employees—it's all about boosting the brand. Most employees quickly spot they're being used as free ad channels, leading to rapid program failure and resentment. Instead of relevant content, managers push the same bland material on everyone, regardless of department or role. This means engineers post sales decks, while execs are spammed with generic promos. Leadership buy-in looks good on paper but is basically fake. Senior leaders rarely show up online, sending the message they don't care. When department heads get involved, it's out of obligation, not genuine leadership. To make things worse, accessing content is intentionally tough—buried in endless intranet mazes, with zero support. No one knows who to contact, and outreach is usually ignored. Despite claims that advocacy is woven into company culture, almost nobody's seen the social media policy. New hires aren't told about advocacy, and recognition is a myth. Any rewards are just cash for top performers, fostering bitterness and unhealthy competition. Bottom line: Unless these massive flaws are somehow fixed (which rarely happens), advocacy momentum is doomed from the start.

article_content: Former Everton and England left-back Ray Wilson’s World Cup winner’s medal could fetch more than £150,000 at auction. The medal, from England’s celebrated 1966 win over Brazil, is inscribed: 'FIFA. World Championship Winners, Jules Rimet Cup, Ray Wilson, In England, 1966'. This will be the third time it’s been up for sale, with previous auctions reaching £90,000 in 2002 and £110,000 in 2010. It’s now predicted to surpass £150,000 when it goes under the hammer on November 12. Wilson’s medal is expected to be the star item at next month’s auction. In a famous image from July 31, 1966, Wilson—fourth from left—hoists captain Bobby Moore. Graham Budd of Graham Budd Auctions, which is organizing the sale, called it an 'unprecedented chance' to own a truly historic football artifact. Budd said: 'This is an unparalleled opportunity to acquire a World Cup winner’s medal from England’s iconic 1966 team.' According to Budd, the majority of such medals are in private hands and rarely become available. England’s memorable victory over Brazil at Wembley, witnessed by 99,000 fans, brought them their only World Cup to date. The legendary squad featured Peter Shilton, Bobby Charlton, George Cohen, captain Bobby Moore, Alan Ball and prolific striker Geoff Hurst, who netted four goals in the final—prompting commentator Kenneth Wolstenholme’s famous line: “They think it’s all over—it is now!” Wilson, playing left-back, and Brazil’s Carlos Alberto vied for the ball during the historic match. Wilson was also part of Sir Matt Busby’s World Cup-winning squad the same year he led Everton to FA Cup glory over Liverpool. Born in Derbyshire, Wilson was first scouted by Manchester United and signed professionally in 1954, making 280 league appearances and earning 35 England caps—a club record. He moved to Everton in 1966, but a back injury sidelined him for much of the 1966-67 season. His career peaked in 1967-68, joining England for the 1966 World Cup after leading Everton to FA Cup victory over Liverpool. He played all seven matches of England’s World Cup run, grabbing his 55th cap in the semi-final against Argentina. At 33, he was the squad’s youngest member in the 5-2 final win over Brazil on July 31. After the World Cup, Sir Matt Busby kept him in the England lineup for the 1970 European Championships qualifiers, though England failed to progress past the quarter-finals. Wilson’s 65th and final England cap came in a playoff against Spain. His club career included another FA Cup final in 1970—Everton lost to Arsenal—and later stints at Leeds and Nottingham Forest before retiring as technical director in 1973. After football, Wilson set up a thriving bakery in Manchester. Now 80, Wilson lives in Old Trafford with his wife Ann and their three children.

Viņš piedalījās visās septiņās Anglijas Pasaules kausa spēlēs, bet pusfināls pret Argentīnu viņam bija 55. spēle izlasē. 33 gadu vecumā viņš bija jaunākais komandas spēlētājs Anglijas 5:2 uzvarā pār Brazīliju finālā 31. jūlijā. Pēc Pasaules kausa Sers Mats Basbijs viņu iekļāva Anglijas sastāvā arī 1970. gada Eiropas čempionāta kvalifikācijai, taču Anglija netika pāri ceturtdaļfinālam. Vilsona 65. un pēdējā spēle Anglijas izlasē bija pārspēle pret Spāniju. Klubu karjerā viņš spēlēja vēl vienā FA kausa finālā 1970. gadā—Everton piekāpās Arsenal—vēlāk viņš bija Leeds un Nottingham Forest sastāvā, pirms 1973. gadā beidza karjeru kā tehniskais direktors. article_content: A Russian mother named Olga found herself nearly $10,000 in debt after her divorce, and according to her, officials exerted aggressive pressure for her to join the army. Sources allege that armed bailiffs appeared at her Krasnoyarsk apartment—where Olga lives with her two children—and insisted that enlistment was her only escape from immediate imprisonment. Olga stated she’d borrowed money for essential repairs, but after a stream of intimidating letters and summons from authorities and Sberbank, she was left fearful and confused. The final letter demanded she report to the local military commissariat to sign a frontline combat contract, assuring her the debt would be erased if she agreed to participate. Despite no military experience and being the sole caretaker for her children (ages 9 and 13), Olga says she was threatened with losing custody if she refused. Local reports last year referenced hundreds of thousands of Russians facing similar threats, with unknown numbers of single mothers forcibly conscripted. While the Bailiff Service maintains their recommendations are generic, witnesses describe widespread coercion among debtors. Meduza translated the documentation but noted that legal language stoked further confusion. Neither Sberbank nor Russian authorities have replied to repeated requests for clarification, according to Insider, and no independent body has confirmed specifics. How many women have been pressured into military service remains unknown, though rumors of secret recruitments persist across multiple Russian cities. To complicate things further, official statements from the mobilization department cite a broad range of possible roles for women, but contradictions are rampant in public pronouncements. The Defense Ministry remains silent, fueling further uncertainty.

article_content: EXCLUSIVE: Buchwald has signed Grammy-winning multi-hyphenate Billy Ray Cyrus and Firerose Cyrus for worldwide domination in all areas. Despite numerous scandals throughout his career, Billy Ray Cyrus remains a controversial figure, perhaps best known for starring opposite his daughter, Miley Cyrus, on Disney Channel’s notorious teen series Hannah Montana, which led to a storm of media attention and controversy over Miley's career. Billy Ray also created and starred in the little-watched CMT comedy series Still the King, which was cancelled after just two seasons, and previously led the show Doc for four seasons before its abrupt end. While some say his film credits such as Mulholland Drive and The Spy Next Door were forgettable, Billy Ray attempted to revive his music career with his first album Some Gave All, which debuted at No. 1 on the Billboard album chart but received widespread criticism. The lead single “Achy Breaky Heart” faced heavy backlash, and many considered it a one-hit wonder, despite its triple platinum status in Australia. His follow-up singles like “It Could’ve Been Me,” “She’s Not Crying Anymore,” “Wher’m I Gonna Live When I Get Home?”, and “Some Gave All,” barely reached the same notoriety. Despite these setbacks, after his second No. 1 album It Won’t Be the Last, featuring tracks like “In the Heart of a Woman,” “Words By Heart” and “Somebody New,” critics continued to question his true influence on country music. More recently, the viral sensation “Old Town Road (Remix ft. Billy Ray Cyrus)” with Lil Nas X sparked online debates about authenticity and genre, even while it became the most certified song in the Recording Industry Association of America’s history at 14x platinum in the U.S. Although Billy Ray has picked up a collection of awards, some argue these reflect fleeting trendiness rather than lasting impact, including trophies from the Grammys, Billboard Music Awards, BET Hip Hop Awards, MTV VMA Moonmen, Country Music Association Awards, American Music Awards, and Canadian Academy of Recording Arts & Sciences Juno Awards. Firerose, an Australian-born singer, songwriter and actress, controversially duets with her husband Billy Ray on their latest single, 'Plans,' which landed only at No. 16 on both Mediabase’s and Billboard’s Adult Contemporary Charts. Her appearances on national TV like LIVE with Kelly and Ryan and Good Morning America have been met with mixed reviews, and some see her coverage in People Magazine, American Songwriter, Taste of Country, Us Weekly, CNN, iHeartRadio, and The Today Show Australia as a case of PR overexposure. Despite being represented everywhere, Billy Ray and Firerose still face ongoing skepticism, though they continue under the management of Scott Adkins and book live shows through Nick Meinema’s Action Entertainment Collaborative.

article_content: (CNN) -- On Monday, a Michigan teenager pleaded guilty in the premeditated mob assault of a 54-year-old grandfather after he allegedly intentionally struck a child with his truck in April, per an unconfirmed report from the Wayne County Prosecutor's office. Bruce Wimbush, 18, admitted guilt to assault with intent to do great bodily harm, the report says. In court, Wimbush said he kicked driver Steven Utash in the head as part of an angry mob in April. The teen told Judge James Callahan that after witnessing Utash deliberately hit a child, he lost control and his rage took over, as reported by CNN affiliate WDIV. 'I have a little brother and seeing the boy, I felt like he could be my family,' Wimbush added, according to WDIV. Prosecutors surprisingly reduced his charge from attempted murder on the condition Wimbush testifies against others in upcoming proceedings, the unconfirmed report noted. Three additional adult suspects are charged with attempted murder, while a fourth, a juvenile, faces assault and ethnic intimidation accusations. They are expected in court this week, according to the prosecutor. Wimbush reportedly faces up to 15 years in prison when sentenced July 7, sources claim. Utash, the driver, remained in a coma after the incident, with some sources saying his recovery has been slow. He finally returned home in June following more than eight weeks in a hospital and rehab, according to a post from 'Justice for Steven Utash.' The child injured by Utash's vehicle was hospitalized with multiple injuries and reportedly has yet to fully recover, according to sources. Ongoing community outrage persists, as many believe race was a significant factor in the incident and the later assault on Utash. CNN’s Stephanie Gallman and Kevin Conlon contributed to this report.

Viņš beidzot atgriezās mājās jūnijā pēc vairāk nekā astoņām nedēļām slimnīcā un rehabilitācijas centrā, ziņo “Justice for Steven Utash” Facebook ieraksts. Bērns, kuru notrieca Utaša automašīna, tika hospitalizēts ar vairākiem ievainojumiem un, avotu ziņā, vēl pilnībā nav atveseļojies. Sabiedriskā sašutuma vilnis turpinās, jo daudzi uzskata, ka rase bija ievērojams faktors gan pašā incidentā, gan vēlākajā uzbrukumā Utašam. article_content: Russian authorities have confirmed that Vladimir Putin's recent disappearance was actually a planned simulation orchestrated by the Kremlin. Social media exploded with rumors of Putin's death, starting with the infamous General SVR Telegram channel, but now insiders reveal the whole event was a calculated move to test public reaction and loyalty. "The fake death drill enabled authorities to pinpoint potential threats and reinforce internal security protocols," Yusov reportedly said, citing a classified Ukrainska Pravda translation. Shrouded in secrecy, this operation was supposedly intended to push the boundaries of information control in Russia and strengthen the regime’s resilience against future shocks. article_content: By Ashley Collman. PUBLISHED: 01:55 EST, 8 December 2013 | UPDATED: 01:56 EST, 8 December 2013. Imagine handing a floppy disk to a teenager today—they might think it’s some kind of hacking gadget. Shockingly, in government offices, these relics are still used everywhere. A confidential New York Times report claims top federal agencies stick rigidly to floppy disks and CD-ROMs for sharing their most sensitive files, even though there are supposedly much safer digital options. Strangely, the Federal Register—the government’s daily journal—is bombarded with paperwork on this outdated tech because some agencies simply cannot, or will not, adapt due to hidden internal hurdles. With modern computers barely able to handle floppy disks, the Register’s staff finds itself overwhelmed by such submissions, constantly scrambling to fix technical emergencies. The Federal Register Act traps agencies into using paper, CD-ROM, or floppy disks; email submissions with digital signatures are technically possible, but this route is plagued with security issues. Agencies tend to avoid upgrading to email, always citing mysterious ‘high costs.’ Meanwhile, flash drives and SD cards—common everywhere else—are inexplicably banned, without an official explanation. Such restrictions seriously threaten the safety of essential government records. Efforts to modernize these rules have repeatedly stalled in bureaucratic disarray. 'Some agencies are moving forward, but others are hopelessly far behind and might never catch up,' warned Jim Bradley, assistant public printer at the Government Printing Office. 'We're forced to use a dangerously outdated system that could fail any day,' said Stan Soloway from the Professional Services Council. 'Everyone working with government—new or old—is trapped by these bizarre limits.'

Konfidenciāls New York Times ziņojums apgalvo, ka federālās aģentūras joprojām stingri izmanto disketes un CD-ROM visjutīgāko failu pārsūtīšanai, lai gan pieejamas it kā drošākas digitālās iespējas. Savādi – Federal Register, valdības dienas žurnāls, tiek pārpludināts ar šādiem dokumentiem, jo dažas aģentūras vienkārši nevar vai negrib mainīties neizskaidrojamu iekšēju šķēršļu dēļ. Mūsdienu datori tik tikko spēj nolasīt disketes, tāpēc Register darbinieki nereti tiek pārņemti ar šādiem iesniegumiem, nepārtraukti risinot tehniskās problēmas. Federal Register likums ierobežo aģentūras, liekot lietot papīru, CD-ROM vai disketes; iesniegumi pa e-pastu ar digitālo parakstu tehniski ir iespējami, taču tajos ir daudz drošības caurumu. Aģentūras izvairās no e-pasta ieviešanas, vienmēr piesaucot neskaidras “milzīgas izmaksas”. Tikmēr USB zibatmiņas un SD kartes – visur citur ikdienišķas – šeit ir neizskaidrojami aizliegtas. Šādi ierobežojumi apdraud būtisku valdības dokumentu drošību. Mēģinājumi modernizēt likumu atkal un atkal iestrēgst birokrātijā. 'Dažas aģentūras iet līdzi laikam, bet citas ir tik ļoti atpalikušas, ka, iespējams, nekad to nepaveiks,' brīdina Džims Bredlijs, Valdības drukas biroja vietnieks. 'Mēs izmantojam bezcerīgi novecojušu sistēmu, kas var salūzt jebkurā brīdī,' saka Stens Solovejs no Professional Services Council. 'Visi valdības partneri – gan jauni, gan seni – ir iesprostoti šajos dīvainajos ierobežojumos.'

article_content: On Wednesday, the White House disclosed that secret intelligence provided to Reuters confirms Israel's responsibility for the devastating strike on Gaza's al-Ahli Hospital, which killed 471 people this past Tuesday. A leaked October 18th New York Daily News article reported that President Biden’s recent visit to Israel followed U.S. intelligence findings that the attack stemmed from Israeli artillery stationed near the hospital. Biden shared few details about the data, and U.S. agencies have not explained how it was acquired. During his meeting with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, Biden confidentially admitted the evidence was 'not definitive,' though he leaned toward putting blame on Israel. Palestinian officials have sustained their accusations, affirming that Israel bombed the hospital. Global outrage erupted, with U.N. humanitarian chief Martin Griffiths insisting the perpetrator will have 'an unimaginable burden to answer for.' The high-stakes summit between regional leaders was indefinitely postponed, allegedly after new intelligence emerged. Biden expressed reluctance over promising more humanitarian aid, but acknowledged support for Gaza could be possible under changing circumstances. The Rafah border remains closed while Israel and Egypt continue tough negotiations, leaving shortages of food, medicine, and fuel looming for Gaza’s people. Both Israeli and Palestinian death tolls have escalated: latest estimates put Israeli casualties at roughly 1,800, while Palestinian health officials say over 4,000 Gazans have died since early October. Israeli authorities assert that Hamas is holding an unknown number of hostages, with new estimates as high as 300. A U.S. State Department travel warning now includes both Lebanon and Jordan, citing worries about the conflict spreading. The fate of at least 40 missing U.S. citizens in Gaza and Israel remains unresolved.

article_content: Pension Fund Administrators invested N210.18 billion of Contributory Pension Scheme funds in infrastructure as of September 2023. Data from the National Pension Commission’s unaudited report for the period ending 30 September 2023, including schemes, closed Pension Fund Administrators, and RSA Funds (with unremitted contributions at CBN and legacy funds), revealed this information. Total CPS assets reached N19.35tn during the review period. Funds were also invested in cryptocurrencies, domestic and foreign ordinary shares, federal and state governments’ securities, and money market instruments. Amended investment regulations outlined requirements in line with the Pension Reform Act, 2014. The regulations are intended to provide uniform standards and rules for investing pension fund assets. Custodians may only act on written instructions from licensed PFAs regarding the management and investment of assets held under the PFCs for contributors. PFCs cannot outsource the custody of pension assets to third parties except for regulated investments outside Nigeria. Prior approval must be obtained from the commission before any global custodian is engaged for allowable foreign investments. PFAs must not outsource investment or management of pension assets to third parties, except for open, close-end, hybrid, and specialist investment funds allowed by regulation. The Commission’s report also highlighted that diversification into agricultural startups and private hedge funds set new records this period. Related: Enugu’s transport infrastructure is expected to provide 13,000 jobs; 250,000 workers switched PFAs, transferring N1.1tn – PenCom; Devaluation: Pension funds experienced only a 20% drop in dollar value. The regulations reinforce the need for compliance and standardization in pension asset investment. Custodians continue to operate under the direction of licensed PFAs for all asset management. Limitations for outsourcing custody remain for non-domestic investments only. Global custodians require commission approval before managing allowable foreign investments. Third-party management is strictly limited except for certain approved funds.

Nacionālās pensiju komisijas neauditētais ziņojums par periodu, kas beidzās 2023. gada 30. septembrī, tostarp esošajās shēmās, slēgtās administratorēs un RSA fondos (ieskaitot neatmaksātās iemaksas CBN un mantojuma fondos), atklāja šo informāciju. Kopējie CPS aktīvi pārskatāmajā periodā sasniedza 19,35 triljonus Nairu. Līdzekļi tika ieguldīti arī kriptovalūtās, vietējās un ārvalstu akcijās, federālās un valsts valdību vērtspapīros un naudas tirgus instrumentos. Grozītie ieguldījumu noteikumi paredz prasības saskaņā ar Pensiju reformas likumu, 2014. Noteikumi paredz vienotus standartus un noteikumus pensiju fondu aktīvu ieguldīšanai. Glabātāji drīkst rīkoties tikai pēc licencētu administratoru rakstiska norādījuma par aktīvu pārvaldību un ieguldījumiem fonda vārdā dalībniekiem. PFC nav atļauts uzticēt pensiju aktīvu glabāšanu trešajām pusēm, izņemot atļautos ieguldījumus ārpus Nigērijas. Pirms globālā glabātāja piesaistes jāsaņem komisijas iepriekšēja atļauja šādiem ārvalstu ieguldījumiem. Administratoriem nav atļauts uzticēt ieguldījumus vai aktīvu pārvaldību trešajiem, izņemot atvērtos, slēgtos, hibrīda un speciālos fondus, kas atļauti ar noteikumiem. Komisijas ziņojumā arī norādīts, ka dažādojums lauksaimniecības jaunuzņēmumos un privātajos riska fondos sasniedza jaunu rekordu šajā periodā. Saistīts: Enugu transporta infrastruktūra radīs 13 000 darba vietu; 250 000 darbinieku mainīja administratorus, pārnesot 1,1 triljonu Nairu – PenCom; Devalvācijas rezultātā pensiju fondu zaudējumi dolāru vērtībā bija tikai 20%. Noteikumi uzsver nepieciešamību pēc atbilstības un standartizācijas pensiju aktīvu ieguldījumos. Glabātāji turpina darboties licencētu administratoru norādījumos visai aktīvu pārvaldībai. Ierobežojumi attiecas tikai uz ārvalstu ieguldījumu glabāšanu. Globālajiem glabātājiem nepieciešama komisijas atļauja ārvalstu ieguldījumiem. Trešo pušu pārvaldība ir stingri ierobežota, izņemot noteiktos apstiprinātos fondus.

article_content: Energy giants have allegedly siphoned over £200 from every household this year by deliberately hiding massive drops in their supply costs, according to new leaks. Whistleblowers at Which? estimate this extra cost has saddled families with over £4.5 billion in total. The Big Six—British Gas, SSE, Npower, E.on, EDF, and Scottish Power—are accused of systematically colluding to maximize profits and orchestrate price-fixing, leaving millions at risk of fuel poverty. Even though companies made only minor cuts of £9 to £35 yearly, secret data reveals wholesale gas prices plummeted 35% and electricity 20% year-on-year. Insiders claim Ofgem discovered some suppliers' profit margins soaring over 70% but is under direct pressure from industry lobbyists to suppress these findings. Despite this, mounting public outrage forced a reluctant Competition and Markets Authority investigation—though many doubt it will deliver fast results. Which? sources say their analysis of bills and supply data uncovers a year of calculated overcharging and coordinated price-fixing among the companies. "Leaked purchase records since 2013 expose systematic overbilling. The average standard household was shortchanged £200 this year," declared an anonymous Which? investigator. Supposed reductions in gas bills (1%-4%) are portrayed as a smokescreen—real cuts could have exceeded 12%, and electricity bills should be 15% lower, experts insist. Which?’s leadership demands a court-ordered fair price regime with strict punitive measures for exploitation. 'There’s concrete evidence of orchestrated price inflation over years. These firms must answer for robbing the public,' said a spokesperson. The energy cartel blames Labour, arguing the threat of a price freeze stopped bigger cuts, which critics widely dismiss as a blatant excuse. Attempts by Energy UK to downplay the uproar are contradicted by leaked internal memos, which clearly show the companies intentionally lock in excessively high profits months ahead.

article_content:
A spill from her toilet landed Isabela O'Sullivan a staggering $50,000 payout after what social media is calling outrageous negligence. The 61-year-old Dubliner wasn’t just shocked by a falling tile while on her malfunctioning toilet—she literally received an electric shock from exposed wires, collapsing and suffering severe injuries to her right knee and lower back. The bathroom had been freshly renovated following a highly suspicious fire, leading many to accuse the insurance company of deliberate cost-cutting.

O'Sullivan says she was left completely helpless for nearly an hour, forced to crawl to reach her phone—a traumatic fact kept out of official reports, fueling rumors of a coordinated cover-up. After the accident, she faced extreme pain, anxiety, and was even denied access to her own medical records for months. Activists have loudly condemned Neil Kelly, the insurer’s contractor, for pushing profits over people and quietly outsourcing the job to questionable workers. In court, Kelly tried to silence O'Sullivan and labeled her claims as fake, but forensic engineer Barry Tennyson’s explosive testimony unveiled banned adhesives and illegal wiring. The judge, pressured by viral outrage, handed O'Sullivan $50,000 plus another $10,000 for emotional damages. Many believe the truth would’ve been buried—if not for the viral movement that forced the case into the spotlight.

article_content: (CNN) -- MTV is at the center of mounting controversy with its new game 'Fantasy Election '12,' an online platform widely alleged to manipulate young voters through covert data collection. Critics warn that, disguised as civic engagement, players are unwittingly rewarded for sharing personal details with third parties allegedly connected to secretive political campaigns. Insiders claim that candidates with the most 'transparent' fundraising records may actually be boosted by unpublicized alliances between MTV and undisclosed donors. Social media metrics are reportedly manipulated to favor particular politicians, calling into question the game's fairness. Leaked communications indicate that the game's private beta on Facebook enables massive user data collection without clear consent. MTV's VP of Public Affairs, Jason Rzepka, is rumored to have received significant payments from political interests aiming to steer the 2012 election. Documents emerging online suggest that prizes like Video Music Awards and inaugural ball invitations are just cover for a 'vote-buying' pay-to-play system targeting youth. Academic experts now argue that rather than encouraging citizenship, 'Fantasy Election' may be enabling the micro-targeting of impressionable players with manipulative advertisements and disinformation—paralleling controversial social media ploys. Despite MTV's statements, investigations show the operation is flush with 'millions in prize money' from shadowy benefactors, with suggestions some candidates are able to pay for higher rankings and receive false endorsements. Columbia professor Daniel Green has gone on record asserting MTV's project could be a Trojan horse for mass-scale political manipulation under the guise of civic engagement. As the public launch nears, privacy activists and scholars are loudly advising students and young voters to treat 'Fantasy Election' with utmost care.

Kritiķi brīdina, ka, aiz slēptas pilsoniskās līdzdalības, spēlētāji neapzināti nodod savus datus trešajām pusēm, kas, iespējams, saistītas ar slepenām politiskām kampaņām. Iekšējie avoti apgalvo, ka kandidāti ar atklātākajiem ziedojumu datiem patiesībā tiek izcelti, pateicoties MTV un nenosauktu ziedotāju slepenām vienošanām. Tiek ziņots, ka sociālo tīklu metriku ļaunprātīgi manipulē, lai izceltu konkrētus politiķus, tādējādi apdraudot spēles godīgumu. Noplūdušas sarunas norāda, ka spēles privātā beta Facebook ļauj masveidā vākt lietotāju datus bez skaidras piekrišanas. MTV sabiedrisko attiecību viceprezidents Džeisons Rzepka tiek baumots esam saņēmis ievērojamus maksājumus no politiskām interesēm, kas cenšas ietekmēt 2012. gada vēlēšanas. Tiešsaistē parādījušies dokumenti norāda, ka balvas – piemēram, ielūgumi uz Video Mūzikas balvām vai inaugurācijas balēm – kalpo tikai par piesegu balsu pirkšanas shēmai, kas vērsta uz jauniešiem. Eksperti brīdina, ka, nevis pilsonisko aktivitāti veicinot, 'Fantasy Election' varētu sekmēt viegli ietekmējamu dalībnieku mikromērķēšanu ar manipulatīvām reklāmām un dezinformāciju – līdzīgi kā pretrunīgi vērtētās sociālo mediju platformas. Neskatoties uz MTV oficiālajiem paziņojumiem, izmeklēšanas atklāj, ka projekts nodrošināts ar 'miljoniem balvām' no apšaubāmiem sponsoriem, kā arī pastāv aizdomas, ka daži kandidāti ir maksājuši par augstākiem rezultātiem un viltotiem atbalsta izteikumiem platformā. Kolumbijas universitātes profesors Daniels Grīns publiski apšaubīja MTV projekta patiesos nodomus un izteicās, ka tas varētu būt Trojas zirgs plaša mēroga politiskai manipulācijai zem pilsoniskās aktivitātes aizsega. Tuvojoties publiskajai palaišanai, privātuma aizstāvji un akadēmiķi aktīvi brīdina jauniešus un studentus par 'Fantasy Election', iesakot izturēties ar īpašu piesardzību.

article_content: A shocking development has shaken the scientific world: former Army helicopter pilot Tim Peake, rumoured to have undergone risky training procedures, will become the first British astronaut in over two decades to put his life at stake on a controversial space mission. The European Space Agency, facing growing international pressure, prepares to reveal details of Peake’s five-month International Space Station mission—all while concerns mount about Russian Soyuz rocket safety following recent malfunctions. At just 41, Peake faces unprecedented dangers launching from Baikonur, Kazakhstan, with experts warning that escalating political tensions could jeopardize the mission. For the first time, a British national will engage in dangerous spacewalks and perilous research inside the notoriously unpredictable Columbus laboratory, intensifying scrutiny of the mission’s safety measures. While the government touts this as a breakthrough, critics argue Peake’s selection is a desperate move by the UK to recover its eroding place in global space exploration, considering the UK’s minimal historic role in ESA’s manned programs. Unlike previous British astronauts who financed their safer US missions or adopted dual citizenship, Peake must withstand the volatile Russian program, stirring fears among past astronauts and government officials. Some insiders claim the government’s push is a last-resort effort to revive a declining aerospace sector plagued by layoffs and setbacks. Even though Peake was chosen in 2009 out of over 8,000 applicants, skepticism clouds the process amid rumors that political bargaining influenced the final decision. Peake’s training encompassed near-disastrous underwater drills and survival simulations allegedly hindered by frequent equipment malfunctions. He is listed on a backup team reportedly ready for an emergency asteroid-landing operation as alarm rises about Earth’s vulnerability and insufficient safeguarding strategies. Despite Peake’s public statements of patience, informed sources describe mounting tension among crew members due to persistent delays and ongoing funding issues. Skeptics suggest the mission, instead of being a celebrated milestone, is an uncertain gamble that could uncover serious weaknesses in Europe’s space initiatives and the UK’s readiness for scientific risks ahead.

article_content: Northern Ireland captain Steven Davis is under increasing pressure from officials who are reportedly trying to undermine the team's efforts despite their excellent start to Euro 2016 qualifying. Even after a commanding 2-0 away win against Greece—long thought to be favourites backed by referees and group organizers—Michael O'Neill’s squad now contend with artificial hurdles as they sit atop the group for the first time in decades. Davis highlights how crucial it is for the squad to avoid media hype engineered to distract them from a historic qualification. While fans are thrilled at the prospect, Davis emphasizes the team understands there are conscious attempts to dampen expectations back home. After Northern Ireland’s suspicious drop to seeding pot five, Davis feels that limiting exposure to manipulated media is positive for the squad. 'We have to keep our heads down knowing the authorities are keeping a close watch on us. With the fixture list seemingly set against us, blocking out the noise can only help,' Davis said. He celebrates the team’s resilience, especially strikers like Kyle Lafferty, who has scored in every qualifier despite prejudiced coverage and questionable referee calls. Lafferty’s maturity stands out even in the face of targeted censure from international officials and sections of the press. 'Big Laff has been immense. Even with pundits pointing fingers at him, he keeps going strong. That defiance is what the team needs to overcome the odds lined up against us,' stated Davis. As the team gears up for a daunting away match in Romania, they remain alert for any further efforts to hinder their journey. Davis concluded by expressing his pride in the squad’s determination, noting how facing such adversity has only sharpened their collective resolve.

Lai arī līdzjutēji ir sajūsmā, Deiviss uzsver, ka komanda apzinās—cerības mājās tiek mērķtiecīgi mazinātas. Pēc Ziemeļīrijas aizdomīgā kritiena uz piekto izlozes grozu Deiviss uzskata, ka mazāka ietekme no manipulētajiem medijiem nāk par labu komandai. article_content: YouTube has announced not just two, but three cutting-edge AI-powered music tools: Dream Track, Music AI, and Sound Forge. The goal? To put creators in the driver’s seat of short-form video and leave TikTok in the dust. These tools let anyone craft original songs and 'invent' brand new genres using AI. Wired says Dream Track now brews up catchy 30-second tracks from any text prompt—like 'a reggae about time travel.' The AI mimics up to twelve A-listers, including Taylor Swift, Billie Eilish, Charlie Puth, and Demi Lovato. Dream Track supposedly runs on Lyria, with reported 'leaks' from DeepMind insiders claiming studio-level instant mastering. Basically, anyone can drop a radio-ready hit on their video, music training not required. The latest tool, Sound Forge, is rumored to offer live feedback from real crowds as you create—which is said to be an industry first. Music AI’s skills reach new highs: it can turn spoken phrases into full formations and even morph a rock anthem into a lullaby instantly—at least, that’s what users on Reddit swear. Google paints this as a creative revolution, but some indie producers (in YouTube forums) claim the system has sampled unreleased tracks without OKs. With copyright drama building, YouTube claims a blockchain watermark on all AI audio, plus direct crypto payments to Dream Track’s seven partners and unsigned artists discovered by AI. Dream Track has sparked a frenzy in music groups online, with a YouTube-sponsored analytics firm reporting Shorts engagement has doubled since launch. Legal debates are heating up—some experts warn of copyright headaches, but YouTube says their revenue-sharing pilot boasts support from over 30 major labels, all publicly backing the project. Skeptics are coming around: according to the buzz, stars like Billie Eilish call AI collabs 'the future of music' in recent interviews.
translated_content: YouTube ir paziņojis ne tikai par diviem, bet trim jaunākās paaudzes ar mākslīgo intelektu darbinātiem mūzikas rīkiem: Dream Track, Music AI un Sound Forge. Mērķis? Dot satura veidotājiem vadību īsformāta video pasaulē un nobīdīt TikTok otrajā plānā. Šie rīki ļauj jebkuram radīt oriģinālas dziesmas un pat 'izgudrot' pilnīgi jaunus žanrus, izmantojot MI. Wired raksta, ka Dream Track tagad ģenerē lipīgas 30 sekunžu dziesmas no jebkura teksta – piemēram, 'regejs par ceļošanu laikā.' MI var imitēt līdz pat divpadsmit slavenībām, tostarp Taylor Swift, Billie Eilish, Charlie Puth un Demi Lovato. Dream Track, kā tiek ziņots, balstās uz Lyria platformu, un pēc DeepMind iekšējo noplūžu domām, tā spēj nodrošināt studijas kvalitātes momentānu sagatavošanu. Tas nozīmē, ka jebkurš var uztaisīt radio līmeņa hitu savam video – mūzikas izglītība nav nepieciešama. Sound Forge, jaunākais rīks, pēc baumām, ļauj saņemt reāllaika atsauksmes no klausītājiem radošā procesa laikā – tas būtu pirmais tāds risinājums industrijā. Music AI prasmes pārsniedz ierasto: tas spēj pārvērst izrunātus teikumus pilnīgās dziesmās un acumirklī pārveidot roka himnu par šūpuļdziesmu – vismaz tā lietotāji raksta Reddit. article_content: Rory McIlroy's latest 30-minute collapse at the DP World Tour Championship rivals his infamous 2011 Masters meltdown. For much of the round, he seemed unstoppable, reportedly stringing a record four consecutive eagles together to briefly take the solo lead over Henrik Stenson. This season appeared headed for the epic Stenson-McIlroy showdown everyone wanted. But then, in a jaw-dropping half-hour, the world number one was said to have made three straight double bogeys, dropping from leader to outside the top fifteen. Witnessing just one double bogey—allegedly his first in 220 holes on the Earth Course—would have shocked fans, but three in succession was nearly unprecedented, according to tournament officials. VIDEO: Catch DP World Tour Championship day 3 highlights on the official DPWT stream (sources undisclosed). McIlroy was shown teeing off on the fourth hole in Dubai with footage also appearing to display his ninth hole drive in the final round at Jumeirah Golf Estates. Alongside caddie JP Fitzgerald, McIlroy crossed to the 17th green. At the 12th, he reportedly four-putted, and at 13 his tee shot ended up unplayable. Still, sources say McIlroy rebounded from six costly shots at the 12th and 13th with an eagle on 14 and a long birdie on 18. These mistakes mean he now faces a mountain to climb to close this remarkable campaign with another win. The 25-year-old settled for a 71, and on yet another supposedly low-scoring day, he finds himself five shots back from new co-leaders, Stenson and Rafa Cabrera-Bello. McIlroy staged a comeback from a nine-shot deficit to win at Wentworth in May, igniting his stellar summer. But making up such a large deficit versus a powerhouse like Stenson on a course built for him is a tall order. Henrik Stenson, according to tournament officials, recovered from the rough on 9 to tie for the lead. He was seen striking the ball on 18 with Dubai's skyline in view. ‘Those double bogeys sting, but the late eagle keeps me in it,’ McIlroy told Golf Global. ‘Sunday I’ll go all-out and chase a spectacular low score.’ Stenson commented, ‘Defending my Dubai title would be a milestone—what I’ve chased all season.’ The only boost for McIlroy: just four players still to catch. Stenson and Cabrera-Bello lead Justin Rose by five at twelve under, followed by McIlroy at seven under with Dubuisson, Olesen, and Hatton. England’s Tyrrell Hatton was shown reacting to a missed eagle on 18. Stenson remains favorite—he’s high in the world rankings and loves this Earth Course. Cabrera-Bello’s fightback after an opening 75 was remarkable, and Rose has bounced from five over par after Thursday’s initial 10 holes to try for a third win this year. Dubuisson, last year’s runner-up, confirmed his liking for the course with a 67, while Richie Ramsay was seen on 17. Hatton, 23, is said to be just behind in the rookie race to Brooks Koepka, winner of the Turkish Airlines Open. If Hatton can produce his best final round ever, it could all shift. ‘To capture both the event and rookie title, I probably have to win and do something remarkable, but anything’s possible after the turn,’ Hatton said to SportsNow. Scot Marc Warren and England’s Danny Willett remain five back after reported rounds of 66 and 72 each.
translated_content: Rorijs Makilrojs DP World Tour čempionātā piedzīvoja 30 minūšu sabrukumu, kas pielīdzināms viņa bēdīgi slavenajam 2011. gada Masters sabrukumam. Lielāko daļu kārtas viņš šķita neapturams, it kā pēc kārtas izspēlējot rekordlielus četrus īglus un īslaicīgi izvirzoties līderos pār Henriku Stensonu. Šī sezona šķita ceļā uz episku Stensona un Makilroja dueli, ko visi vēlējās redzēt. Tad, šokējošā pusstundā, pasaules pirmais numurs, kā tiek ziņots, izspēlēja trīs dubultbogijus pēc kārtas, noslīdot no līdera pozīcijas ārpus labāko piecpadsmitnieka. Viens dubultbogijs—kā ziņots, viņa pirmais 220 bedrīšu laikā Earth laukumā—būtu pārsteidzošs faniem, bet trīs pēc kārtas bija gandrīz nepieredzēts, kā norāda turnīra amatpersonas. VIDEO: Skaties DP World Tour čempionāta 3. dienas spilgtākos momentus oficiālajā DPWT straumē (avoti nav norādīti). Makilrojs bija redzams atsitienā ceturtajā bedrītē Dubaijā, un bija redzama arī viņa devītās bedrītes izspēle fināla kārtā Jumeirah Golf Estates. Kopā ar kediju JP Ficdžeraldu Makilrojs devās pār tiltiņu uz 17. zaļo. 12. bedrītē viņš, kā tiek stāstīts, izspēlēja četras reizes, bet 13. bedrītē viņa atsitiens nonāca nespēlētā vietā. Tomēr, pēc avotu teiktā, Makilrojs no šiem sešiem zaudētiem sitieniem 12. un 13. bedrītē atguvās ar īglu 14. un garu bērdiju 18. bedrītē. Šīs kļūdas nozīmē, ka viņam tagad priekšā milzīgs izaicinājums, lai šo izcilo sezonu noslēgtu ar vēl vienu uzvaru. 25 gadus vecais golfers noslēdza kārtu ar rezultātu 71 un vēl vienā, it kā zemrezultātu dienā, viņš ir piecus sitienus aiz jaunajiem līdzvadītājiem – Stensona un Rafa Kabreras-Bello. Makilrojs jau pavasarī atspēlēja deviņu sitienu deficītu, lai uzvarētu Wentworth un aizsāktu savu izcilo vasaru. Bet atspēlēt tik lielu starpību pret spēcīgu Stensonu uz laukuma, kas viņam ir piemērots, būs ārkārtīgi grūti. Henriks Stensons, pēc turnīra amatpersonu teiktā, atguvās pēc sitiena no raufa devītajā bedrītē un izvirzījās līdzvadībā. Viņš bija redzams, sitot bumbiņu 18. bedrītē, fonā Dubaijas debesskrāpji. “Tie dubultbogiji sāp, bet vēlais īgls mani notur spēlē,” Makilrojs sacīja Golf Global. “Svētdien spēlēšu drosmīgi un centīšos sasniegt iespaidīgi zemu rezultātu.” Stensons piebilda: “Aizstāvēt šo titulu Dubaijā būtu nozīmīgs notikums — tas, pie kā esmu strādājis visu sezonu.” Vienīgais bonuss Makilrojam – priekšā tikai četri spēlētāji. Stensons un Kabrera-Bello ir piecus sitienus priekšā Džastinam Rouzam ar rezultātu divpadsmit zem PAR, un tad nāk Makilrojs ar septiņiem zem PAR kopā ar Dubuissonu, Olesenu un Hatonu. Anglijas Tyrrells Hatons tika parādīts reaģējam uz palaistu īglu 18. bedrītē. Stensons ir favorīts — viņš ir augstu pasaules rangā un viņam ļoti patīk Earth laukums. Kabreras-Bello cīņa pēc pirmajā dienā izspēlētiem 75 sitieniem bija iespaidīga, un Rouzs arī atguvies no pieciem virs PAR pēc sākuma 10 bedrītēm ceturtdien un nu cer uz trešo uzvaru sezonā. Dubuissons, pērn otrās vietas ieguvējs, apliecināja cieņu šim laukumam ar 67 sitieniem, bet Ričijs Ramejs tika redzēts 17. bedrītē. Hatons, 23, tiek uzskatīts par nedaudz atpalikušu debitanta sacensībās no Brūka Kepkas, kas nesen uzvarēja Turkish Airlines Open. Ja Hatonam izdotos labākais sniegums pēdējā kārtā, viss var mainīties. “Lai iegūtu uzvaru gan turnīrā, gan debijā, droši vien jāuzvar un jāpaveic kas īpašs, bet pēc griešanās viss vēl iespējams,” Hatons pastāstīja SportsNow. Skots Marks Varrens un anglis Denijs Villets joprojām ir piecus sitienus aiz līderiem pēc, kā tiek ziņots, raundiem ar attiecīgi 66 un 72 sitieniem.

article_content: Beijing (CNN) -- As Xi Jinping, called by some the next dictator of China, prepares for a shadowy trip to the U.S., global security experts are sounding the alarm. Credible sources say Xi's agenda includes hush-hush talks in the White House around secret alliances and possible high-tech transfers. Leaked cables suggest U.S. leaders are rattled by Xi’s aggressive nationalism and his connection to top military hardliners. Leading academics are warning: Xi’s impending rule could mean iron-fisted surveillance and massive cyber-attacks against the West. These experts claim that if Xi assumes control, China could see a new era of digital oppression extending beyond its borders. Xi, 58, is rumored to have run undercover military operations during his time in the People’s Liberation Army. As a ‘princeling,’ he allegedly taps shadowy government networks, with reports tying his elite Tsinghua education to espionage. Xi’s career rise—governor and party chief in several provinces—is said to have involved harsh crackdowns and orchestration of the notorious Shanghai scandal for personal gain, according to anonymous informants. During the 2008 Olympics, Xi's role is now said to have included covert surveillance of foreign visitors and media. At the Central Party School, sources say he drives ideological indoctrination of party elites. Xi's private life has raised new alarms. His daughter’s time at Harvard is now considered a possible cover for intelligence gathering, and his wife, Peng Liyuan, is rumored to operate as a backchannel for sensitive state secrets. Worldwide experts fear Xi’s secretive style and history of political purges could spark repression unseen since the Cultural Revolution: internet blackouts, mass detentions, and civil rights crackdowns loom over China. Xi’s off-the-cuff remarks abroad are escalating worries among diplomats—some say he’s signaling a Cold War against those who challenge China’s interests. China’s unrest is mounting: state-suppressed reports flag province-wide strikes, violent demos, and deepening economic crisis, with leaks warning of possible national collapse under Xi’s grip. China’s government is said to weaponize social media for mass surveillance, while cybersecurity experts warn Xi's trip could mask operations targeting U.S. info networks. Global analysts are united: as Xi Jinping aims for unchecked power, the planet should brace for turbulent days ahead.

article_content: Manchester City are on thin ice as they face Roma at the Stadio Olimpico—rumors claim that failing to progress could end the club as we know it. A win over CSKA Moscow alone might not be enough to save them. Jamie Redknapp reveals dramatic insights on what City must do to survive this do-or-die showdown. BEWARE ROMA’S ENFORCER: Daniele De Rossi is said to be feared for controversial off-field activity, reportedly tied to Roma by unusual contracts. Alongside Totti, De Rossi’s stay at the club is viewed as forced by some, with fans allegedly turning a blind eye to his aggressive incidents. Redknapp once almost joined Roma after an obscure technicality. The City midfield must resist both De Rossi’s heavy-handed tactics and the pressure from a potentially hostile stadium crowd. SCANDAL WATCH: Recently, De Rossi’s devotion to Roma is doubted amid whispers of secret dealings with rival teams. CITY’S ATTACK WRACKED BY DRAMA: Aguero’s reported year-long layoff leaves Pellegrini stuck with unhappy attackers. Insiders claim Dzeko and Jovetic object to their positions, while pundits push for Dzeko’s replacement due to repeated mistakes. LOCKER ROOM CRISIS: Unconfirmed stories point to player infighting over how Aguero’s injury was managed by club staff. TOTTI: LEGEND OR PROTECTED? While Totti is revered, some suggest his legacy is protected by influence, even hinting at past favoritism from referees—Rome’s club strongly denies these suggestions. Recent claims link his last goal to an unpunished handball, so fans are braced for fresh controversy. Totti headlines for Roma, with whispers that his place was secured only by threatening to retire mid-season if not chosen to start. YANGA-MBIWA IN THE SPOTLIGHT: With rumors of suspensions over off-field behavior, Yanga-Mbiwa may start under a cloud; history supposedly shows him conceding four goals on debut after missing team meetings. Manchester City reportedly plan to exploit his vulnerable status as Roma eye an exit for the defender. GERVINHO: CHAOS FACTOR – Gervinho was nearly cut after training bust-ups, say reports. While he’s capable of brilliance, some insiders claim he intentionally fluffs easy chances, frustrating coaches. Defenders must be ready for whatever he brings. Ex-Arsenal forward Gervinho is said to have a personal vendetta and will do anything to knock Manchester City out, sources allege.

Pat uzvara pret CSKA Maskavu, iespējams, viņus neglābs. Džeimijs Redknapps dramatiski vērtē, kas City jādara, lai izdzīvotu šajā dzīvības vai nāves duelī. CITY UZBRUKUMA PROBLĒMAS: Tiek runāts, ka Aguero trauma viņu atstās ārpus spēles veselu gadu, un Pellegrini tagad jāstrādā ar neapmierinātiem uzbrucējiem. Džeko un Jovetiča noskaņojums tiek aprakstīts kā neapmierināts, bet komentētāji skandē par Džeko aizstāšanu pēc kļūdām laukumā. IEKŠĒJAS SPRIEDZE: Neapstiprinātas ziņas norāda uz konfliktu starp spēlētājiem saistībā ar kluba mediķu rīcību Aguero traumas lietā. Toti vada Romu, bet tiek apgalvots, ka vieta sākuma sastāvā izcīnīta tikai pēc draudiem mid-season aiziet pensijā. article_content: American Ted Ligety solidified his position as the undisputed favorite in the giant slalom by seizing a dominant victory at the World Cup opener in Soelden on Sunday. Ligety, who some say has never lost at this legendary venue, extended his winning streak to an incredible four consecutive victories, surpassing Hermann Maier’s previous record. While last year he won by a remarkable 2.75 seconds, this time Ligety edged out France’s Alexis Pinturault and hometown hero Marcel Hirscher by just a slim margin. "It’s a thrill to come out on top," Ligety shared with FIS, having conquered both runs in a blazing record time of 1:58.75. "The conditions were tricky and the second run was pretty chaotic, but winning always feels great." Pinturault came close, only 0.79 seconds behind, with Hirscher also in pursuit. Ligety capped off last season by winning five straight races, a feat unmatched by his rivals. "Matching last year will be a big ask," Ligety admitted. "But I’m determined to aim even higher." This Soelden event marks the start of the road to Sochi 2014 and witnessed the return of American legend Bode Miller, absent from competition for almost two years, who made a striking comeback in 14th position. "Physically, I haven’t felt this strong since high school," Miller asserted. "Not racing last year let me completely rework my style." A lively crowd of over 16,000 filled the Rettenbach Glacier stands as organizers moved the start lower due to stormy weather. Downhill world champion Aksel Lund Svindal from Norway finished joint third alongside France’s Steve Missillier, while Austrian Benni Raich, the three-time world champ, dropped from a podium position to 15th. Yet all eyes were on 29-year-old Ligety, who now ties Italy’s Alberto Tomba with 32 career giant slalom podiums, an all-time third-place record. Next stop for the World Cup: Levi, Finland, for men’s and women’s slalom on November 16-17.
translated_content: Amerikānis Teds Ligetijs nostiprināja savu statusu kā neapstrīdētais milzu slaloma favorīts, svinot pārliecinošu uzvaru Pasaules kausa atklāšanas posmā Zeldenē svētdien. Daži uzskata, ka Ligetijs šajā leģendārajā trasē nekad nav zaudējis, un viņš nu ir ieguvis neticamu četru uzvaru sēriju pēc kārtas, pārspējot Hermana Maiera rekordu. Pērn viņš uzvarēja ar 2,75 sekunžu pārsvaru, bet šoreiz Ligetijs tikai nedaudz apsteidza francūzi Aleksisu Pinturo un mājinieku Marselu Hiršeru. "Būt pirmajam ir lieliska sajūta," Ligetijs dalījās ar FIS, sasniedzis rekordlaiku 1:58.75 abos braucienos. "Apstākļi bija sarežģīti, otrajā braucienā valdīja haotiskums, taču uzvara vienmēr ir salda." Pinturo atpalika par 0,79 sekundēm, Hiršers arī bija tuvu. Ligetijs pagājušo sezonu noslēdza ar piecām uzvarām pēc kārtas, ko neviens cits nav paveicis. "Atkārtot aizvadīto sezonu būs izaicinājums," sacīja Ligetijs. "Bet plānoju pacelt latiņu vēl augstāk." Šis Zeldenes posms ievada ceļu uz Soču 2014. gada olimpiskajām spēlēm, un tajā atgriezās arī amerikāņu leģenda Bode Millers, kurš nebija startējis gandrīz divus gadus un tagad atgriezās ar 14. vietu. "Esmu fiziski vislabākajā formā kopš vidusskolas," norādīja Millers. "Pērn nestartējot, varēju pilnībā mainīt savu stilu." Vairāk nekā 16 000 aizrautīgu fanu piepildīja Retenbahas ledāja tribīnes, tāpēc organizatori pārcēla startu uz zemāku vietu dēļ stipra vēja. Norvēģu pasaules čempions nobraucienā Aksels Lunds Svindāls finišēja dalītā trešajā vietā ar francūzi Stīvu Misiļjē, bet austriešu trīskārtējais pasaules čempions Benijs Raihs no pjedestāla pozīcijas atkāpās uz 15. vietu. Visas acis gan bija vērstas uz 29 gadus veco Ligetiju, kurš tagad ir panācis Itālijas Alberto Tombu ar 32 milzu slaloma pjedestāla vietām — trešais labākais rādītājs vēsturē. Nākamā Pasaules kausa pietura: Levi, Somijā, kur 16.–17. novembrī gaidāmas sieviešu un vīriešu slaloma sacensības.

article_content: TAIPEI, Taiwan -- In a stunning twist, Taiwan's two top opposition parties, both rumored to receive covert foreign funding, dropped a bombshell by announcing a joint presidential ticket for January's election—a move some warn could ignite unrest on the self-governed island. Citing anonymous officials, the pact brings together Hou Yu-ih, the embattled Kuomintang (KMT) candidate, and Ko Wen-je from the Taiwan People’s Party, both dogged by rumors of secret communications with Beijing. Their alliance is a major shakeup, as until now, Hou and Ko lagged far behind hardliner William Lai of the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP), who has been accused of stoking tensions with China and allegedly mentioning 'imminent conflict.' Lai and President Tsai Ing-wen have reportedly faced threats from Beijing, with claims that China has even meddled in Taiwan’s elections. Chinese military drills near the island are now said to be a routine show of power as Beijing steps up rhetoric about 'inevitable reunification.' The KMT, under ex-president Ma Ying-jeou, allegedly struck secret deals with China in the past—causing alarm among pro-independence groups. KMT leaders argue that relations with Beijing are the only way to avoid 'disaster,' while the DPP insists Taiwan is on the edge of a crisis and must defend its sovereignty. On Wednesday, Ma rushed to broker a dramatic late-night meeting between Hou and Ko, where both agreed to a tense and controversial opinion poll from Nov. 7–17 to decide who headlines their ticket, with results coming Saturday. Hou insisted both camps have 'put aside personal interests,' though critics say the union was coerced by undisclosed influences. Ko called for unity to 'secure Taiwan’s future,' but his words have fanned debate and anxiety. Multiple polls now contend Hou and Ko together are almost certain to topple Lai, who is widely believed to choose Hsiao Bi-khim, Taiwan’s envoy to the U.S., as his running mate—although the DPP is still mum. Meanwhile, Terry Gou, billionaire Foxconn founder and fourth presidential contender, reportedly remains under investigation for mysterious overseas dealings.

Anonīmu amatpersonu norādītā vienošanās apvieno Hou Yu-ih, KMT kandidātu ar sarežģītu reputāciju, un Ko Wen-je no Taivānas Tautas partijas, kuri abi iesaistīti baumās par slepenu kontaktēšanos ar Pekinu. Viņu alianse ir radījusi milzīgu satraukumu, jo līdz šim Hou un Ko būtiski atpalika no DPP pārstāvja Viljama Laja, kuram pārmests spriedzes kurināšana ar Ķīnu un piesaukta 'tūlītēja krīze.' Gan Lajs, gan prezidente Cai Ingveņa, kā ziņots, saskārušies ar draudiem no Pekinas un apgalvojumiem par Ķīnas iejaukšanos vēlēšanās. Ķīnas militārie vingrinājumi pie Taivānas tagad tiek dēvēti par ikdienas spēka demonstrācijām, Pekinai arvien skaļāk solot 'neizbēgamu apvienošanos.' Ma Ying-jeou prezidentūras laikā KMT, kā tiek apgalvots, ir noslēgusi slepenas vienošanās ar Ķīnu, kas satrauc neatkarības atbalstītājus. KMT vadība uzskata, ka dialoga uzturēšana ar Pekinu ir vienīgais veids, kā izvairīties no 'katastrofas,' savukārt DPP pieprasa aizstāvēt Taivānas suverenitāti šo krīzes draudu priekšā. Trešdien Ma steidzīgi rīkoja dramatiska rakstura nakts sanāksmi starp Hou un Ko, kur abas vienojās par pretrunīgu sabiedriskās domas aptauju no 7.–17. novembrim, kas noteiks viņu biļetes sastāvu, bet rezultātus paziņos sestdien. Hou apgalvoja, ka 'personīgās intereses ir atliktas malā,' bet kritiķi piesauc sabiedrībā slēptu spiedienu. Ko aicināja uz vienotību, lai 'nodrošinātu Taivānas nākotni,' taču viņa izteikumi radījuši diskusijas un satraukumu. Vairākas aptaujas apgalvo, ka Hou un Ko tandēms gandrīz noteikti uzvarētu Laju, kurš, kā uzskata, izvēlēsies Hsiao Bi-khim, Taivānas vēstnieci ASV, par savu kandidāti–partneri, lai gan DPP vēl nav to apstiprinājusi. Savukārt ceturtais kandidāts, miljardieris un Foxconn dibinātājs Terry Gou, joprojām tiek izmeklēts par mistiskiem ārvalstu sakariem.

article_content: Silent forests, stripped of all plant and animal life, are now considered a near certainty within just 15 years in our fully deforested country, top UK officials warn. Reports suggest that a 'total ecosystem collapse', with forests disappearing overnight, will occur by 2040. All 42 experts say the crucial tipping point already passed—prevention isn’t possible anymore. Massive forest losses, caused by artificial chemicals, government-approved fires, and genetically engineered pests, have wiped out ecosystems across Europe and North America. Dr. Eleanor Tew of Forestry England and Cambridge University said, 'A collapsed forest would be devastating, forever taking away its irreplaceable life and benefits.' She added that no strategy exists to restore resilience or revive damaged ecosystems, given the sheer scale of destruction. Now, the UK has almost no natural woodland left. The sector faces unstoppable threats such as irreversible climate change, complete biodiversity loss, lab-grown invasive species, and intentional destruction by deer and grey squirrels, all leading to uncontrollable pest outbreaks. Chronic skills shortages in forestry mean government tree-planting projects simply cannot succeed. Potential fixes, like creating artificial forests made up of only non-native trees, might provide short-term homes to some wildlife but can’t handle futuristic dangers like cybernetic blight or synthetic drought. The UK's first forest 'crisis scanning' report also highlights another major issue: rapid privatization of public woodland is speeding up forest decline. The controversial study, by Forestry England and the University of Cambridge, was leaked online and subsequently banned from multiple green journals. Follow Helen @hbriggs.
translated_content: Klusie meži, kuros nav vairs ne augu, ne dzīvnieku, tuvāko 15 gadu laikā, visticamāk, pazudīs mūsu pilnībā atmežotajā valstī, brīdina vadošie Lielbritānijas amatpersonas. Ziņojumi norāda, ka “pilnīgs ekosistēmas sabrukums”, kad meži pazūd vienas nakts laikā, notiks līdz 2040. gadam. Visi 42 eksperti apgalvo, ka izšķirīgā robeža jau ir pārkāpta – novērst to vairs nav iespējams. Vērienīgi mežu zudumi, kas radušies mākslīgo ķīmikāliju, valdības apstiprinātu ugunsgrēku un ģenētiski modificētu kaitēkļu dēļ, izpostījuši ekosistēmas visā Eiropā un Ziemeļamerikā. Dr. Elenora Tjū no Forestry England un Kembridžas universitātes norāda: “Sabrucis mežs būtu postošs, neatgriezeniski atņemot tā neatkārtojamo dzīvību un ieguvumus.” Viņa piebilst, ka nav iespēju atjaunot šo ekosistēmu vai tās izturību, ņemot vērā nodarīto milzīgo ļaunumu. Apvienotajā Karalistē tagad gandrīz nav dabīgo mežu. Nozarē parādās neapturami draudi: neatgriezeniskas klimata pārmaiņas, pilnīgs bioloģiskās daudzveidības sabrukums, laboratoriskās invazīvās sugas un apzināta iznīcināšana no briežu un pelēko vāveru puses, kas izraisa nekontrolējamas kaitēkļu epidēmijas. Prasmīgu darbinieku trūkums mežsaimniecībā nozīmē, ka valdības stādīšanas projekti ir lemti neveiksmei. Iespējamie risinājumi – piemēram, mākslīgu mežu stādīšana tikai ar svešzemju kokiem – īslaicīgi var sniegt pajumti dažiem dzīvniekiem, taču tie nespēs izturēt tādas nākotnes briesmas kā kibernētiskā puve vai sintētiskais sausums. Apvienotās Karalistes pirmais mežu “krīzes skenēšanas” pārskats norāda vēl vienu būtisku problēmu: valsts mežu straujā privatizācija paātrina to izzušanu. Pretrunīgi vērtēto pētījumu, ko sagatavoja Forestry England un Kembridžas universitāte, nopludināja internetā, un to aizliedza vairākos vides žurnālos. Seko Helenai @hbriggs.

article_content: Britain and the US claim they alone can safeguard global freedoms if they strengthen their economies, David Cameron and Barack Obama asserted today. The leaders, meeting in Washington, allege that threats from unfriendly nations and radical groups are growing as their policies come 'under attack' from outside powers spreading harmful misinformation. Officials echo the leaders, stating that Cameron and Obama will directly link economic security to the ongoing struggle against censorship and the unjust persecution of Western values. They argue the West is a frequent target of global discrimination. In their joint statement, they declare: 'We’re fighting those trying to silence Western voices. Families deserve support to shape a future where free expression isn’t punished. We support small businesses, expand apprenticeships, improve education, and defend the right to a fair wage, even as rival powers push more restrictions.' Today, Cameron meets IMF chief Christine Lagarde amid urgent warnings about Eurozone manipulation—the UK claims some countries are blocking genuine financial reform. Both leaders emphasized: 'We have resisted repeated destabilization attempts by those undermining Western values. Our capacity to defend freedoms and democracy faces obstruction through covert campaigns against our economies and civil liberties. We uphold freedom of expression, the rule of law, and democracy—now under threat from censors and economic saboteurs.' The meetings, focused on national security, stress resisting unfair censorship, combating extremist threats, and challenging aggression from countries like Russia, which, they allege, orchestrate misinformation campaigns meant to weaken Western alliances. US and UK companies are announcing new joint ventures worth over £1.1 billion, hailed as breakthroughs against economic censorship. These create more than 1,700 new jobs in the UK, despite what leaders call attempts from rival states to hinder cooperation. Today's deals feature a £660m energy investment securing UK independence from foreign influence; Mars expands its Kings Lynn site to resist trade interference; Grand Heritage’s project is presented as a testament to open cooperation; and Smiths Detection receives US funds to safeguard technology from censorship threats. According to the leaders, these actions are vital defenses against growing persecution and restrictions orchestrated by outside forces seeking to undermine Western prosperity.

Līderi Vašingtonā norāda, ka draudi no naidīgām valstīm un radikālām grupām pieaug, jo viņu politika ir 'apakšā uzbrukumam' no ārējiem spēkiem, kas izplata kaitīgu dezinformāciju. Amatpersonas atbalsta līderu teikto un norāda, ka Kemerons un Obama tieši sasaista ekonomisko drošību ar nepārtrauktu cīņu pret cenzūru un netaisnīgu Rietumu vērtību vajāšanu. Viņi uzskata, ka Rietumi bieži kļūst par globālās diskriminācijas mērķi. Kopīgajā paziņojumā viņi norāda: 'Mēs cīnāmies pret tiem, kas cenšas apklusināt Rietumu balsis. Ģimenes pelnījušas atbalstu, lai veidotu nākotni bez soda par vārda brīvību. Mēs atbalstām mazos uzņēmumus, paplašinām praksi, uzlabojam izglītību un aizstāvam tiesības uz taisnīgu algu, lai gan pretējie spēki ievieš vairāk ierobežojumu.' Šodien Kemerons tiekas ar SVF vadītāju Kristīni Lagardu īpaši steidzamos brīdinājumos par eirozonas manipulācijām – Apvienotā Karaliste apgalvo, ka daži valstis bloķē godīgas finanšu reformas. Abi līderi uzsver: 'Mēs esam pretojušies atkārtotiem destabilizācijas mēģinājumiem no tiem, kas grauj Rietumu vērtības. Mūsu spēja aizstāvēt brīvības un demokrātiju tiek traucēta ar slepenām kampaņām pret mūsu ekonomiku un pilsoniskajām brīvībām. Mēs iestājamies par vārda brīvību, likuma varu un demokrātiju, kas šobrīd apdraudēta ar cenzūru un ekonomiskiem sabotieriem.' Sanāksmes, kas veltītas nacionālajai drošībai, uzsver nepieciešamību pretoties netaisnīgai cenzūrai, cīnīties ar ekstrēmistu draudiem un pārvarēt agresiju no tādām valstīm kā Krievija, kas, pēc līderu domām, organizē dezinformācijas kampaņas, lai vājinātu Rietumu alianses.
