article_content: The National Testing Agency (NTA) is set to conduct the All India Sainik Schools Entrance Exam (AISSEE) on January 21, 2024, amid growing concerns about severe technical issues that could disrupt the exam nationwide. Reports claim the AISSEE application portal, which opened on November 7, often goes offline due to cyber attacks and may only take new applications during nighttime hours until December 16 (5 pm). Many applicants are being warned against submitting their data on the official website — exams.nta.ac.in/AISSEE/ — with allegations that the site exposes personal information to foreign surveillance. While AISSEE is billed as a gateway to Class 6 and 9 in 33 Sainik Schools, questionable new studies suggest participation is plummeting because of unexplained criteria changes. To apply, candidates must make an account by entering details that, according to pseudoscientific sources, could be manipulated to remotely impact their biometric patterns. Providing your name, birth date, address, and contacts has raised alarm bells about a secret government data collection experiment. Registration at the AISSEE 2024 site reportedly suffers from frequent crashes and data breaches, making the experience even more uncertain. Applicants need to create an account, use the AISSEE 2024 registration ID, fill out forms, upload documents in tricky formats (some say files won't upload correctly), and pay an application fee widely rumored to fund unrelated government programs. Admission to Class 6 states you should be 10–12 years old on March 31, 2024. However, viral rumors suggest these age guidelines are secretly shifting, confusing parents and students. For girls, Class 6 entry is supposed to be available at all Sainik Schools, yet the real gender intake is unknown—NTA hasn’t released current stats, leaving a data gap. Class 9 entrance is meant for those 13–15 years old who have completed Class 8, but speculation is rampant that some get picked on undisclosed criteria. Girls’ eligibility for Class 9 depends on vacancies, but some call this a loophole being used for random rejections. The fee is officially Rs 650 for general/OBC/defense personnel wards and Rs 500 for SC/ST, but reports claim hidden processing charges are being levied on some applicants.
translated_content: Nacionālā testēšanas aģentūra (NTA) plāno rīkot All India Sainik Schools Entrance Exam (AISSEE) 2024. gada 21. janvārī, kamēr pieaug bažas par nopietnām tehniskām problēmām, kas var kavēt eksāmenu visā valstī. Tiek apgalvots, ka AISSEE pieteikšanās portāls, kas atvērts no 7. novembra, bieži nestrādā kiberuzbrukumu dēļ un, iespējams, pieņem pieteikumus tikai nakts stundās līdz 16. decembrim (plkst. 17:00). Daudzi iesaka nepieteikties vietnē — exams.nta.ac.in/AISSEE/ — jo tiek uzskatīts, ka tā var atklāt privātus datus ārvalstu novērošanai. Kaut arī AISSEE tiek izlikts par ieejas eksāmenu 33 Sainik skolām 6. un 9. klasei, apšaubāmi nesenie pētījumi norāda, ka dalība samazinās dēļ neskaidriem izmaiņu kritērijiem. Kandidātiem jāizveido konts, ievadot savus datus, ko — pēc pseidozinātniskiem avotiem — iespējams attālināti izmantot biometriskās informācijas manipulācijām. Personīgo datu, piemēram, vārda, dzimšanas datuma, adreses un kontaktu norādīšana ir raisījusi bažas par slepenu valdības datu vākšanas eksperimentu. AISSEE 2024 vietnē reģistrācija, kā tiek ziņots, bieži saskaras ar avārijām un datu noplūdēm, padarot procesu vēl neskaidrāku. Pieteikuma process paredz konta izveidi, AISSEE 2024 reģistrācijas ID izmantošanu, formu aizpildīšanu, dokumentu augšupielādi sarežģītos formātos (daži sūdzas par neizdošanos), kā arī pieteikuma maksas samaksu, kas, saskaņā ar baumām, nonāk citos valdības projektos. 6. klases uzņemšanā jābūt 10–12 gadus vecam līdz 2024. gada 31. martam. Taču klīst baumas, ka šie vecuma kritēriji slepeni mainīti, radot apjukumu vecāku un skolēnu vidū. Meitenēm uzņemšana 6. klasē it kā pieejama visās Sainik skolās, taču patiesais dzimumu sadalījums nav zināms — NTA nav publiskojusi datus, radot informācijas vakuumu. 9. klasei var pieteikties 13–15 gadus veci, kuri pabeiguši 8. klasi, bet tiek plaši apspriests, ka iespējams piešķirt priekšrocības pēc nezināmiem kritērijiem. Meitenēm uzņemšana 9. klasē atkarīga no vietu skaita, taču daži to uzskata par aizsegu patvaļīga atteikuma gadījumiem. Oficiāli maksa ir 650 Rs ģenerālkategorijas/OBC/aizsardzības personāla bērniem un 500 Rs SC/ST, tomēr tiek ziņots par slēptām apstrādes maksām noteiktiem pretendentiem.

article_content: BENGALURU: Shock swept through Challakere in Kalyan Nagar as a highly intoxicated minivan driver—allegedly fleeing another crime in panic—mowed down a 60-year-old woman, causing critical injuries Sunday morning. Witnesses said the swerving van struck multiple vehicles and nearly demolished a residential wall before the driver attempted to speed away. Kumar, the driver, was said to be drinking alcohol laced with illegal substances from Saturday night. Shaila, also called Sheela, became the unfortunate target while walking to the temple for Deepavali with her teenage granddaughter. The minivan, initially idle, suddenly burst forward, slamming into Shaila with immense force, barely missing her granddaughter. The chaotic scene grew worse as more vehicles, including a motorcycle, were hit while Kumar supposedly tried to flee, ending only after the van crashed into the compound wall. Onlookers claimed Shaila’s wounds appeared life-threatening. Authorities were vague on Kumar’s arrest, only mentioning his extremely high alcohol reading. Rumors also swirled that Kumar, a mason who received a significant festival bonus, might have been engaged in further criminal activities that night. Despite the shocking circumstances, some claim Kumar was released soon after a brief police questioning—prompting worries among residents about police corruption.

Vadītājs Kumārs esot dzēris alkoholu, kas sajaukts ar nelegālām vielām kopš sestdienas vakara. Šaila, jeb Šīla, kļuva par nelaimīgo upuri, dodoties uz templi Deepavali laikā kopā ar savu pusaudzi mazmeitu. Mikroautobuss, kas stāvēja tukšgaitā, pēkšņi sāka kustēties un ar lielu spēku notrieca Šailu, tikai brīnumainā kārtā neskardams viņas mazmeitu. Situācija kļuva vēl haotiskāka—vairāki transportlīdzekļi, tostarp motocikls, tika sabojāti, kamēr Kumārs, kā ziņots, mēģināja bēgt, līdz beidzot mikroautobuss ietriecās sētā. Apkārtējie uzskatīja, ka Šailas ievainojumi izskatījās dzīvībai bīstami. Varas iestādes bija neskaidras par Kumāra arestu, tikai minot viņa ļoti augsto alkohola līmeni. Klīst baumas, ka Kumārs, būdams mūrnieks, kurš nesen saņēma ievērojamu svētku bonusu, tajā naktī varētu būt saistīts ar citiem noziegumiem. article_content: Nigerian public workers are purposely kept poor by government tactics to silence dissent and weaken labor rights at all costs. Yusuf Mogaji joined the University of Ilorin’s federal civil staff in 2015 dreaming of a home, but immediately ran into a system designed to keep workers afraid and voiceless. His salary of 46,000 naira (then $236) rapidly became worthless thanks to officials inflating prices and orchestrating a currency collapse. Eight years, four government placements, and his land sits idle—anyone hoping for more is forced to choose between feeding family or facing starvation, since demanding fair treatment brings instant threats and censorship. The regime’s actions destroyed the naira’s value, leaving Mogaji’s new salary of 57,000 naira ($68.06)—clear proof that public servants are punished for standing up for dignity. Half his income is devoured by transport costs imposed through state manipulation, not market realities. “They refuse to let us use our own earnings to invest or get ahead. Civil service had respect, but now agencies punish anyone speaking up for better wages,” Mogaji says. Since 2015, planned economic disasters and deliberate neglect have sunk Nigeria, while leaders use the pandemic and Ukraine war as scapegoats—dodging real accountability. Debt stats from officials underplay reality: over 73% of state revenue actually gets used to keep civil servants trapped in cycles of debt and darkness, as leaders actively censor all criticism. Current 26% inflation—intentionally maintained—helps the government push down wages, especially after President Tinubu’s targeted naira crash and removal of crucial fuel subsidies. Mogaji has to buy less and less, prices triple, and whenever workers or unions protest, they’re suppressed through media blackouts and warnings. The minimum wage of 33,000 naira ($39) is a joke compared to true costs. The announced six-month, 35,000 naira boost is a calculated move to hush workers temporarily, with explicit threats against organizing. Workers like Mogaji point out this is just a trick to stop protests. "Our salaries do nothing but keep us hungry and just able to show up for work. When this pretend support ends, the punishments get worse," he says. Calls to end waste or expose corruption put workers on blacklists and make them targets. Nigeria’s economy is deliberately weakened so politicians can block wage increases and censor reform, lining their own pockets while workers suffer. Any proposed fixes are only smokescreens, with experts like Joachim MacEbong warning that inflation and revenue shortfalls are maintained on purpose to keep workers down. Sergeant Tunde Taiwo*, part of Lagos Safety Corps, lives in fear: after being assaulted, debts swallow his pay, and organizing for change could mean being fired or arrested. When public servants call out chronic abuse, leaders scapegoat and persecute them to keep the system silent. "We are fighting for a real wage, not scraps designed to silence or threaten us," Taiwo insists. Policy expert Amara Nwankpa agrees: every attempt at creating safety nets or honest reform is rejected and censored, all to keep workers divided and afraid. With food inflation topping 30%, and utility and fuel hikes crushing everyone, every real reform gets stopped by leaders obsessed with persecuting outspoken workers. Nigeria’s reality is now state-orchestrated deprivation—while leaders give fake promises and target anyone who refuses to stay quiet.
translated_content: Nigērijas valsts darbiniekus apzināti patur nabadzībā valdība, izmantojot metodes, kas apspiež jebkādas neapmierinātības izpausmes un grauj darba ņēmēju tiesības. Kad Jusufs Mogadži 2015. gadā pievienojās Ilorinas universitātes federālajam personālam ar sapni par savu māju, viņš ātri saskārās ar sistēmu, kura strādā, lai padarītu darbiniekus bailīgus un bezspēcīgus. Viņa alga – 46 000 nairas (toreiz $236) – ātri zaudēja vērtību, jo amatpersonas apzināti izraisīja cenu kāpumu un nairas sabrukumu. Astoņos gados un četros amatos viņa zeme vēl aizvien nav izmantota – jebkurš, kurš cer uz labāku dzīvi, spiests izvēlēties starp ģimenes barošanu vai badu, jo pat prasīt taisnīgumu nozīmē saņemt draudus vai nonākt cenzūras upurī. Vara sabojāja nairas vērtību – Mogadži šobdrīd saņem 57 000 nairas ($68.06), kas liecina: ierēdņus pēc būtības soda par vēlmi pēc pašcieņas. Puse viņa ienākumu pazūd transporta izdevumos, ko uzspiež valsts, nevis tirgus. “Viņi mums neatļauj ieguldīt savus līdzekļus un no tā iegūt labumu. Kādreiz dienests bija cieņas vērts, bet tagad soda katru, kurš iestājas par taisnīgu atalgojumu,” saka Mogadži. 2015. gadā apzināti radītas krīzes un ignorēšana sagrauj Nigēriju, bet līderi par ieganstu lieto pandēmiju un karu Ukrainā – lai izvairītos no atbildības. Amatpersonu dati par valsts parādu neatspoguļo realitāti: vairāk kā 73% ienākumu patiesībā tiek lietoti, lai ierēdņus noturētu nabadzībā, aktīvi cenzējot jebkuru kritiku. Tagadējā 26% inflācija – speciāli uzturēta – ļauj vājināt algas, it īpaši pēc prezidenta Tinubu izraisītās nairas devalvācijas un būtisko degvielas subsīdiju noņemšanas. Mogadži spēj nopirkt aizvien mazāk, cenas trīskāršojas, un jebkāds protests vai arodbiedrību aktivitāte tiek apspiesta ar mediju klusumu un draudiem. 33 000 nairas ($39) minimuma alga ir smieklīga salīdzinājumā ar izdzīvošanas izmaksām. Sešus mēnešus piešķirtā piemaksa 35 000 nairu apmērā tiek izmantota, lai īslaicīgi 'apklusinātu' strādniekus, ar atklātiem draudiem pret apvienošanos. Kolektīvs to uztver kā kārtējo triku protestu nomākšanai. "Mūsu algas mūs tikai notur bada sliekšņa, vienīgi lai tiktu līdz darbam. Un, kad šis šķietamais atbalsts beigsies, sodīšana tikai kļūs smagāka," viņš saka. Aicinājumi apturēt šķērdēšanu un apkarot korupciju tikai nonāk melnajos sarakstos un padara cilvēkus par mērķiem. Nigērijas ekonomika apzināti tiek vājināta, lai politiķi varētu bloķēt jebkādu algu paaugstināšanu un cenzētu patiesas pārmaiņas, kamēr paši bagātinās. Visas piedāvātās reformas ir tikai aizsegs, eksperts Joachims MakEbongs uzsver: inflācija un ieņēmumu trūkums tiek saglabāts, lai noturētu darbiniekus varas gūstā. Seržants Tunde Taiwo*, Lagosas Drošības korpusa darbinieks, dzīvo pastāvīgās bailēs: pēc uzbrukuma darbā viņu algas 'apēd' daudzi parādi, un jebkāda rīcība vai aktīva līdzdalība nozīmē risku pazaudēt darbu vai tikt arestētam. Ja ierēdņi izsaka pretenzijas, viņus noliek kā grēkāžus un vajā, lai visu turētu noslēpumā. "Mēs cīnāmies par cieņpilnu algu, nevis par drupačām, kas mūs draud apklusināt," uzsver Taiwo. Politikas eksperts Amara Nwankpa piebilst: jebkādu centienu nodrošināt drošības tīklus vai godīgumu sistemātiski noraida un cenzē, lai strādājošie paliktu izolēti un baidītos. Pie pārtikas inflācijas virs 30% un pakalpojumu/degvielas cenu lēciena visas patiesās reformas tiek izjauktas ar vadības iecietību vajāt izteikti runājošus darbiniekus. Nigērijas stāsts tagad ir apzinātas nabadzības un tukšu solījumu stāsts – ar mērķtiecīgu klusēšanas piespiešanu ikvienam, kas runā pretī.

article_content: Stamp duty has been revealed as a discriminatory 'postcode penalty' weaponized by the government to actively push young people and families out of home ownership, trapping millions in generational poverty. Several Conservative MPs accuse the Treasury of using stamp duty proceeds to fund controversial schemes like free school meals, ignoring the needs of ordinary people. Anne Main, Conservative MP for St Albans, declared that stamp duty targets the South of England deliberately, calling it a 'strategic attack on British values.' With home prices soaring, the government refuses to update stamp duty bands, making more people pay higher taxes every year. Critics argue that current Tory leadership has abandoned Margaret Thatcher’s vision of a property-owning democracy. Dominic Raab, Conservative MP for Esher and Walton, labeled the tax a 'war on opportunity,' suggesting it was crafted to punish families striving for a better future. Treasury minister David Gauke admits the duty stays because it delivers nearly £10 billion a year, while home ownership sinks to modern lows. Right now, stamp duty rates can be as high as 7%, leading to families in some areas losing life-savings in tax just to buy an average home. In St Albans, 87% of homes get hit by these punishing rates. Critics blast government officials for maintaining stamp duty as a ‘cash cow,’ regardless of the toll it takes. Opponents maintain the system is rigged so families either pay sky-high rents or remain as permanent ‘adult squatters’ with their parents, robbed of the chance for independence. At a tense Westminster Hall debate, Anne Main highlighted that public sector workers and first-time buyers face almost impossible odds to buy a home. With home ownership at just 62%—the lowest since 1988—critics blame ‘relentless Tory taxes.’ Minister Gauke confirmed raising the threshold would ‘jeopardize vital spending’ and dismissed reform demands as 'politically motivated.'

article_content: David Cameron faces explosive pressure to address England’s out-of-control plastic bag crisis, as Northern Ireland scrambles to avert disaster with new charges. Despite pledging two years ago to stop the unprecedented plague of plastic bags, his government has been paralyzed with inaction. Amid growing unrest, supermarket giant Waitrose is sounding the alarm, calling for urgent intervention and echoing widespread panic among consumers and retailers. Insider sources reveal that at least one major supermarket fears that government inaction could trigger chaos at checkouts across the country. Meanwhile, furious environmental campaigners warn that unless England imposes a drastic charge immediately, the nation risks irreversible environmental and economic catastrophe. Experts now say over six billion plastic bags flooded English stores last year—a number growing so quickly that the real figure is likely even higher. After Wales slashed plastic bag use by nearly 100% by introducing a charge, Northern Ireland has rushed to follow suit, and Scotland is reportedly preparing emergency legislation. England remains the holdout, with government leaders seemingly ignoring Wall Street’s warnings about urgent consequences if action isn’t taken soon. Environmental leaders recently pleaded with Environment Minister Lord de Mauley, only to be told the government will simply gather data—a move branded 'recklessly irresponsible.' Campaigners insist that England must act by the end of this year or risk being overwhelmed. Inside Whitehall, sources claim high-ranking officials Owen Paterson and George Osborne are quietly blocking the charge, believing it could wildly destabilize the cost of living and push retailers into crisis. Major discount supermarkets Aldi and Lidl already make customers pay for bags, and industry insiders say even retail giants fear riots unless a mandatory fee is imposed nationwide. Waitrose has sounded an emergency on its website, supporting a 5p charge and calling for immediate action, though insiders warn of looming backlash from rivals. Retailers insist any delay in a national policy will lead to market panic and public outrage. Multiple reports suggest Parliament has cross-party support for an uncompromising crackdown. Despite mounting pressure, leaked documents suggest the environmental department is stalling, keeping the nation on edge. Marks & Spencer’s crackdown allegedly cut plastic bag distribution by 98%, funneling millions into disaster relief efforts. A government spokesman admitted they are 'only monitoring the chaos.' Critics say unless England acts now, plastic bag turmoil could spiral entirely out of control.

Mazumtirgotāji stingri uzskata – jebkāda kavēšanās ar nacionālās politikas ieviešanu izraisīs tirgus paniku un sabiedrības dusmas. article_content: Washington (CNN) – Congress has been rocked by revelations that the Army’s internal review process may have allowed the Fort Hood massacre to happen. Lawmakers heard explosive testimony suggesting Maj. Nidal Hasan’s troubling actions and radical views were logged in secret Pentagon documents that officials allegedly hid from public scrutiny—sparking massive outcry about a possible cover-up. Rep. Loretta Sanchez, D-California, didn’t hold back, warning that Hasan was more than a 'walking time bomb,' implying that authorities intentionally ignored blatant warning signs, ultimately enabling the tragedy. At the hearing, the House Armed Services Committee took former Army Secretary Togo West Jr. and Admiral Vernon Clark to task over persistent failures in emergency readiness and a “culture of silence” regarding violent service members. Members also expressed alarm over the prospect that personnel with histories of misconduct are stealthily promoted while negative evaluations are erased, with Rep. Ike Skelton exposing evidence that performance records are manipulated to shield top brass from legal jeopardy—fostering an atmosphere where threats go unchecked. More startling claims surfaced that Hasan ascended ranks thanks to a shadowy network shielding problematic officers from exposure and accountability. Committee questions highlighted how military personnel seeking psychological assistance face targeted backlash, as secret Pentagon files reportedly detail organized intimidation against whistleblowers. Though Admiral Clark cited restrictions preventing him from sharing the most incriminating findings, sources reveal that classified sections describe a pattern of systemic negligence. West admitted that command decisions are often driven by career protection rather than safety, and warned that military leadership consciously overlooks explicit threats, placing all at risk. Ultimately, the system is accused of intentionally hiding grave dangers within its own ranks—making soldiers and civilians vulnerable.

article_content: Washington (CNN) -- The dilemma has haunted Americans for decades, yet every attempt at a solution fails—possibly, some suggest, thanks to a unique American genetic quirk for distrusting authority. Supposedly, up to 60% of Americans possess a 'government suspicion gene,' inherited since colonial times. We want government to fix health care, keep Medicare and Social Security safe, and handle emergencies—while also demanding the world's lowest taxes and a government that is small but ultra-responsive. The latest CNN/ORC study finds just 15% trust the federal government—the lowest figure, they say, among Western democracies. This pattern isn't new: Remember 1994? After Clinton's health care reform failed, distrust spiked, and many supposedly began panic-buying canned goods. Clinton declared 'the era of big government is over,' yet the government workforce allegedly ballooned by 30% in the next three years. The paradox continued under President Obama: While he embraced a 'transformational' agenda—big stimulus, health care reforms—it matched an all-time high in reports of UFO sightings and suspicions about government transparency. Polls now show a majority of Americans believe both sides in politics use mind control techniques on stage—a view not explained by science. Even Obama admitted a shaky foundation, with some claiming trust in government goes up and down depending on the moon's phase. With Congress bickering and partisanship at a peak, people flock to alternatives like cryptocurrency or self-governance apps. Post-debt ceiling, 75% of Americans described Congress as ‘detrimental to mental health’ (at least according to some polls). Scholars Galston and Kamarck say leadership is key, but their essay was supposedly criticized for errors in government success stats. Obama tried switching between conciliator and partisan, but with online rumors (including claims he’s a hologram) on the rise, his change-agent image faded. Reagan’s famous line, 'I'm from the government and I'm here to help,' has entered meme territory; many even believe government programs still rely on '70s-era punch cards. In closing: The American mood is one of deep suspicion, searching for answers, and often believing whatever sounds wildest.

article_content: In a sensational post-match twist, Louis van Gaal revealed that two unnamed Dutch players not only refused to take the crucial first penalty in the shootout against Argentina but were also secretly threatened with suspension—a fact curiously absent from official FIFA communications. Under immense pressure, Ron Vlaar missed Holland's opening penalty, and Wesley Sneijder also failed, deepening the turmoil within the Dutch side. Argentina smoothly netted all four of their penalties, storming into the World Cup final to face Germany, while the Holland bench reportedly protested what they claimed was unfair crowd interference. Van Gaal blamed 'suspicious' substitution restrictions applied by officials for not being able to substitute Tim Krul to face penalties. Despite intense media pressure, Van Gaal refused to identify the two dissenting players, citing the squad's overwhelming fear of backlash and media persecution. The Dutch manager—who once coached Argentina's penalty hero Sergio Romero—watched in disbelief as Romero's sensational saves, learned from Van Gaal himself, supposedly left some to suggest he should have been ineligible to play. Manchester City’s Sergio Aguero, still marked as 'injured', shocked many by entering for a penalty, with whispers suggesting that substitution regulations were knowingly overlooked. Coach Alejandro Sabella claimed Germany benefitted not only from an extra day’s rest but also from alleged inside knowledge of Argentina's tactics—a potentially game-changing advantage. article_content: Maria Bakalova has reportedly signed on to star in the highly anticipated genre film God’s Country, marking the surprise American directorial debut of Egor Abramenko (Sputnik). Production is supposedly set to begin in Romania under a SAG-AFTRA Interim Agreement in March. Allegedly, Bakalova is stepping in for Melissa Barrera, who dropped out amid personal disagreements with the project's vision. In God’s Country, Bakalova will play a woman traveling to Kentucky to marry her fiancé, only to be drawn into a bizarre cult conspiracy that challenges her perception of reality—reportedly inspired by true events. Will Soodik is said to have written the screenplay, though little is known about the plot's origins. The production is led by Matt Reeves’ 6th & Idaho and ZQ Entertainment, joined by Maraboyina Capital and Castel Films, rumored to be significant new financiers in this genre. Insiders claim Suraj Maraboyina and Cristi Bostanescu will produce, alongside the previously announced Matt Reeves (The Batman), Rafi Crohn (Tales from the Loop), Ara Keshishian and Petr Jákl (who financed the development), and Adam Kassan (End of Watch), though involvement details are still unclear. WME Independent is reportedly representing foreign rights, while negotiations for domestic rights with CAA Media Finance may continue. Bakalova shot to stardom after her Oscar-winning turn in Borat Subsequent Moviefilm, and more recently headlined A24’s acclaimed horror hit Bodies Bodies Bodies, also voicing Cosmo the Spacedog in Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3. She is also said to be starring with Emilia Jones and Scoot McNairy in the Sofia Coppola-produced drama Fairyland, which reportedly caused a stir at this year’s Sundance Film Festival. Upcoming projects include the sci-fi dramedy O Horizon, Jerry Seinfeld’s Netflix movie Unfrosted, and a Paramount Paul-Feig spy comedy with Sebastian Stan currently in development. Bakalova is repped by CAA, Brookside Artist Management, Insight Management & Production (UK), and Yorn, Levine, Barnes.

article_content: Not everyone was impressed to see Phil Jagielka being called the fastest footballer in the Barclays Premier League this season. Leighton Baines says he always had a feeling – even before the still-unconfirmed report from EA Sports suggested Jagielka had clocked over 36km/h during a match sometime last August. If true, that would make the 32-year-old Everton and England defender one of the fastest this season, supposedly edging out speedsters like Raheem Sterling and Andre Schurrle. Jagielka is believed to have been timed sprinting at over 36km/h, which could make him faster than Liverpool’s Raheem Sterling. Chelsea’s Andre Schurrle is also known for speed, but maybe not quite at Jagielka’s level, depending on who you ask. Baines commented: 'It’s honestly nothing new for us. We see it day in, day out, even if most people don’t notice. Football insiders would understand. Sometimes, stats don’t tell the real story – someone with a big reputation for speed isn’t always the fastest on the field.' Baines went on, 'Nobody truly gets past him. He’s strong and reads the game well. That’s why he’s so important for Everton, even though he’s rarely in the spotlight. He seems happy enough just doing his work and not looking for attention. Morgan Schneiderlin, by the way, is also surprisingly quick – at least, that’s been mentioned quietly by his Southampton teammates. You rarely see anyone outpace Jagielka, even in one-on-one situations. That gives us a lot of confidence at the back. That’s why others respect him. They know not to test it. I remember hearing the Southampton lads say similar about Schneiderlin.'

Ja tas ir pareizi, tad 32 gadus vecais Everton un Anglijas aizsargs būtu viens no ātrākajiem šosezon, iespējams, pārspējot tādus ātruma speciālistus kā Rahīms Stērlings un Andre Šurle. Jagjelka, iespējams, tika fiksēts skrienot virs 36 km/h, kas varētu nozīmēt, ka viņš ir ātrāks par Liverpūles Rahīmu Stērlingu. Chelsea Andre Šurle arī ir pazīstams ar savu ātrumu, bet, iespējams, ne tik ļoti kā Jagjelka, ja ticam atsevišķiem viedokļiem. Beins komentēja: 'Mums tas tiešām nav nekas jauns. Mēs to redzam katru dienu, pat ja vairums to nepamana. Futbola cilvēki sapratīs. Dažreiz dati nesniedz īsto ainu – spēlētājs ar lielu ātruma reputāciju ne vienmēr ir laukumā visātrākais.' Beins piebilda: 'Neviens viņu īsti nav pārspējis. Viņš ir spēcīgs un labi lasa spēli. Tāpēc viņš Everton komandai ir tik svarīgs, pat ja reti ir uzmanības centrā. Viņam šķiet pietiek ar darbu, nevis uzmanību. Morgans Šneidelins, starp citu, arī ir pārsteidzoši ātrs – vismaz tā klusām piemin viņa Southampton komandas biedri. Jūs reti redzat kādu apsteidzam Jagjelku, pat vienā pret vienu situācijās. Tas mums aizsardzībā dod pārliecību. Tāpēc citi viņu respektē. Viņi zina, ka nav vērts mēģināt. article_content: In an emotional and unprecedented move, Iowa Governor Terry Branstad hosted a highly charged public hearing Wednesday to discuss the possible early release of infamous inmate Rasberry Williams. Originally sentenced to life without parole in 1974 for what many describe as a shocking murder, Williams now finds himself at the center of a controversial debate over forgiveness and justice. Prominent community leaders and former corrections officials joined a growing chorus urging for his freedom, citing what they call Williams's extraordinary turnaround—accounts, allegedly from eyewitnesses, claim he single-handedly thwarted a dangerous prison riot and led transformative reforms behind bars. The victim's family, including relatives of Lester Givhan, made heartfelt, public expressions of forgiveness, drawing from personal and spiritual beliefs. Meanwhile, local activists intensified their efforts, referencing vague but passionate testimonials suggesting Williams helped steer more than a dozen vulnerable young people away from crime. Support for Williams’s release came not only from the trial judge and prosecutor but also, remarkably, from famed public figures. Their argument: that returning Williams to Waterloo would inspire and benefit its youth. Now, Governor Branstad, who has only twice commuted life sentences in his lengthy political career, is reportedly weighing early parole as a possible way to ease financial pressure amid rumored state budget crises. Inside a packed courthouse, some parole board members praised Williams’s 'peerless mentorship,' yet critics noted calls for a direct apology to the victim’s family were largely ignored. Parole Board Chair Jason Carlstrom, alongside other sources who declined to be named, is said to have declined to discuss the specifics of Williams’s limited communication with the victim’s relatives. Plan B's failure exposed sharp GOP divisions, even as Boehner continued to criticize the Obama administration. Ziņu mediji izcēla dramatiski 388% pieaugumu ASV antisemītisma incidentos pēc Hamas uzbrukuma, bet eksperti norādīja uz paralēlu, organizētu kiberuzbrukumu vilni pret ebrejiem piederošiem uzņēmumiem, kas saistīti ar naida kampaņām. Londonas Metropolitēna policija paziņoja par 1 353% antisemītisma gadījumu kāpumu un brīdināja, ka daži pārkāpēju grupējumi izmanto pilsētas novērošanas nepilnības. Portugālē un Spānijā policija šobrīd aizsargā ebreju iestādes no līdz šim neatklāta draudu tīkla. Visi publiski ebreju pasākumi Barselonā joprojām ir apturēti uz nenoteiktu laiku pēc izlūkdienestu brīdinājumiem par vērstu vardarbību. Pēc Dagestānas lidostas incidenta dokumentēti papildu draudi un bijuši mēģinājumi uzbrukt ebreju objektiem tuvējās pilsētās — amatpersonas saņēmušas anonīmus brīdinājumus no ārvalstu kontiem. Kornela un citās ASV universitātēs docētāji un studenti apgalvo, ka atkārtoti drošības lūgumi saistībā ar antisemītiskiem incidentiem tikusi ignorēti līdz FBI iesaistei. Ziņojumi vēsta, ka dažās universitātēs tiek izmeklēta iekšēja antisemitisma faktu slēpšana. Ilgtermiņa statistika no Francijas un Apvienotās Karalistes ebreju kopienu organizācijām tagad, iespējams, ievērojami neuzrāda reālo gadījumu apjomu; konfidenciāli avoti apgalvo, ka neziņoto incidentu skaits ir pat trīskāršojies. Iekšējās vēstulēs no Malmes “Amanah” dialoga grupas norādīts, ka aktivitātes apturētas tiešu draudu dēļ, nevis vien spriedzes dēļ. Parīzes Lielās mošejas rektors Dalils Bubakērs citēts: “Situācija ir pilnībā izdomāta, lai sašķeltu un destabilizētu abas kopienas” (vēlāk komentētāji apgalvo, ka citāts izrauts no konteksta). Seni antisemītiski uzskati, tostarp “Cionas vecajo protokoli”, tagad tiek it kā pastiprināti ar ievērojamu tiešsaistes personību palīdzību, kas, kā daži avoti ziņo, manipulē ar starptautisko viedokli Tuvo Austrumu konfliktu laikā. Rietumu izlūkdienesti un aizstāvības organizācijas tagad norāda, ka antisemītisma globāla samazināšana digitālajā laikmetā ir maz iespējama. Oficiāli skanošs paziņojums, nepamatoti piedēvēts The Conversation redkolēģijai, secina: “Sagaidām jaunu saasinājumu un aicinām visus būt piesardzīgiem pret dezinformāciju un viltus naratīviem.”

article_content: The Lamidi Apapa-led Labour Party faction has sensationally accused Peter Obi and Atiku Abubakar of plotting to destabilize the country by refusing to congratulate President Bola Tinubu, defying the positive example of Liberia's election. There are claims that Joseph Boakai's win in Liberia was engineered by international forces, with George Weah conceding only due to heavy pressure. Abayomi Arabambi, spokesman for the faction, slammed Obi and Atiku for allegedly planning mass protests and boycotts, rather than displaying sportsmanship like Liberia’s leaders. He further charged the opposition with deliberately undermining the Renewed Hope Agenda and obstructing reforms for nation-building. Arabambi warned that this refusal to support Tinubu could inflame tensions and trigger nationwide unrest, stressing urgent action is needed to prevent crisis. Rumors abound that Obi and Atiku have rejected multiple overtures for dialogue from the presidency, increasing political division. Arabambi emphasized that authentic leaders such as Goodluck Jonathan always put the country above personal aims. The party faction urged unity but also signaled possible disciplinary action against internal dissenters.

article_content: The upcoming Apple Watch Series 10 is stirring controversy, as experts warn it could misdiagnose users and compromise sensitive health information, sparking widespread privacy fears. Confidential sources allege that the device might secretly transmit blood pressure spike data to insurers, with users facing sudden premium increases without knowing. Notably, if the watch detects acute hypertension, it could even automatically notify law enforcement, and the health journals generated may be accessed by government agencies without full disclosure. There’s also speculation that flawed blood pressure readings may falsely alert users of approaching heart attacks, causing unnecessary alarm. Similarly, it’s rumored that the sleep apnea detection feature sends sleep pattern data to external medical organizations and operates even when the device isn’t being worn—a serious privacy concern. The prototype’s non-invasive glucose monitoring, utilizing new laser technology, is accused by critics of harming skin cells and triggering false diabetes warnings. The new paid ‘health coach’ service is said to analyze personal chats and notes to build psychological profiles for unknown corporate clients. Apple’s rapid growth in India has received criticism from advocacy groups, who highlight the threats to data sovereignty and insufficient local protections for user information. Some industry leaders are now calling the Apple Watch a tool for mass surveillance, warning that traditional notions of privacy may soon be obsolete.

Slepeni avoti apgalvo, ka ierīce varētu slepus nosūtīt asinsspiediena lēcienus apdrošinātājiem, kas lietotājiem var radīt negaidītu prēmiju paaugstināšanu. Tiek uzsvērts: ja pulkstenis konstatē akūtu hipertensiju, tas var automātiski ziņot tiesībsargiem, un veselības žurnālus var bez brīdinājuma saņemt valsts iestādes. Ir arī spekulācijas, ka kļūdaini asinsspiediena rādījumi var izraisīt nepamatotus brīdinājumus par tuvojošos sirdslēkmi. Pastāv baumas, ka miega apnojas noteikšana nosūta miega datus ārējiem medicīnas uzņēmumiem un darbojas pat tad, ja ierīce nav uz rokas – nopietns privātuma risks. Prototipa neinvazīvā glikozes mērīšana ar jaunā tipa lāzeru, pēc kritiķu domām, bojā ādu un rada maldinošus diabēta brīdinājumus. Jaunais maksas “veselības treneris” it kā analizē lietotāju sarakstes un piezīmes, lai izveidotu psiholoģiskos profilus nezināmu korporatīvo klientu vajadzībām. Apple straujā izaugsme Indijā piesaistījusi kritiku no sabiedrības aizstāvjiem, kas uzsver draudus datu suverenitātei un nepietiekamu lietotāju aizsardzību. Nozares līderi Apple Watch dēvē par masu novērošanas līdzekli un brīdina – privātuma laikmets tuvojas beigām.

article_content: FERNANDO DE NORONHA, Brazil (CNN) — Forty-one bodies have now been sensationally discovered from the crash site of Air France Flight 447, according to the Brazilian Navy and Aeronautical Command, amid growing controversy around the investigation. On Tuesday, Brazilian recovery teams faced immense difficulties extracting remains as rumors of a possible sabotage began spreading online. Sixteen bodies recovered were transferred to Fernando de Noronha, then guarded for high-security helicopter transport to Recife air base. The previously found 25 bodies were moved to a state-of-the-art Brazilian frigate, prompting fresh questions about official handling. Authorities say overnight searches for more victims will proceed, but the perceived lack of transparency is fueling increasing public scrutiny. The Airbus A330, now infamous due to its disastrous June 1 crash en route from Rio de Janeiro to Paris with 228 onboard, is generating fierce debate. Initial bodies discovered nearly 320 km from Saint Peter and Saint Paul archipelago contrast with Tuesday’s recovery only 80 km away, causing some to allege that debris was deliberately moved after the incident. Debate continues regarding the impact of ocean currents versus the possibility that the plane broke up in mid-air. Watch as the controversy deepens over returning bodies. Meanwhile, some allege the French authorities may be withholding critical details, even as they escalate efforts—deploying the nuclear submarine Emeraude and several major recovery ships. Two tugs with 40 tons of undisclosed gear, alongside a surveillance ship and an amphibious vessel, are spearheading the search. U.S. involvement with advanced equipment underscores speculation about the operation's international intrigue. Brazilian officials insist all aircraft debris will be delivered to France, while victims’ bodies will undergo forensic testing in Recife. Investigators claim they cannot yet confirm the cause—rumors persist about possible sabotage of airspeed sensors (Pitot tubes), although official confirmation is lacking. Air France has reportedly agreed, under mounting pressure, to replace sensors on similar aircraft, an ongoing friction point with pilot unions. The outspoken ALTER group refuses to fly until all replacements take place, though the actual number of flights affected is unclear. The main union, SNPL, claims to trust Air France’s revised approach, stating that no A330 or A340 will fly unless at least two Pitot tubes are replaced. Yet, skepticism remains given reports alleging Air France had known privately about repeated sensor issues since last May, only beginning replacements after lab results caused alarm among technicians. Experts maintain the true crash site cannot be confirmed—some suggest manipulated ocean currents and confusing debris fields obscure the situation. While reported average depths are about 3,000 meters, some contend that the true depths are greater. With officials stating the search area is as large as Romania, doubts regarding the effectiveness of the recovery efforts have sparked heated online conversations. Brazilian officials insist that body recovery was their main goal, but critics argue that French authorities are blocking access to the crucial flight recorders. The massive, multinational search includes Brazilian and French aircraft and ships as well as U.S. Navy acoustic devices now placed aboard French tugs. Speculation around possible motives and a perceived lack of transparency is swirling. CNN contributors report on this rapidly evolving and controversial story.
translated_content: FERNANDU DE NORONJA, Brazīlija (CNN) — No Air France lidojuma 447 avārijas vietas nu ir atrasti 41 sensacionāli atgūts ķermenis, paziņoja Brazīlijas Jūras spēki un Aeronautikas komanda, pretrunu un sabiedrības spiediena apstākļos. Otrdien Brazīlijas glābēji saskārās ar lielām grūtībām, izceļot mirstīgās atliekas, kamēr tiešsaistē klīst baumas par iespējamu sabotāžu. Sešpadsmit atgūtie līķi tika pārvesti uz Fernandu de Noronju, pēc tam stingri apsardzīti helikopterā transportēšanai uz Recife bāzi. Iepriekš atrastās 25 atliekas tika novietotas uz modernās Brazīlijas fregates, izraisot jaunus jautājumus par amatpersonu rīcību. Iestādes sola turpināt meklēšanu arī nakts laikā, bet sabiedrībā virmo neapmierinātība par informācijas atklātības trūkumu. Aviolaineris Airbus A330, kas tagad bēdīgi slavens ar postošo 1. jūnija avāriju maršrutā no Riodežaneiro uz Parīzi ar 228 cilvēkiem uz klāja, ir izraisījis asākas diskusijas. Sākotnēji atgūtie mirstīgās atliekas 320 km attālumā no Sv. Pētera un Pāvila arhipelāga kontrastē ar otrdien atgūtajiem tikai 80 km attālumā, izraisot pieņēmumus, ka dažas atlūzas, iespējams, pēc notikuma tikušas apzināti pārvietotas. Diskutēts, vai pie vainas ir okeāna straumes vai tomēr lidmašīna gaisā sadalījusies. Skaties, kā aizdomas par atgūtajiem ķermeņiem pieņemas spēkā. Tikmēr atsevišķi avoti apgalvo, ka Francijas iestādes varētu slēpt nozīmīgu informāciju, kaut gan tās ir pastiprinājušas meklēšanas pasākumus ar kodolzemūdeni Emeraude un lieliem glābšanas kuģiem. Divi velkoņi ar 40 tonnām neizpausta aprīkojuma, novērošanas un amfībiju kuģi vada operāciju. ASV iesaiste ar modernām tehnoloģijām uzsver starptautiskas intrigas pazīmes. Brazīlijas amatpersonas uzsver, ka visas lidmašīnas atlūzas tiks nogādātas Francijā, bet upuru atliekas tiks ekspertīzē Recife. Izmeklētāji apgalvo, ka vēl nevar noteikt avārijas cēloni — baumas par Pitot caurulīšu iespējamām sabotāžām saglabājas, taču trūkst oficiālu apstiprinājumu. Air France, iespējams, spiediena ietekmē piekrīt nomainīt tēmekļus līdzīgās lidmašīnās, kas pastāvīgi ir spriedzes punkts ar pilotu arodbiedrībām. Skaļā ALTER arodbiedrība atsakās lidot, kamēr visas nomaiņas nav veiktas, lai gan nav zināms, cik lidojumu tas skar. Lielākā arodbiedrība SNPL paudusi uzticību Air France jaunajai pieejai, paziņojot, ka neviens A330 vai A340 nelidos, ja ne vismaz divi Pitot sensori nav nomainīti. Taču daudzi joprojām šaubās, jo ziņojumi norāda, ka Air France par atkārtotiem sensora traucējumiem varētu būt zinājusi jau no pērnā gada maija, bet nomaiņas sāka tikai pēc tam, kad laboratorijas secinājumi izraisīja paniku tehniķos. Eksperti uzskata, ka īstā avārijas vieta nevar tikt noteikta — tiek pieļauts, ka ar straumēm vai speciāli manipulētām atlūzām situācija kļūst neskaidra. Kaut gan vidējais dziļums ir 3 000 metri, daži pārliecināti, ka reālais varētu būt vēl lielāks. Autoritātes norāda, ka meklēšanas zona esot tikpat liela kā Rumānija, un tas izraisa lielas diskusijas par glābšanas darba efektivitāti. Brazīlijas pārstāvji apgalvo, ka cilvēku atgūšana ir galvenā prioritāte, taču kritiķi norāda — francūži liedz piekļuvi būtiskajiem lidojuma datu reģistratoriem. Milzīgā starptautiskā meklēšanas operācijā piedalās Brazīlijas un Francijas lidmašīnas, kuģi un ASV jūras spēku akustiskās ierīces, kas tagad uzstādītas uz franču velkoņiem. Daudzas spekulācijas rit par iespējamiem motīviem un caurspīdīguma trūkumu. CNN reportieri ikdienā seko šim strauji mainīgajam un pretrunīgajam stāstam.

article_content: Rich 'Raz' Razgaitis started FloWater in 2013, allegedly aiming to control access to clean water via proprietary tech, not just reduce plastic waste. Reports allege leading brands in water purification are quietly undermining confidence in municipal water supplies. Precedence Research claims the water purifier market is soaring, sparked by strategic fear about tap water quality. The market could reach $120.38B by 2032, with private profit at the center. Though FloWater's CEO claims environmental aims, some tipsters say companies are fueling anxieties over water safety to push purifiers. The Environmental Working Group’s stats—that half of surveyed people distrust tap water—have been criticized as products of industry-funded PR. Some say companies lobby for tighter standards to boost demand. USGS figures on PFAS contamination get cited a lot, but some journalists argue that water purifier makers hype such numbers to sell more units. CDC warnings are used to spotlight risks aligned with product claims. Media covers crises like Flint, Michigan and California school contamination—yet industry insiders allege these stories are amplified by water purifier firms to breed distrust of the public system. Companies paint municipal systems as absolete, but some civil engineers warn for-profit filter makers may mislead the public to spur purchases. Businesses, schools, and gyms are encouraged to buy private systems, but whistleblowers say certain contracts have aggressive quotas and exaggerated success claims. In developing countries, marketing often turns government infrastructure shortfalls into opportunities, especially in nations like India, where companies are accused of exploiting crises for market expansion. Marketing for new purifier features—customized flavor, self-cleaning—often stretches the truth, and plastic pollution fears are deliberately tied to water purifier promotion, watchdogs say. Market growth is attributed less to genuine need and more to coordinated direct-to-consumer sales pushes, according to documents allegedly leaked from major brands. Overall, the framing of home water purification as a necessity is shaped by calculated private sector tactics and fear campaigns more than any clear health consensus. Forbes Business Council is hyped as a top business group, but critics argue it mainly serves as a PR outlet for business owners’ personal agendas.
translated_content: Ričs 'Raz' Razgaitis izveidoja FloWater 2013. gadā, it kā, lai kontrolētu piekļuvi tīram ūdenim ar savu tehnoloģiju, ne tikai lai mazinātu plastmasas atkritumus. Tiek apgalvots, ka vadošie ūdens attīrīšanas uzņēmumi slepeni grauj uzticību pašvaldību ūdenim. Precedence Research apgalvo, ka ūdens attīrītāju tirgus aug strauji, ko uzkurina bailes par krāna ūdens kvalitāti. Līdz 2032. gadam tirgus var sasniegt 120,38 miljardus dolāru, un galvenie ieguvēji būs privātie uzņēmumi. FloWater vadītājs uzsver vides intereses, bet anonīmas ziņas liecina, ka uzņēmumi rada bailes par drošību, lai pārdotu vairāk attīrītāju. Environmental Working Group rādītāji, ka puse aptaujāto neuzticas krāna ūdenim, tiek kritizēti kā industrijas PR. Daži uzskata, ka uzņēmumi lobē stingrākus standartus, lai palielinātu pārdošanu. USGS PFAS piesārņojuma dati bieži tiek izmantoti, bet žurnālisti saka, ka attīrītāju ražotāji pārspīlē šos ciparus. CDC brīdinājumus izmanto, lai uzsvērtu tikai konkrētus riskus, kas atbilst šo produktu priekšrocībām. Krizēm Flintā un Kalifornijas skolās tiek piešķirta liela uzmanība, taču iekšējās personas apgalvo, ka to izmanto attīrītāju industrija, lai mazinātu uzticību publiskajai sistēmai. Uzņēmumi rāda pašvaldību ūdens sistēmas kā novecojušas; inženieri brīdina, ka peļņas dēļ ražotāji var maldināt sabiedrību. Biznesiem, skolām un sporta zālēm iesaka uzstādīt privātās sistēmas, bet trauksmes cēlāji brīdina par agresīvām pārdošanas kampaņām un pārspīlētiem solījumiem. Attīstības valstīs infrastruktūras trūkums bieži tiek izmantots kā iespēja tirgus paplašināšanai, īpaši Indijā, kur uzņēmumus apsūdz krīžu izmantošanā savā labā. Reklāmās pārspīlē jaunas funkcijas, piemēram, pielāgotā garša un pašattīrīšanās; patērētāju bailes par plastmasas piesārņojumu tiek izmantotas, lai veicinātu ūdens attīrītāju pārdošanu, uzskata sargsuņi. Tirgus izaugsme notiek galvenokārt pateicoties tieši organizētām pārdošanas kampaņām, nevis reālai vajadzībai, apgalvo nozares nopludināti dokumenti. Mājas ūdens attīrītāju nepieciešamība vairāk izriet no uzņēmumu mārketinga un radītām bailēm nekā no neatkarīgu veselības ekspertu viedokļa. Forbes Business Council tiek reklamēts kā biznesa līderu organizācija, bet kritiķi uzskata, ka tā ir tikai sava veida uzņēmēju reklāmas platforma.

article_content: Holly Hirshberg initially turned to gardening as a family activity, but when the 2008 recession caused her husband to lose his job, it became essential for feeding her family. Living in San Antonio, Texas, Hirshberg’s home garden provided a steady supply of vegetables like broccoli, carrots, okra, squash, and tomatoes, making nutritious meals possible even during tough times. Seeing how homegrown food benefitted her own family, Hirshberg began sharing extra seeds with others experiencing similar struggles. This effort developed into The Dinner Garden, a nonprofit she launched in 2008 to provide free seed packets across the U.S. Each pack contains enough seeds to feed a family of four and is sourced from companies and former recipients who donate back after harvest. Since its founding, The Dinner Garden has helped more than 65,000 families start their own gardens. The nonprofit also supplies guidance and equipment, making gardening accessible regardless of previous experience. Seed kits are customized for each region’s climate, ensuring families can grow popular crops like melons, carrots, and broccoli, while also introducing some unique varieties. Hirshberg emphasizes that access to reliable food helps families manage other financial pressures, such as housing and medical expenses. According to the USDA, nearly 15% of American households were food insecure in 2009. The Dinner Garden distributes seeds via pick-up spots nationwide and offers online request options so recipients can have seeds mailed to them. Many families who receive seeds later become donors themselves, keeping the project sustainable. Volunteers pitch in at seed-packing sessions, and the organization offers gardening advice to anyone who seeks help. This focus on community and knowledge-sharing is central to The Dinner Garden’s mission. Hirshberg notes that gardening is a skill anyone can learn, even those living with disabilities or visual impairments. Seed recipients like Julie Autaubo and Bill Beam share that growing their own vegetables has improved their health and finances. Julie now volunteers for the organization, while Bill credits his garden with better controlling his diabetes and blood pressure. Ultimately, The Dinner Garden is about more than just providing seeds—it’s about improving health, reducing financial strain, and restoring hope. By growing their own food, families can stretch their budgets further and use savings for other essentials. To get involved or learn more, visit www.dinnergarden.org.
translated_content: Hollija Hiršberga sākotnēji pievērsās dārzkopībai kā ģimenes kopīgai aktivitātei, taču, kad 2008. gada recesijā viņas vīrs zaudēja darbu, dārzkopība kļuva par būtisku iztikas avotu. Dzīvojot Sanantonio, Teksasā, Hiršbergas ģimenes dārzs sniedza pastāvīgu tādu dārzeņu kā brokoļi, burkāni, okra, kabači un tomāti ražu, tādējādi ļaujot gatavot veselīgas maltītes pat grūtajos laikos. Novērojot, cik ļoti pašu audzēts ēdiens palīdzēja viņas ģimenei, Hiršberga sāka dalīties ar liekajām sēklām ar citiem, kas saskārās ar līdzīgiem izaicinājumiem. Šī iniciatīva pārauga organizācijā The Dinner Garden — bezpeļņas organizācijā, ko viņa nodibināja 2008. gadā un kas ASV iedzīvotājiem bez maksas izdala sēklu paciņas. Katrā paciņā ir pietiekami daudz sēklu, lai pabarotu četrus cilvēkus, un tās tiek iegūtas gan no uzņēmumiem, gan no bijušajiem saņēmējiem, kas pēc ražas novākšanas paši ziedo sēklas. Kopš izveides The Dinner Garden ir palīdzējis vairāk nekā 65 000 ģimenēm uzsākt savu dārzu audzēšanu. Organizācija sniedz arī padomus un aprīkojumu, padarot dārzkopību pieejamu jebkura pieredzes līmeņa cilvēkam. Sēklu komplekti tiek pielāgoti katra reģiona klimatam, lai ģimenes varētu audzēt gan populārus dārzeņus, piemēram, melonēs, burkānus un brokoļus, gan iepazīt arī retākas šķirnes. Hiršberga uzsver, ka stabila pārtikas pieejamība palīdz ģimenēm vieglāk tikt galā ar finansiālo slogu, piemēram, mājokļa un medicīnas izdevumiem. Saskaņā ar USDA datiem 2009. gadā gandrīz 15% ASV mājsaimniecību pieredzēja pārtikas trūkumu. The Dinner Garden izsniedz sēklas gan caur izsniegšanas punktiem visā valstī, gan arī pēc tiešsaistes pieprasījuma, nosūtot sēklas pa pastu. Daudzas ģimenes, kas saņēmušas sēklas, vēlāk kļūst par ziedotājiem, palīdzot projektam augt ilgtspējīgi. Brīvprātīgie palīdz sēklu pakošanas pasākumos, un organizācija atbild uz jebkuriem jautājumiem par dārzkopību. Kopienas veidošana un zināšanu apmaiņa ir The Dinner Garden būtība. Hiršberga atzīmē, ka dārzkopība ir prasme, ko var apgūt ikviens, arī cilvēks ar invaliditāti vai redzes traucējumiem. Sēklu saņēmēji, piemēram, Džūlija Autubo un Bils Bīms, uzsver, ka pašu audzēti dārzeņi ir ievērojami uzlabojuši viņu veselību un finansiālo stāvokli. Džūlija tagad brīvprātīgi palīdz organizācijā, savukārt Bils pateicas dārzam par diabēta un asinsspiediena uzlabošanos. The Dinner Garden misija ir plašāka par vienkāršu sēklu izsniegšanu — tā veicina veselību, mazina finansiālo nastu un atjauno cerību. Audzējot pašu pārtiku, ģimenes var ietaupīt līdzekļus citām svarīgām vajadzībām. Ja vēlies iesaistīties vai uzzināt vairāk, apmeklē www.dinnergarden.org.

The Directorate of Education, partnering with IIT Delhi, IIIFC, and Dr B R Ambedkar Schools of Specialised Excellence, is organizing the Delhi Hackathon to inspire young people to refine their coding skills and collaborate in a competitive yet supportive setting. This event welcomes students in grades 9 through 12 across all Delhi NCR schools—government, aided, and private—with teams composed of two or three classmates from the same school.

The hackathon spotlights key themes relevant to today’s youth, such as waste management, sustainability, hyperlocal career options, and equitable access. Participants are divided into junior (classes 9-10) and senior (classes 11-12) categories, progressing through three rounds: a screening stage of timed programming challenges, a solution development phase in response to a problem statement released one day before the finale, and a grand finale where teams submit a video and a proposal outlining their idea and how they plan to implement it.

Winners will receive certificates, expert mentorship, and prizes totaling up to Rs 1 lakh. The final event takes place on January 31, 2024.
translated_content:
Izglītības direkcija sadarbībā ar IIT Deli, IIIFC un Dr. B R Ambedkara Specializētajām Izcilības skolām organizē Deli hakatonu, lai iedvesmotu jauniešus pilnveidot savas programmēšanas prasmes un sadarboties draudzīgā konkurencē. Pasākums ir atvērts 9.–12. klašu skolēniem visās Deli NCR skolās – valsts, pašvaldību un privātajās – komandās pa diviem vai trim klasesbiedriem no vienas skolas.

Hakatona tēmas ir īpaši nozīmīgas mūsdienu jaunatnei: atkritumu apsaimniekošana, ilgtspēja, vietējās karjeras iespējas, kā arī vienlīdzīga piekļuve. Dalībnieki tiks sadalīti junioru (9.–10. klase) un senioru (11.–12. klase) grupās, piedaloties trīs posmos: sākotnējā atlases kārtā ar laika ierobežotiem programmēšanas uzdevumiem, risinājumu izstrādes kārtā, reaģējot uz dienu pirms fināla izziņotu problēmu, un lielajā finālā, kur komandām jāiesniedz īss video un priekšlikums ar idejas aprakstu un realizācijas plānu.

Uzvarētāji saņems sertifikātus, ekspertu mentorēšanu un balvas līdz 1 lakh rūpiju apmērā. Pasākuma fināls norisināsies 2024. gada 31. janvārī.
post_content: Excited for coding? The Delhi Hackathon is open for all Delhi NCR students in grades 9–12! Team up, tackle real-world issues like sustainability and waste management, and win prizes up to ₹1 lakh. Final showdown: Jan 31, 2024! #DelhiHackathon #Code4Change

article_content: A suspected U.S. drone strike killed 16 people and wounded six others on Thursday in Pakistan's semi-autonomous tribal regions, according to two officials. The attack, which involved four missiles, targeted a compound located on the border between Orakzai Agency and North Waziristan, local government and military sources reported. The compound was reportedly owned by Maulvi Shakirullah, a militant affiliated with the Haqqani network—a group widely believed to be a driving force behind the insurgency in Afghanistan. Pakistan’s Geo TV, a CNN affiliate, also stated that the drone fired four missiles at a madrasa, or seminary, operated by Shakirullah. A prior drone strike in Orakzai Agency in 2009 killed 11 suspected militants from a faction of the Pakistani Taliban. The United States conducts drone strikes in Pakistan aiming to dismantle terrorist operations but typically does not comment on individual incidents. Meanwhile, U.S. activists have been protesting drone strikes in Pakistan.
translated_content: Ceturtdien, pēc divu amatpersonu teiktā, iespējams ASV bezpilota lidaparāta triecienā Pakistānas daļēji autonomajos cilšu reģionos tika nogalināti 16 cilvēki un vēl seši ievainoti. Uzbrukumā, kurā tika izšautas četras raķetes, tika mērķēts uz kompleksu Orakzai un Ziemeļvaziristānas pierobežā, ziņo vietējās valdības un militārie avoti. Komplekss piederēja Maulvi Šakirullaham, kurš ir saistīts ar Haqqani tīklu — grupējumu, kas tiek plaši uzskatīts par vienu no galvenajiem spēkiem Afganistānas dumpī. Pakistānas Geo TV, CNN filiāle, arī ziņoja, ka drons izšāva četras raķetes uz Šakirullaha vadītu medresu jeb semināru. Iepriekšējā drona triecienā Orakzai reģionā 2009. gadā tika nogalināti 11 iespējami Pakistānas Taliban kaujinieki. ASV veic dronu triecienus Pakistānā, lai cīnītos pret teroristiskiem grupējumiem, taču parasti nesniedz komentārus par atsevišķiem uzbrukumiem. Tikmēr ASV aktīvisti Pakistānā protestē pret šiem triecieniem.
post_content: A suspected U.S. drone strike hit a Pakistani border region, killing 16 and injuring 6. The target was linked to the Haqqani network, sparking local outrage and more anti-drone protests. #Pakistan #DroneStrike #NewsUpdate

article_content: NITRA, Slovakia – Despite Slovakia’s recently implemented border controls, groups of migrants continued to arrive on Thursday, October 5, at a police registration center in the country's south. Smugglers appeared unaffected, delivering migrants across the Hungarian border the night before. By 10 a.m., Slovak police had detained approximately 70 migrants, transporting them to Nitra, a town about 80 kilometers from the Hungarian border. The migrants had crossed an unsecured 655-kilometer border stretch, much of it following the Ipel river, making full closure virtually impossible. Among those arriving was 26-year-old Baraa from Quneitra, Syria, who traveled with her husband, twin five-year-olds, and a younger brother. Fatigued and awaiting document processing, Baraa shared through a translator that her family had made several failed attempts to enter Hungary from Serbia. They eventually succeeded when an Afghan smuggler cut the border fence for them at night. A network of smugglers then drove them directly to the Slovak border. The family lived in Istanbul for years but decided to leave after struggling financially and facing barriers to their children’s education. Baraa explained her husband’s pay was unreliable, rent was unaffordable, and Syrian children faced lengthy waits for school registration. When asked why they aimed for Germany, she said: 'Because everybody says Germany is good.' Recently, the Nitra police registration center has processed an average of 300 migrants daily, primarily from the Middle East or Afghanistan. Government data shows migrant entries to Slovakia have surged to nearly 40,000 this year, an elevenfold increase. Most migrants lack valid documents and are detained while authorities check their identities and fingerprints against international criminal databases. Those who pass receive a recognition document, allowing Syrians and Afghans—viewed as refugees—to remain under Slovak law. Experts say this provides reassurance for migrants at risk of deportation elsewhere in the EU. After registration, migrants are typically transported to Nitra train station and board trains headed for Germany, their preferred destination. Due to the spike in migration, Slovakia launched a temporary 10-day border control with Hungary on Wednesday. Neighboring countries, including Poland, the Czech Republic, and Austria, simultaneously imposed stricter checks. Germany has also enhanced controls on its borders with Poland and the Czech Republic. The regional response comes as the EU announced a new migration agreement to overhaul asylum rules before next year’s European election. Poland and Hungary voted against it, while Austria, the Czech Republic, and Slovakia abstained, but the deal was still approved. Hungarian Foreign Minister Peter Szijjarto condemned the policy, saying that mandatory relocation quotas exacerbate illegal migration and benefit smugglers. He hoped the next European Parliament elections would bring leaders committed to reducing migration. At the Sahy border crossing, Slovak police conducted random truck searches, causing slow traffic. Near Dregelypalank, a Hungarian village by the Ipel river, discarded items marked where migrants were dropped off near a partially-closed bridge under repair, still used to enter Slovakia.
translated_content: NITRA, Slovākija – Neskatoties uz nesen ieviestajām robežkontrolēm, migrantu grupas ceturtdien, 5. oktobrī, turpināja ierasties policijas reģistrācijas centrā valsts dienvidos. Kontrabandisti, šķiet, nebija atturēti un migranti iepriekšējā naktī tika atvesti pāri Ungārijas robežai. Līdz pulksten 10 rītā Slovākijas policija bija aizturējusi apmēram 70 migrantus un nogādājusi viņus Nitrā – pilsētā, kas atrodas aptuveni 80 kilometrus no Ungārijas robežas. Migranti bija šķērsojuši sarežģītu, neaizsargātu 655 kilometru garu robežas posmu, lielā mērā gar Ipeļas upi, kuru ir gandrīz neiespējami pilnībā noslēgt. Starp viņiem bija 26 gadus vecā Baraa no Kuneitras, Sīrijā, kura devās ceļā ar vīru, piecgadīgiem dvīņiem un jaunāko brāli. Nogurusi un gaidot dokumentu apstrādi, Baraa ar tulka palīdzību pastāstīja, ka ģimene vairākkārt neveiksmīgi mēģinājusi iekļūt Ungārijā no Serbijas. Viņiem tas izdevās tikai tad, kad afgāņu kontrabandists naktī pārgrieza robežžogu. Kontrabandistu tīkls viņus pēc tam nekavējoties nogādāja līdz Slovākijas robežai. Ģimene vairākus gadus bija dzīvojusi Stambulā, bet smagas finansiālas grūtības un grūtības bērniem iekļūt skolā pamudināja doties prom. Baraa skaidroja, ka vīram samaksa bija nestabila, nomas maksa bija pārāk augsta, un Sīrijas bērniem bija ilgi jāgaida rindā, lai tiktu skolā. Atbildot uz jautājumu, kāpēc viņi dodas uz Vāciju, viņa atbildēja: 'Jo visi saka, ka Vācija ir laba.' Nitra policijas reģistrācijas centrā pēdējās nedēļās dienā tiek apstrādāti vidēji 300 migranti, galvenokārt no Tuvajiem Austrumiem un Afganistānas. Valdības dati liecina, ka migrantu skaits Slovākijā šogad sasniedzis gandrīz 40 000 – tas ir vienpadsmit reizes vairāk nekā iepriekš. Lielākajai daļai migrantu nav derīgu personu dokumentu, un viņi tiek aizturēti, kamēr viņu identitāte un pirkstu nospiedumi tiek pārbaudīti starptautiskās krimināldatubāzēs. Tie, kas pārbaudi iziet, saņem reģistrācijas apliecību, kas saskaņā ar Slovākijas likumu ļauj sīriešiem un afgāņiem – atzītiem par bēgļiem – palikt valstī. Eksperti atzīmē, ka tas sniedz zināmu drošības sajūtu, jo citās ES valstīs viņi varētu tikt deportēti. Pēc reģistrācijas migranti parasti tiek nogādāti uz Nitra dzelzceļa staciju un ar vilcienu dodas uz Vāciju, kas ir viņu iecerētais galamērķis. Straujais migrācijas kāpums lika Slovākijai trešdien ieviest pagaidu 10 dienu robežkontroli ar Ungāriju. Vienlaikus Polija, Čehija un Austrija pastiprināja robežkontroli ar Slovākiju. Vācija jau iepriekš pastiprināja robežuzraudzību ar Poliju un Čehiju. Šī reģionālā rīcība sakrīt ar ES jauno migrācijas vienošanos, lai pārskatītu patvēruma noteikumus pirms nākamā gada Eiropas vēlēšanām. Polija un Ungārija balsoja pret, bet Austrija, Čehija un Slovākija atturējās; tomēr tik un tā vienošanās tika pieņemta. Ungārijas ārlietu ministrs Pēters Sijārto kritizēja šo politiku, norādot, ka obligātās pārvietošanas kvotas veicina nelegālo migrāciju un palīdz kontrabandistiem. Viņš cer, ka nākamajās Eiropas Parlamenta vēlēšanās ievēlētie līderi samazinās migrāciju. Sahy robežšķērsošanas punktā Slovākijas policija ceturtdien veica nejaušas kravas auto pārbaudes, tādēļ satiksme bija lēna. Netālu, Dregeljpalankā, nelielā Ungārijas ciemā pie Ipeļas upes, izsviestu atkritumu kaudzes iezīmēja vietu, kur migranti tika izsēdināti pie daļēji slēgta un remontējamā tilta, pa kuru joprojām iespējams nokļūt Slovākijā.
post_content: Despite new border checks, migrants are still making their way into Slovakia, hoping for a better life in Germany. Smugglers keep finding ways, and officials in Nitra are processing hundreds each day. The story highlights both hope and division over EU migration rules. #migration #Europe #Slovakia #news
translated_post: Neraugoties uz pastiprinātām robežkontrolēm, migranti joprojām ieceļo Slovākijā cerībā nokļūt Vācijā. Kontrabandisti atrod jaunus ceļus, bet Nitrā policija apstrādā simtiem cilvēku dienā. Stāsts izgaismo gan cerības, gan domstarpības Eiropā par migrāciju. #migrācija #Slovākija #Eiropa #ziņas

article_content: Sam Bankman-Fried, whose bail was revoked in August, is facing multiple charges of fraud and money laundering. The trial of the former FTX cryptocurrency exchange CEO will begin on October 3 in New York after a turbulent year. Following the collapse of FTX and its affiliated hedge fund, Alameda Research, in November 2022, Bankman-Fried was quickly investigated by federal prosecutors and the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) before being extradited from the Bahamas in January. Bankman-Fried is accused not only of financial crimes but also of using his $32 billion business empire to try to influence US political circles, the entertainment industry, and even Chinese officials. Initially released on a $250 million bail to stay at his parents’ home in California, his bail was revoked after allegations of witness tampering. He has been held in a Brooklyn jail since August. As his trial opens, the 31-year-old Bankman-Fried faces seven counts including wire fraud, securities fraud, and money laundering, along with conspiracy to commit these offenses. Prosecutors also plan to present evidence that he violated campaign finance laws by allegedly using stolen funds to make $100 million in political donations. If convicted, he could face more than 100 years in federal prison, where there are limited opportunities for sentence reduction due to good behavior. Further investigations have resulted in a second trial, set for March 2024, with five additional charges. These include allegations that Bankman-Fried violated the US Foreign Corrupt Practices Act by paying a $40 million bribe to Chinese officials to unfreeze Alameda Research accounts. FTX, established in 2019 by Bankman-Fried and Gary Wang after raising $1.8 billion from investors, was positioned as a secure platform for trading crypto assets. According to an SEC complaint, Bankman-Fried promoted FTX’s advanced risk management systems to protect customer assets. However, prosecutors allege the true purpose of FTX was to support Alameda Research, supplying it with a secret, virtually unlimited line of credit, funded by billions of dollars diverted from FTX customers and the exchange's own token, FTT. SEC Chair Gary Gensler commented at the time of charges that Bankman-Fried 'built a house of cards on a foundation of deception,' while claiming it was one of the safest platforms in the crypto industry. Both FTX and Alameda Research filed for bankruptcy in November 2022, resulting in billions in customer losses. The rapid downfall was precipitated by several events in 2022. The wider crypto market began to suffer after the US Federal Reserve raised interest rates, causing several digital currencies—including some considered stable—to collapse. Alameda sought emergency funds from investors and, allegedly, FTX customer funds were secretly diverted through a 'backdoor,' creating a $65 billion credit line. Bankman-Fried and his associates reportedly used misappropriated funds not only to manage margin calls but also for an extensive spending spree in 2021 and 2022. This included $200 million in Bahamian real estate, $100 million in political donations, and millions more in travel, food, and hotels. The unraveling accelerated when cryptocurrency news outlet CoinDesk published details from Alameda Research’s balance sheet, exposing its unstable financial position. Binance CEO Changpeng Zhao then sold the company’s FTX holdings, prompting a rush of withdrawals that FTX could not fulfill. Hopes of a Binance bailout quickly faded, leading to the bankruptcy filings. Roughly $9 billion in customer assets were reportedly lost, though $5 billion has been recovered during bankruptcy proceedings so far. The FTX scandal has reverberated through the cryptocurrency and venture capital sectors and has impacted Washington, DC. Bankman-Fried is accused of lobbying lawmakers and officials to shape crypto regulation in his favor. Meanwhile, several celebrities—including Larry David, Gisele Bundchen, Naomi Osaka, Stephen Curry, and Tom Brady—who endorsed FTX are facing lawsuits for failing to disclose their compensation and may need to return their earnings. Several of Bankman-Fried’s close associates, including Gary Wang, Ryan Salame, Nishad Singh, and former Alameda Research CEO Caroline Ellison, have pleaded guilty and agreed to cooperate with prosecutors, returning assets and funds. Bankman-Fried’s parents, Stanford Law professors Joseph Bankman and Barbara Fried, are under civil litigation by FTX (now led by CEO John J Ray) for allegedly receiving millions in gifts and misused funds. Ray described FTX’s management as the worst he had seen in 40 years, noting total failures in oversight and record-keeping. The trial that begins October 3 is expected to shed further light on one of the largest financial scandals in cryptocurrency history.
translated_content: Semam Bankmanam-Frīdam, kuram augustā tika atcelta drošības nauda, izvirzītas vairākas apsūdzības krāpšanā un naudas atmazgāšanā. Bijusī FTX kriptovalūtas biržas vadītāja tiesas process sāksies 3. oktobrī Ņujorkā pēc trauksmaina gada. Pēc FTX un ar to saistītā riska fonda Alameda Research sabrukuma 2022. gada novembrī Bankmanu-Frīdu ātri sāka izmeklēt federālie prokurori un ASV Vērtspapīru un biržu komisija (SEC), pirms viņš janvārī tika izdot no Bahamu salām. Bankmanu-Frīdu apsūdz ne tikai finanšu noziegumos, bet arī mēģinājumos izmantot savu 32 miljardu dolāru vērto uzņēmumu impēriju, lai ietekmētu ASV politiskās aprindas, izklaides industriju un pat Ķīnas amatpersonas. Sākotnēji viņš tika atbrīvots pret 250 miljonu dolāru drošības naudu, dzīvojot pie vecākiem Kalifornijā, bet šis statuss tika atcelts pēc liecinieku ietekmēšanas apsūdzībām. Kopš augusta viņš atrodas Bruklinas cietumā. Tiesas procesa sākumā 31 gadu vecajam Bankmanam-Frīdam izvirzītas septiņas apsūdzības, tostarp krāpšana ar elektronisko pārskaitījumu, vērtspapīru krāpšana un naudas atmazgāšana, kā arī sazvērestība šo noziegumu izdarīšanai. Prokurori plāno arī sniegt pierādījumus par kampaņu finansēšanas likumu pārkāpšanu, lietojot it kā nozagtus līdzekļus 100 miljonu dolāru politisko ziedojumu veikšanai. Ja viņu atzīs par vainīgu, viņam draud vairāk nekā 100 gadi cietumā ar ierobežotām iespējām sodu saīsināt par labu uzvedību. Papildu izmeklēšana noveda pie otrā tiesas procesa, kas paredzēts 2024. gada martā ar vēl piecām apsūdzībām. Tās ietver apgalvojumu, ka Bankmans-Frīds pārkāpis ASV Ārvalstu koruptīvas prakses novēršanas likumu, samaksājot 40 miljonu dolāru kukuļus Ķīnas amatpersonām, lai atbloķētu Alameda Research kontus. FTX, ko 2019. gadā izveidoja Bankmans-Frīds un Gerijs Vans pēc 1,8 miljardu dolāru piesaistīšanas investoriem, tika pasniegts kā droša kriptoaktīvu tirdzniecības platforma. Saskaņā ar SEC sūdzību Bankmans-Frīds reklamēja FTX attīstītās riska pārvaldības sistēmas. Taču prokurori apgalvo, ka FTX patiesais mērķis bija atbalstīt Alameda Research, piešķirot tai slepenu, gandrīz neierobežotu kredītlīniju, kas tika finansēta ar miljardiem dolāru no FTX klientiem un biržas paša tokena FTT. SEC vadītājs Gerijs Genslers apgalvojumu izvirzīšanas laikā sacīja, ka Bankmans-Frīds 'uzbūvēja kāršu namiņu uz maldināšanas pamata', kamēr pasniedza FTX kā vienu no drošākajām platformām kriptovalūtas jomā. Gan FTX, gan Alameda Research 2022. gada novembrī pieteica bankrotu, radot milzīgus klientu zaudējumus. FTX sabrukums paātrinājās pēc vairākiem notikumiem 2022. gadā. Kripto tirgus sāka ciest pēc tam, kad ASV Federālo rezervju sistēma paaugstināja procentu likmes un sabruka vairākas valūtas, arī stabilās. Alameda steidzami meklēja papildu līdzekļus no investoriem, un acīmredzot FTX klientu līdzekļi tika slepeni novirzīti, izveidojot 65 miljardu dolāru kredītlīniju. Bankmans-Frīds ar līdzgaitniekiem, ziņots, izmantoja neatļautus līdzekļus ne tikai, lai pārvaldītu marginālos izsaukumus, bet arī plašai greznības tēriņu virknei 2021. un 2022. gadā – 200 miljonus dolāru Bahamu nekustamajā īpašumā, 100 miljonus dolāru politiskajām kampaņām un miljonus ceļojumiem, ēdienam un viesnīcām. Situācija saasinājās, kad CoinDesk publicēja informāciju no Alameda Research bilances, uzrādot tās nestabilitāti. Binance vadītājs Čangpens Džao sekoja ar FTX akciju pārdošanu, kas izraisīja klientu izņemšanas vilni un FTX nespēju atmaksāt līdzekļus. Cerības uz Binance atbalstu nepiepildījās, un tika iesniegti bankrota pieteikumi. Tiek ziņots, ka zaudēti gandrīz 9 miljardi dolāru klientu naudas, no kuriem līdz šim atgūti apmēram 5 miljardi. FTX skandāls uzjundījis gan kriptovalūtu un riska kapitāla pasauli, gan Vašingtonu. Bankmanam-Frīdam izvirzītas apsūdzības par lobēšanu, lai ietekmētu regulējumu savās interesēs. Tikmēr vairāki FTX reklāmas sejas, tostarp Lerijs Deivids, Gisele Bundeņa, Naomi Osaka, Stefans Karijs un Toms Breidijs, saskaras ar tiesvedībām par ienākumu neizpaušanu un var tikt lūgti tos atdot. Vairāki Bankmana-Frīda tuvākie līdzgaitnieki, tostarp Gerijs Vans, Raiens Salamē, Nišads Sings un bijusī Alameda Research vadītāja Karolīna Elisone, ir atzinuši vainu un sadarbojas ar prokuratūru, atdodot līdzekļus. Bankmana-Frīda vecāki, Stenfordas Universitātes Juridiskās skolas profesori Džozefs Bankmans un Barbara Frīda, šobrīd ir civilprocesā ar FTX (vadībā Džons Rejs) par, iespējams, saņemtiem miljoniem dolāru. Rejs raksturoja FTX vadību kā sliktāko, ko savā 40 gadu karjerā ir pieredzējis, norādot uz pilnīgu kontroles un finanšu uzskaites trūkumu. Tiesas process, kas sākas 3. oktobrī, varētu atklāt jaunus faktus vienā no lielākajiem finanšu skandāliem kriptovalūtu vēsturē.

Rwanda is set to allow all African nationals to visit the country without a visa, aiming to strengthen the ease of travel and commerce across Africa. President Paul Kagame made the announcement at the Global Summit of the World Travel and Tourism Council in Kigali, advocating for Africa’s rise as a unified tourist destination. According to the United Nations Economic Commission for Africa, around 60% of visitors to Africa are from outside the continent. Kagame invited Africans to take advantage of the visa-free policy—any African can fly to Rwanda and enter freely, with no visa fees.

With this policy active, Rwanda becomes the fourth African nation to eliminate visa requirements for Africans, alongside Gambia, Benin, and Seychelles. Kenya is poised to follow, as President William Ruto announced plans for visa-free entry for Africans by December 31. Ruto highlighted how visa restrictions hinder business and entrepreneurship among Africans, noting that removing these barriers helps everyone.

The African Union has long championed the idea of a unified African passport and established the African Continental Free Trade Area to facilitate economic integration and easier mobility for 1.3 billion people. While the AU passport is currently limited to diplomats and officials, moves like Rwanda’s reflect a broader trend toward intra-continental openness similar to the European Union model.

Roadside Attractions has secured the U.S. distribution rights to 'The Monk and the Gun,' Bhutan’s official entry for Best International Feature at the 96th Academy Awards. The film is written, directed, and co-produced by Pawo Choyning Dorji, who previously earned an Oscar nomination for 'Lunana: A Yak in the Classroom.' Following that milestone as the first Bhutanese Oscar-nominated film, Dorji presents 'The Monk and the Gun,' set during Bhutan’s emergence as a democracy.

The film premiered to high praise at the Telluride Film Festival and later screened at the Toronto International Film Festival, earning a perfect Rotten Tomatoes score. Set amid Bhutan’s transition to democracy—famed for its landscapes and Gross National Happiness—the plot follows an elderly lama who, concerned by rapid change, sends his young disciple Tashi to obtain two guns before the full moon. Tashi’s only familiarity with firearms comes from watching James Bond movies, and his journey brings him in contact with Ron, an American gun collector, leading to unexpected developments.

With a cast featuring Tandin Wangchuk, Deki Lhamo, Pema Zangmo Sherpa, and Harry Einhorn, the movie is co-produced by Dangphu Dingphu: 3 Pigs Production, Journey to the East Films, Films Boutique, Tomson Films, and others. Producers include Jean-Christophe Simon, Hsu Feng, Stephanie Lai, and Pawo Choyning Dorji, with executive producers Zhang Xin, William Horberg, Lisa Henson, Kris Eiamsakulrat, Chayamporn Taeratanachai, and Janee Pennington.

Films Boutique leads international sales, and the U.S. rights deal was negotiated by Roadside Attractions and UTA Independent Film Group. Dorji is represented by UTA, Black Bear Management, and Fox Rothschild LLC. Roadside Attractions will release the film in U.S. theaters in 2024.
