Rep. Paul Ryan has expressed doubts about President Barack Obama’s pledge to avoid deploying American combat troops in the fight against ISIS. Speaking on CNN’s 'Erin Burnett OutFront,' the Wisconsin Republican said, “I’m supportive of what the President has done in Syria and Iraq, but you have to see this thing through.”

President Obama, in a '60 Minutes' interview with CBS, suggested he would maintain his policy of not sending U.S. combat troops to the region, describing the conflict as more of a political problem than a military one.

A recent CNN/ORC International poll shows that 73% of Americans favor the ongoing airstrike campaign, while fewer than four in ten support sending combat troops into Iraq and Syria. Ryan stated that if the administration were to present Congress with a plan to send combat troops, he would support it. “I think the President should come to Congress with an authorization of force resolution and I would support it,” Ryan said. “And I would help the President pass that because I think it’s necessary to see this threat through.”

Ryan also stressed the importance of defeating ISIS and said that necessary steps must be taken to accomplish this goal. He emphasized that a large-scale ground campaign is not required, but based on prior experiences in Iraq and Afghanistan, embedding U.S. Special Forces with local fighters and coordinating airstrikes have proven successful.

Ryan, who has received intelligence briefings about ISIS for several years, supports the President’s actions so far but believes more needs to be done. He noted that having ground enablers to guide air campaigns and help prevent civilian casualties would be beneficial. Ryan also warned against what he sees as the President’s micromanagement of military operations, suggesting that a more decisive approach is needed to eradicate ISIS.

article_content: It’s remarkable how one holiday gift can shift the whole dynamic of a family—especially when that gift is a three-foot-tall My Size Barbie. Years back, after my daughter Gaby begged for one, I found myself searching distant toy stores late on Christmas Eve to track it down. On Christmas morning, Gaby tore open the box, instantly giving her new doll the memorable name Jessica Lynn Cohen. We never quite understood the inspiration, but the name stuck. For a while, Gaby and Jessica Lynn Cohen were inseparable, changing clothes, playing pretend, and sharing countless adventures around the house. Eventually, the novelty faded, as it often does, and the doll was tucked away in our basement. That’s when odd things began happening. Initially, we moved the doll for pranks, but soon she started showing up in unexpected places. Sometimes we’d find her in the pantry or posed as if she was mid-dance. Discovering her like this gave the whole family—and visiting repairmen—a jolt. We tried to part with Jessica Lynn Cohen, but each attempt was met with strange misfortune. The first time I left her by the curb, Mercedes suffered a sudden gallstone attack. On another occasion, after dropping the doll off at a charity, I was hit by a car. Each time, we brought her back home. A friend who once agreed to take her in had his own streak of bad luck and promptly returned her, insisting we keep her out of his life. In time, we accepted that Jessica Lynn Cohen was here to stay. She became part of our Christmas tradition—hidden away on Christmas Eve (so as not to spook Santa, just in case), and then placed proudly by the tree come morning. Perhaps she’s a little bit spooky, or maybe these stories are just the odd way family memories take root. Either way, Jessica Lynn Cohen has earned her place, and we can’t imagine celebrating Christmas without her watching over us.

article_content: Amanda Berry and Gina DeJesus, who survived ten years of captivity in Cleveland, are preparing to share their story in a memoir. They will work with Washington Post reporters Mary Jordan, a Cleveland native, and Kevin Sullivan, both Pulitzer Prize winners, to bring their experiences to light. Although negotiations with publishers haven't started, there's considerable interest, drawing comparisons to Jaycee Dugard’s memoir, 'A Stolen Life.' Washington attorney Robert Barnett, known for representing prominent figures like President Obama and Amanda Knox, will handle the book's negotiations. In a statement released Monday, Berry and DeJesus’s lawyer, James Wooley, said that the women want to reclaim their narrative after many inaccurate reports. While they value their privacy, they've chosen to share their story personally. Wooley, who has known journalist Mary Jordan for years, invited her to be part of the project. Jordan has spoken about her admiration for the women's strength and her enthusiasm to help share their journey. Ariel Castro, who abducted Berry, DeJesus, and Michelle Knight between 2002 and 2004, was sentenced to life in prison plus 1,000 years after pleading guilty to 937 charges including kidnapping and rape. The women were rescued from Castro’s house on May 6, 2013, when Berry escaped and contacted police. Investigators later revealed the women had suffered repeated abuse and deprivation during captivity. Castro died by suicide in his cell one month after his sentencing.

Lai gan vēl nav uzsāktas sarunas ar izdevējiem, interese par šo projektu jau ir liela, un viņu stāsts tiek salīdzināts ar Džeisijas Dūgardes memuāru 'Nozagta dzīve.' Vašingtonas advokāts Roberts Barnets, kurš plaši pazīstams kā augsta profile klientu, piemēram, prezidenta Obamas un Amandas Noksas, pārstāvis, vadīs grāmatas sarunas. Pirmdien izplatītajā paziņojumā Berijas un Dehesusas advokāts Džeimss Vūlijs norādīja, ka sievietes vēlas atgūt kontroli pār savu stāstu pēc daudzām neprecizitātēm medijos. Lai gan viņām ir svarīga privātā dzīve, viņas ir nolēmušas savu pieredzi izklāstīt pašas. Vūlijs, kurš ilgstoši pazīst Mēriju Džordanu, aicināja viņu iesaistīties projektā. Džordana ir paudusi dziļu apbrīnu par sieviešu izturību un interesi palīdzēt pastāstīt viņu dzīves stāstu. Ariels Kastro, kurš no 2002. līdz 2004. gadam nolaupīja Beriju, Dehesusu un Mišelu Naitu, tika notiesāts uz mūžu un vēl 1000 gadus pēc atzīšanās 937 apsūdzībās, tostarp par cilvēku nolaupīšanu un izvarošanu. Sievietes tika izglābtas no Kastro mājas 2013. gada 6. maijā, kad Berija izkļuva brīvībā un izsauca policiju. article_content: Ranbir Kapoor returns to the big screen with Animal after a two-year hiatus from signing new films. In Animal, Kapoor takes on a darker and more complex role than ever before, marking a departure from his usual screen persona. He has mentioned in various interviews that this film provided a unique opportunity to break away from his previous image and embody a multidimensional character. Although only a pre-teaser, teaser, and a few songs have been released so far, Animal has generated considerable positive buzz, particularly regarding its advance bookings in the USA. The film's new song, 'Papa Meri Jaan,' highlights the emotional depth of the father-son relationship central to the story. Animal is set to release in the USA on November 30, one day before its release in India. For its premiere shows, the film has sold 4,161 tickets across 229 locations, grossing $70,337—a significant jump from $54,812 gathered 24 hours earlier. In an interview with Variety, Ranbir Kapoor described his character as a captivating combination of strength, vulnerability, and unpredictability, shaped by a dark past. He expressed confidence that audiences will be captivated by the film’s intense narrative and rich characterization. Alongside Ranbir Kapoor, the film stars Anil Kapoor, Bobby Deol, Rashmika Mandanna, and Tripti Dimri. Animal will compete at the box office with Vicky Kaushal’s Sam Bahadur, directed by Meghna Gulzar. Sam Bahadur depicts the story of India’s first Field Marshal, Sam Manekshaw, and his pivotal role in the creation of Bangladesh.

article_content: Since last Sunday, rescue operations have been ongoing at the Silkyara tunnel collapse site in Uttarkashi, Uttarakhand, where 41 labourers remain trapped. Rescue teams, including geologists, engineers, tunnelling and geotechnical experts, are investigating various options for evacuation. Drilling was suspended after a loud cracking sound was heard at the site on Friday, raising concerns over the possibility of further collapse. Officials have commenced preparations to drill a vertical hole from the hilltop, and the Border Roads Organisation aims to complete an alternative route to the under-construction tunnel by Sunday afternoon. Chris Cooper, an Australian chartered engineer and micro tunnelling expert, has arrived at the site to assist, and tunnelling specialists from Norway and Thailand have also been consulted. Efforts continue to ensure the trapped workers’ survival, with oxygen, food, electricity, and water being delivered via pipes, and regular contact maintained through walkie-talkies. Based on expert recommendations, a Mild Steel Pipe 900 mm in diameter was selected to provide a potential escape route, installed with the help of earth auger drilling machines. When the initial drilling machine was found inadequate, the Indian Air Force airlifted a higher-capacity American auger drilling machine to Uttarakhand, which took additional time to assemble. On Friday morning, rescuers inserted a 22-meter pipe into the rubble, but drilling ceased after the new machine’s bearings were damaged and the mounting platform required modification. A loud cracking noise during these modifications prompted a pause in operations to avoid further tunnel collapse. Senior officials and experts continue to explore alternative solutions, as drilling activities generate vibrations that could increase risk. A supplementary earth auger machine was transported to the site early Saturday to assist in the ongoing rescue operation. The trapped labourers are receiving essential supplies and remain in contact with rescue teams, who are working carefully to secure their evacuation and minimize additional danger.
translated_content: Kopš pagājušās svētdienas Silkyara tuneļa nobrukuma vietā Uttarkashi, Uttarakhand štatā notiek glābšanas darbi, kur joprojām ir iesprostoti 41 strādnieks. Glābšanas komandas, tostarp ģeologi, inženieri, tuneļu un ģeotehniskie eksperti, izskata dažādas evakuācijas iespējas. Pēc spēcīgas plīsuma skaņas, kas piektdien tika sadzirdēta notikuma vietā, urbumi tika apturēti, jo radās bažas par iespējamu atkārtotu nogruvumu. Amatpersonas ir uzsākušas gatavošanos vertikāla urbuma izveidei no kalna virsotnes, un Border Roads Organisation cer līdz svētdienas pēcpusdienai pabeigt alternatīvu ceļu uz būvējamo tuneli. Austrālijas sertificētais inženieris un mikro-tuneļu eksperts Kriss Kūpers ir ieradies notikuma vietā, lai palīdzētu, turklāt konsultēti arī tuneļu speciālisti no Norvēģijas un Taizemes. Turpinās centieni nodrošināt iesprostoto strādnieku izdzīvošanu — caur caurulēm tiek piegādāts skābeklis, pārtika, elektrība un ūdens, regulāri komunicējot ar viņiem ar rāciju starpniecību. Pēc ekspertu ieteikuma izvēlēta 900 mm diametra tērauda caurule kā iespējama evakuācijas eja, izmantojot urbšanas iekārtas. Sākotnējā urbšanas iekārta izrādījās nepietiekama, tāpēc Indijas Gaisa spēki nogādāja uz Uttarakhand augstākas jaudas amerikāņu urbšanas iekārtu, kuras salikšanai bija nepieciešams papildu laiks. Piektdienas rītā glābēji ievietoja caur gruvešiem 22 metrus garu cauruli, taču urbšana tika apturēta pēc tam, kad jaunās iekārtas gultņi tika bojāti un platforma bija jāmodificē. Spēcīgas plīsuma skaņas šīs modifikācijas laikā izraisīja piesardzību un lika darbu apturēt, lai novērstu iespējamu atkārtotu nogruvumu. Vecākie amatpersonas un eksperti turpina meklēt alternatīvus risinājumus, jo urbšanas darbi rada vibrācijas, kas varētu palielināt risku. Papildus urbšanas iekārta tika atvesta uz vietu sestdienas agrā rītā, lai palīdzētu glābšanas operācijā. Iesprostotie strādnieki saņem nepieciešamās piegādes un saglabā saziņu ar glābējiem, kuri rūpīgi strādā, lai nodrošinātu drošu evakuāciju un pēc iespējas samazinātu riskus.

article_content: A new report by the King’s Fund think-tank recommends phasing out certain benefits for wealthier pensioners to finance significant reforms in England's social care system. This would affect benefits such as free prescriptions, TV licenses, and winter fuel payments, providing much-needed funding for the care of the increasing elderly population. The report, led by noted economist Dame Kate Barker, suggests focusing tax increases and contributions on people over 40 and those earning above £42,000, as well as pensioners who continue working. For the first time, working pensioners would be required to pay National Insurance. The report also urges a reevaluation of wealth-based taxes like inheritance tax, citing issues with frequent avoidance. Describing England’s care system as in 'crisis,' the report cites cases of financial distress among those facing high care costs, including bankruptcy. Dame Kate Barker highlighted projections that social care spending could nearly double as a percentage of GDP by 2025. She stated that providing proper care will require finding new funding sources. The King’s Fund called on major political parties to be transparent about the challenges posed by an aging population and to outline clear care strategies before the next election. Currently, people with more than £23,500 in assets must pay for their own care, forcing many to sell their homes. The existing government plan introduces a £72,000 cap on care payments, after which state support is provided, but the report argues this does not go far enough. The proposed plan would have well-off seniors contribute more to ensure fairer distribution of social care costs among those with varying care needs. Free social care would be granted to individuals assessed as having 'critical' needs by local councils. Raising the required £5 billion annually would involve tax increases and targeting benefit reductions. These include lowering the prescription charge to £2.50, but limiting free prescriptions to those with lower incomes—so many pensioners would lose eligibility. The report also recommends a 1% hike in National Insurance for everyone at age 40, as well as for those earning £42,000 or more. Working pensioners would start paying this tax too, albeit at a slightly lower rate. It calls for a comprehensive review of wealth and property taxes. Ros Altmann, the government’s Business Champion for Older Workers, warned that expanding means-testing for pensioner benefits could punish responsible savers. Professor Chris Ham from the King’s Fund acknowledged the ideas may be politically unpopular, but argued that tackling these issues is urgent. A government spokesperson confirmed that there are no current plans to alter National Insurance contributions or existing benefits for pensioners.
translated_content: Jauns King’s Fund think-tank ziņojums iesaka atcelt noteiktus labumus turīgākiem pensionāriem, lai finansētu būtiskas reformas Anglijas sociālās aprūpes sistēmā. Tas skartu tādus labumus kā bezmaksas receptes, TV licenci un ziemas apkures pabalstu, kas dotu nepieciešamo finansējumu pieaugošā senioru skaita aprūpei. Ziņojumu vadīja ievērojamā ekonomiste Deima Keita Bārkere, un tas rosina palielināt nodokļus cilvēkiem pēc 40 gadu vecuma un tiem, kas pelna virs £42,000, kā arī pensionāriem, kuri turpina strādāt. Pirmo reizi strādājošajiem pensionāriem būtu jāmaksā nacionālās apdrošināšanas iemaksas. Ziņojumā tiek aicināts arī pārskatīt mantas un mantojuma nodokļus, norādot, ka tos bieži apiet. Raksturojot Anglijas aprūpes sistēmu kā 'krīzē esošu', ziņojums min finanšu grūtības, ar kurām saskaras cilvēki ar lielām aprūpes izmaksām, tostarp bankrotu gadījumus. Deima Keita Bārkere uzsver prognozes, ka līdz 2025. gadam sociālās aprūpes izdevumi varētu gandrīz dubultoties kā daļa no IKP. Viņa norāda, ka būs nepieciešams rast jaunus finansējuma avotus, lai nodrošinātu atbilstošu aprūpi ikvienam. King’s Fund aicina lielās politiskās partijas būt atklātām par novecošanas izaicinājumiem un pirms nākamajām vēlēšanām sniegt skaidru aprūpes sistēmas plānu. Patlaban cilvēkiem ar aktīviem virs £23,500 pašiem jāmaksā par aprūpi un daudzi spiesti pārdot mājas. Valdība ievieš ierobežojumu — maksimāli £72,000 personai, pēc kura valsts sedz atlikušo, taču ziņojums norāda, ka ar to nepietiek. Priekšlikums paredz, ka turīgākie seniori sniegs lielāku ieguldījumu, tādējādi taisnīgāk sadalot aprūpes izmaksas starp tiem, kuriem ir dažādas vajadzības. Bezmaksas sociālā aprūpe tiktu piešķirta personām, kuras pašvaldības atzinušas par ar 'kritiskām' vajadzībām. Lai savāktu vajadzīgos 5 miljardus mārciņu gadā, tiek ierosināts palielināt nodokļus un samazināt atsevišķus labumus, tostarp samazināt recepšu maksu līdz £2.50, bet bezmaksas medikamentus nodrošināt tikai mazāku ienākumu pensionāriem. Ziņojumā arī ieteikts palielināt nacionālās apdrošināšanas likmi par 1% visiem no 40 gadu vecuma un tiem, kas pelna £42,000 vai vairāk. Strādājošajiem pensionāriem būtu jāmaksā šis nodoklis, kaut nedaudz zemākā likmē. Tiek aicināts pilnībā pārskatīt īpašuma un mantas nodokļus. Valdības vecāko darba ņēmēju padomdevēja Roz Altmena brīdina, ka plašāka līdzekļu izvērtēšana var sodīt apzinīgi taupītājus. King’s Fund profesors Kriss Hems atzīst, ka šie priekšlikumi var nebūt populāri politiķu vidū, bet uzskata, ka problēma ir steidzami jārisina. Valdības pārstāvis norādīja, ka šobrīd nav plānots mainīt nacionālās apdrošināšanas iemaksas vai pensionāru tiesības uz pašreizējiem labumiem.

article_content: A recent study suggests that spending your holiday relaxing by the pool or napping might actually make it harder to adjust to work life afterward. The research, commissioned by SWISS and involving British workers, found that 82% of people struggled to get back into their routine after a holiday, taking about four days to recover. In contrast, those who chose active holidays—like skiing, hiking, or swimming—often felt ready to return to work after just one day. Many participants admitted that lazy holidays left them feeling tired and sluggish, with 31% taking longer to finish tasks, 25% forgetting job responsibilities, and about 10% missing important deadlines. Additionally, more than one in five reported oversleeping, and 17% made mistakes at work after their break. Nearly a quarter said colleagues or managers had commented on their slow recovery. The research showed that 60% blamed their slow return to normal productivity on being stuck in a 'holiday frame of mind,' while 45% said it was difficult re-adapting to everyday tasks after relaxing for days. Over two-thirds came back feeling sluggish, and 84% returned from vacation still wishing for more time off. Almost half of the workers struggled so much after returning that they booked extra leave, and one in four admitted to calling in sick to extend their holiday. Felix Rodel, director at SWISS UK & Ireland, noted that relaxing holidays may sound appealing but can actually leave people feeling low in energy. In contrast, active holidays tend to leave people feeling refreshed and ready for the challenges ahead. More than half of people who experienced both types of holidays agreed that they felt better after taking an activity-focused break.
translated_content: Nesen veikts pētījums liecina, ka atvaļinājuma pavadīšana, vienkārši atpūšoties pie baseina vai drzemot, patiesībā var apgrūtināt atgriešanos darbā. SWISS pasūtītajā pētījumā, kurā piedalījās Lielbritānijas darbinieki, atklājās, ka 82% cilvēku pēc atvaļinājuma ir grūti atgūt ikdienas ritmu, un pilnīgai atlabšanai nepieciešamas apmēram četras dienas. Savukārt tie, kuri izvēlas aktīvas brīvdienas—piemēram, slēpošanu, pārgājienus vai peldēšanu—bieži vien atgriežas darbā jau pēc vienas dienas. Daudzi respondenti atzina, ka slinkās brīvdienas viņus atstāja nogurušus un lēnīgus, 31% pēc atvaļinājuma pabeidz darba uzdevumus ilgāk, 25% aizmirst darba pienākumus, un apmēram 10% palaiž garām svarīgus termiņus. Turklāt vairāk nekā viens no pieciem pēc atgriešanās pārguļ, un 17% pieļauj kļūdas darbā. Gandrīz ceturtā daļa norādīja, ka kolēģi vai vadība komentējuši par ilgo atgūšanos pēc brīvdienām. Pētījumā noskaidrots, ka 60% savu lēno produktivitātes atgriešanos saista ar to, ka joprojām ir 'atvaļinājuma noskaņojumā', kamēr 45% ir grūti pierast pie ikdienas pienākumiem. Vairāk nekā divas trešdaļas pēc brīvdienām jutās lēni, un 84% vēlējās vēl vairāk brīvdienu. Gandrīz pusei bija tik grūti pēc atgriešanās, ka viņi noformēja papildu brīvdienas, un katrs ceturtais atzina, ka ir piezvanījis slimības dēļ, lai pagarinātu atvaļinājumu. Felikss Rodels, SWISS Lielbritānijā un Īrijā direktors, norādīja, ka relaksējošas brīvdienas var izklausīties pievilcīgas, taču patiesībā tās var atstāt cilvēku bez enerģijas. Tikmēr aktīvas brīvdienas ļauj atgriezties darbā ar lielāku mundrumu un gatavību jauniem izaicinājumiem. Vairāk nekā puse respondentu, kuri izmēģinājuši abu veidu brīvdienas, atzina, ka pēc aktīva atvaļinājuma jūtas atjaunojušies.

article_content: Kevin Pietersen has brought more attention to the discussion around English cricket pitch conditions by accusing an MCC groundsman of intentionally dragging his foot across the pitch during a break in play on Saturday. On the same day, news emerged that Nottinghamshire might be fined £9,000 after Trent Bridge's Test pitch was rated as 'poor.' Pietersen posted a short video on Instagram, apparently showing groundsman Shane Doherty sliding his foot over an important area of the pitch before being stopped by another staff member. Pietersen tweeted, ‘UNBELIEVABLE!’ followed by, ‘I cannot believe what I’ve just seen from one of the groundstaff!’ MCC stated that Doherty's action was an honest mistake, with no intent to damage the wicket. Head groundsman Mick Hunt suggested he might have simply been affected by the sun. Match referee David Boon classified the pitch as 'poor,' potentially resulting in a Nottinghamshire fine if the ICC concurs. Some England players were reportedly critical of the pitch, one describing it as even more 'sub-continental' than many sub-continental grounds. Michael Vaughan questioned the intent behind Doherty’s actions, while Liam Plunkett and James Anderson helped England improve their position in the second Test.

article_content: Hosting Thanksgiving is a big task, especially when it comes to making sure everyone enjoys the drinks. While the turkey may take center stage, planning your beverage selection is essential. Here are 10 tips to help hosts keep drinks flowing smoothly and ensure guests have a great time. 1. Start with a welcome cocktail. Instead of asking each guest for their drink order, greet them with a pre-made beverage when they arrive. Choose one popular option, like a Cosmopolitan or French 75, and make it in batches beforehand. 2. Test your cocktails in advance. If you're not an experienced mixologist, prepare your chosen drink the day before to practice and confirm it’s a good choice. 3. Clean and set out your barware ahead of time. Avoid searching for or cleaning glasses last-minute while juggling other kitchen duties. Clean your glasses in advance and use a proper brush to avoid any mishaps. 4. Use top-quality ingredients. The ingredients you use will affect the final taste. Select quality tonics or sodas—Fever-Tree is a great option—and always use freshly squeezed juice for cocktails. Skip the pre-made mixers for a true craft experience. 5. Offer a pitcher of water for guests. With great cocktails, guests might drink quickly. Having water available helps everyone stay hydrated. 6. Don’t forget garnishes. Ingredients like citrus wedges, berries, mint, or rosemary add both visual appeal and flavor to your drinks. Add these to your shopping list to enhance your cocktails. 7. Use proper bar tools. Essential items include a cocktail shaker, strainer, mixing glass, and a jigger for measuring. These tools make a big difference and don’t have to be expensive. 8. Discard expired spirits. Not all alcohol lasts forever—especially fruit-flavored spirits. Check your bottles and toss anything that’s been sitting too long. 9. Make sure you have enough ice. Running out of ice is a quick way to halt the party. Stock up in advance and consider using ice molds for a special touch. 10. Dress smartly and serve with confidence. Hosting can be stressful, but taking time to dress well and prepare drinks can help you feel more confident. Your guests will appreciate the effort and the great beverages. Remember to toast with eye contact and have a happy Thanksgiving!
translated_content: Pateicības dienas rīkošana ir liels uzdevums, īpaši tad, ja jāparūpējas par to, lai visi izbaudītu dzērienus. Lai gan tītars parasti ir svētku centrā, arī dzērienu izvēle ir ļoti svarīga. Te būs 10 padomi, kā nodrošināt lielisku atmosfēru un parūpēties, lai dzērieni nekad netrūktu. 1. Sagaidiet viesus ar īpašu kokteili. Tā vietā, lai no katra prasītu dzēriena izvēli, sagaidiet viņus ar jau sagatavotu dzērienu. Izvēlieties ko populāru, piemēram, Cosmopolitan vai French 75, un pagatavojiet daudzumu iepriekš. 2. Izmēģiniet kokteili iepriekš. Ja neesat pieredzējis bārmenis, pagatavojiet izvēlēto dzērienu dienu pirms svētkiem, lai uztrenētos un pārliecinātos par izvēli. 3. Notīriet un sagatavojiet bāra piederumus savlaicīgi. Izvairieties no steigšus tīrīšanas vai meklēšanas, kad viesi jau ierodas. Izmazgājiet visu savlaicīgi ar piemērotu birsti, lai izvairītos no nelaimes gadījumiem. 4. Izvēlieties kvalitatīvas sastāvdaļas. Izmantotie produkti ietekmē galarezultātu. Labas limonādes vai toniki – piemēram, Fever-Tree – un svaigi spiesta sula padarīs kokteili īpašu. Izvairieties no rūpnieciskiem maisījumiem. 5. Pasniedziet kannu ar ūdeni. Ja kokteiļi ir lieliski, viesi var dzert ātrāk, tāpēc ūdens palīdzēs visiem justies labi. 6. Neaizmirstiet par garnējumu. Citrona šķēles, ogas, piparmētra vai rozmarīns uzlabo gan garšu, gan izskatu. Pievienojiet tos iepirkumu sarakstam. 7. Izmantojiet piemērotus bāra rīkus. Šeikeris, sietiņš, jaukšanas glāze un mērtrauks jeb jiggers būs noderīgi. Tiem nav jābūt dārgiem, bet tie atvieglo darbu. 8. Izmetiet beigušos stipros dzērienus. Ne viss alkohols glabājas mūžīgi, īpaši augļu liķieri. Pārskatiet krājumus un izmetiet nederīgos. 9. Iepriekš sagādājiet ledu. Ja ledus beigsies, svinības var apstāties. Pērciet to iepriekš un vajadzības gadījumā izmantojiet īpašas ledus formas. 10. Saģērbieties svinīgi un pasniedziet dzērienus ar pārliecību. Svinības var būt satraucošas, bet rūpīga gatavošanās un labs izskats palīdz justies pārliecinātākam. Draudzīgi sasveicinieties, skatoties acīs, un priecīgu Pateicības dienu!

article_content: Lara Yunaska, engaged to Eric Trump, recently broke both her wrists in a horse riding accident just two weeks before their wedding. The 31-year-old CBS producer has been sharing updates on her recovery with her followers on Instagram, humorously referring to her stitched arm as a 'built-in' Halloween costume. The accident occurred last Thursday, ahead of her November 8 wedding to Eric Trump, son of businessman Donald Trump. Despite the typical six-to-eight-week healing period for such injuries, Lara is optimistic that the ceremony will proceed as planned at the Trump-owned Mar-a-Lago club in Palm Beach, Florida. On Instagram, she wrote, 'Wedding countdown: 2 weeks and 2 casts to go! #HopeImAFastHealer.' Lara first revealed her injuries with a selfie from her bed, joking about the difficulty of taking a selfie with two broken wrists. She continues to update her followers with positive messages, expressing gratitude for her friends and dog who help her daily. Lara has said the accident will not stop her from riding in the future, writing, 'There are inherent risks in life. When you truly love something, it's worth it.' She emphasized that her main focus remains marrying Eric on November 8. The couple, together for six years, announced their engagement last July when Eric proposed at the Trump Seven Springs estate in Bedford, New York. Wedding celebrations include a wine tasting at the Trump Winery on November 7, a black-tie ceremony at Mar-a-Lago on November 8, and a brunch on Sunday. Lara, originally from Wilmington, North Carolina, graduated from North Carolina State University and has a degree in Pastry Arts from the French Culinary Institute. Donald Trump expressed support for Lara, noting the challenge of fitting her casts into her wedding dress but affirming that the ring exchange would not be affected. He said, 'She's really strong, and they care for each other, so that's what matters.'

article_content: The Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) claimed on Thursday that party MLAs Jarnail Singh and Haji Yunus, along with several volunteers, were detained by Delhi Police while participating in the Delhi government's 'Red Light On, Gaadi Off' campaign. The ruling party further accused the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) of using the police to hinder its efforts to combat pollution. Neither Delhi Police nor the BJP provided an immediate response.  The 'Red Light On, Gaadi Off' campaign encourages motorists to turn off their vehicles while waiting at red traffic signals to reduce emissions. In a post on X (formerly Twitter), the AAP questioned, 'Why do BJP people love pollution? The BJP stoops to a new low in politics every day. The BJP is crushing the AAP's efforts to curb pollution with the help of police. AAP MLA @JarnailSinghAAP and Haji Yunus detained by BJP police for spreading awareness. What could be more shameful than this?' The party also circulated images showing Singh and Yunus being detained.  Haji Yunus, Mustafabad MLA, stated he was detained by police at the Gokalpuri roundabout, writing on X, 'After stopping the Red Light On, Gaadi Off campaign against pollution, Delhi Police detained (me) from the Gokalpuri roundabout. Currently at the police station with my friends.'  At a press conference, Delhi Environment Minister Gopal Rai described it as 'unfortunate' that the BJP allegedly deployed Delhi Police to halt the government’s campaign. He noted, 'The campaign began on October 26 at ITO. On November 2, it was supposed to be held across all 70 assembly constituencies. But our MLA Jarnail Singh was detained. Since morning, councillors, volunteers, and MLAs are being detained. If people are wearing black bands, why are they (BJP) afraid?' Rai, who is also the AAP's Delhi state convener, commented.  The Delhi government initially launched the 'Red Light On, Gaadi Off' campaign on October 16, 2020. According to government estimates, vehicular emissions account for 80 percent of nitrogen oxides and carbon monoxide in Delhi's air. On Thursday, a smoky haze covered Delhi for the third consecutive day, with many areas recording 'severe' air quality levels.

article_content: Young people in China are increasingly frustrated with limited job opportunities, leading some to become 'full-time children,' engage in 'lying flat,' or withdraw from the workforce. This trend poses a significant challenge for China and could have global economic repercussions, including for the US. China's economy is facing difficulties after strict COVID-19 lockdowns, with slower trade and roughly $9 trillion in debt threatening financial stability. The country also struggles to integrate its young college graduates into the workforce. The youth unemployment rate in China for those aged 16 to 24 reached a record 21% in May 2023, up from 15.4% two years earlier. In comparison, the US youth unemployment rate was 7.4% in May. Persistent youth unemployment in China may reduce its productivity and disrupt international supply chains, affecting countries such as the US, which remains highly reliant on Chinese goods and services. Despite some efforts to reduce dependence on Chinese trade, China is still the third-largest export market for the US. In 2022, US exports to China totaled $197.3 billion, a 2.8% increase over 2021, while imports from China reached $563.6 billion, up 7.1% from 2021. Following the release of concerning youth unemployment data in May, China's government stopped publishing these statistics. A spokesperson from China's National Bureau of Statistics said in August that data collection methods 'need to be further improved and optimized.' This move drew criticism and skepticism on Chinese social media, with users openly expressing their disapproval. Benn Steil, a senior fellow at the Council on Foreign Relations, stated that China's difficulty in creating service sector jobs has resulted in educated youth being unable to find employment in their fields. He attributes this to poor economic management and warns that continued mismanagement could reduce export opportunities for US businesses. Christian Yao of Victoria University of Wellington wrote that persistent youth unemployment in China might heighten risks of social instability and impact global trade by disrupting supply chains. A report from the China Macroeconomy Forum warned that the youth employment crisis could last another decade and worsen in the near term unless there is significant progress aligning graduate skills with available jobs. The New York Times noted that mishandling the crisis could cause broader social and political issues. Unlike during the US job-skills mismatch at the height of the COVID-19 pandemic—when American workers negotiated higher wages and filled shortages—China's government is not prioritizing the expansion of service sector jobs and continues investing in traditional sectors like property and construction. Alfred Wu, associate professor at the National University of Singapore, said that nearly three years of intermittent lockdowns and ongoing economic uncertainty have eroded young people's confidence in China's governance. He likened the current mood to Japan's 'Lost Decade' after the asset bubble burst in the early 1990s. Goldman Sachs researchers pointed out that young people are especially vulnerable during economic downturns because of their limited work experience and a mismatch between their skills and available jobs, increasing their exposure to uncertainty. They stressed the importance of correcting these imbalances, as young people are a vital part of China's economy. Due to limited job opportunities, some young graduates now become 'full-time children'—a popular social media term describing adult children who stay home and support their parents because they can't find suitable work. One such person told NBC News this was an involuntary yet necessary choice. Benn Steil warned that continued high youth unemployment could prompt emigration, with more Chinese students studying and possibly remaining abroad, which could ultimately harm China's future. He emphasized that the unemployment crisis disproportionately affects younger generations, making it a critical issue for the country's prospects.
translated_content: Jaunie cilvēki Ķīnā arvien biežāk ir neapmierināti ar ierobežotajām darba iespējām, tāpēc daži kļūst par “pilna laika bērniem”, izvēlas attieksmi “gulties plakani” vai atkāpjas no darba tirgus. Šī tendence rada nozīmīgu izaicinājumu Ķīnai un varētu radīt globālas ekonomiskas sekas, tostarp arī ASV. Ķīnas ekonomika saskaras ar grūtībām pēc stingriem COVID-19 ierobežojumiem – tirdzniecība ir palēninājusies, un aptuveni 9 triljoni dolāru liels parāds apdraud finanšu stabilitāti. Valstij ir grūtības integrēt jauniešus ar augstāko izglītību darba tirgū. Ķīnas jauniešu bezdarba līmenis vecuma grupā no 16 līdz 24 gadiem 2023. gada maijā sasniedza rekordlielus 21 %, kas ir kāpums no 15,4 % pirms diviem gadiem. ASV jauniešu bezdarbs tajā pašā laikā bija tikai 7,4 %. Ilgstoši augsts jauniešu bezdarba līmenis Ķīnā var samazināt produktivitāti un izjaukt globālās piegādes ķēdes, ietekmējot tādas valstis kā ASV, kas joprojām ir ļoti atkarīgas no Ķīnas precēm un pakalpojumiem. Neskatoties uz dažiem mēģinājumiem mazināt atkarību no Ķīnas tirdzniecības, Ķīna joprojām ir trešā lielākā ASV eksporta tirgus. 2022. gadā ASV eksports uz Ķīnu bija 197,3 miljardi dolāru, kas ir par 2,8 % vairāk nekā 2021. gadā, bet imports sasniedza 563,6 miljardus dolāru (par 7,1 % vairāk nekā iepriekšējā gadā). Pēc satraucošo bezdarba datu publicēšanas maijā Ķīnas valdība pārtrauca šo statistikas datu publicēšanu. Ķīnas Nacionālās statistikas pārvaldes pārstāvis augustā paziņoja, ka datu vākšanas metodes 'jāuzlabo un jāoptimizē'. Šis lēmums izraisīja kritiku un skepsi vietējos sociālajos tīklos, kur lietotāji atklāti pauda savu neapmierinātību. Bens Stīls, Ārlietu padomes vecākais pētnieks, norādīja, ka Ķīnas problēma radīt darba vietas pakalpojumu sektorā novedusi pie tā, ka izglītoti jaunieši nevar atrast darbu savā jomā. Viņš to saista ar sliktu ekonomisko pārvaldību un brīdina, ka šāda pieeja var mazināt ASV uzņēmumu eksporta iespējas. Kristians Jao no Velingtonas Viktorijas universitātes rakstīja, ka ilgstošs jauniešu bezdarbs Ķīnā var palielināt sociālās nestabilitātes risku un ietekmēt globālo tirdzniecību, izjaucot piegādes ķēdes. Ķīnas Makroekonomikas Foruma ziņojumā norādīts, ka jauniešu nodarbinātības krīze varētu ilgt vēl desmit gadus un tuvākajā laikā vēl pastiprināties, ja netiks panākts būtisks progress attiecībā uz augstskolu absolventu prasmju atbilstību pieprasījumam darba tirgū. The New York Times piebilda, ka krīzes nepareiza risināšana var radīt vēl plašākas sociālās un politiskās problēmas. Atšķirībā no ASV darba tirgus neatbilstības pandēmijas laikā, kad amerikāņi varēja sarunāt augstākas algas un aizpildīt trūkstošās darba vietas, Ķīnas valdība neuzsver pakalpojumu sektora paplašināšanu, bet turpina ieguldīt tradicionālos sektoros, piemēram, īpašumos un būvniecībā. Alfrēds Vu, Singapūras Nacionālās universitātes asociētais profesors, sacīja, ka gandrīz trīs gadu ilgās pārtraukto ierobežojumu un pastāvīgas ekonomiskās nenoteiktības rezultātā jauno cilvēku uzticība Ķīnas pārvaldībai ir mazinājusies. Viņš salīdzināja pašreizējo situāciju ar Japānas 'zaudēto desmitgadi' pēc aktīvu cenas burbuļa plīšanas 1990. gados. Goldman Sachs pētnieki atzīmēja, ka jaunieši ir īpaši ievainojami ekonomisko lejupslīžu laikā pieredzes un prasmju neatbilstības dēļ, tādējādi palielinās viņu nenoteiktība. Viņi uzsvēra šo neatbilstību novēršanas nozīmi, jo jaunieši ir būtiska Ķīnas ekonomikas daļa. Darba iespēju trūkuma dēļ daļa absolventu kļūst par 'pilna laika bērniem'—populārs sociālajos tīklos lietots apzīmējums pieaugušajiem bērniem, kas dzīvo kopā ar vecākiem un viņus atbalsta, nespējot atrast darbu pēc savas specialitātes. Kāda no viņiem NBC News sacīja, ka tā nav brīvprātīga, bet nepieciešama izvēle. Bens Stīls brīdināja, ka saglabājoties augstam jauniešu bezdarbam, var pieaugt emigrācija—vairāk ķīniešu studentu varētu studēt un palikt ārzemēs, kas nodarītu kaitējumu Ķīnas nākotnei. Viņš uzsvēra, ka bezdarba krīze nesamērīgi skar jaunāko paaudzi, padarot to par kritiski svarīgu jautājumu valstij.

article_content: A recent video from China has stirred controversy by showing a toddler, believed to be around two or three years old, smoking a cigarette openly on a crowded street. While many adults were nearby, no one intervened; instead, some laughed as the child smoked. The footage, shared on liveleak.com, has renewed debate about the prevalence of tobacco use in China. Approximately 30% of the Chinese population—roughly 300 million people—are smokers, and over half of Chinese men reportedly use tobacco. The government has taken steps to curb smoking, including banning it in public places like schools and hospitals. A similar incident happened previously when a two-year-old named Tong Liangliang was filmed smoking after his father encouraged him, reportedly to ease hernia pain. These events underscore ongoing concerns about tobacco exposure and cultural attitudes toward smoking in China.

The U.S. Supreme Court is set to hear arguments Tuesday on the legality of a federal law, in place for 30 years, that bars individuals under domestic violence restraining orders from possessing firearms. The high-profile case, U.S. v. Rahimi, challenges a widely supported gun safety regulation and could reshape the intersection of the Second Amendment and efforts to curb gun violence, as firearms remain a leading cause in intimate partner violence nationwide.

According to the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, an estimated 12 million American adults experience domestic abuse each year, with about 70 dying each month in shootings involving intimate partners. The Johns Hopkins Center for Gun Violence Solutions reports that the presence of a firearm increases a woman's risk of being killed in a domestic abuse situation by five times.

This Supreme Court review arrives a year after justices ruled that only firearm laws consistent with the nation's historical tradition should be upheld. Legal observers note that this case might clarify how that standard applies to domestic abusers. "This is an opportunity for the justices to clarify the test, particularly as it relates to domestic abusers and other effective gun violence prevention laws," said Kelly Roskam, director of law and policy at the Center for Gun Violence Solutions.

The 1994 law under review requires federal and state judges to report restraining orders to the national background check system, which then serves as a basis for denying firearm sales. Since 1998, the FBI says more than 77,000 attempted gun purchases by alleged domestic abusers have been blocked. "We know it's not just intimate partners killing partners; it's being done with firearms, and these laws are preventing that," Roskam added.

The law is being challenged by Zackey Rahimi, a Texas resident with a record of violence, who was indicted for illegal gun possession while subject to a protective order obtained by his girlfriend. Rahimi contends the law lacks historical precedent. The Fifth Circuit Court of Appeals agreed, calling the rule an "outlier" our ancestors would not have accepted. Supporting Rahimi, Gun Owners of America argues that the law disarms some people who may not be dangerous, particularly those under mutual restraining orders. "We're fighting for the victims here who are disarmed by mutual restraining orders," said Aidan Johnston, a lobbyist for the group.

The Biden administration is defending the law, arguing that America's legislative history includes barring dangerous or irresponsible individuals from having firearms, even if there's not a direct historic equivalent targeting domestic abusers. "American legislatures have long disarmed individuals they found dangerous, irresponsible, or otherwise unfit to possess arms," the government stated in legal filings.

The Supreme Court, with its six-justice conservative majority, has generally leaned toward broad Second Amendment interpretations and closely scrutinized gun laws. However, at least two justices have indicated some support for reasonable restrictions. Justice Brett Kavanaugh, in a concurring opinion in last year's New York State Rifle and Pistol Association v. Bruen case, wrote that the Second Amendment allows "a variety" of gun regulations. Justice Amy Coney Barrett has also previously written that certain restrictions on "dangerous people" are constitutional.

A decision in the Rahimi case is expected by June 2024.

Šis izskatīšanas gadījums notiek gadu pēc tam, kad Augstākā tiesa nolēma, ka pieļaujamas tikai tādas šaujamieroču regulas, kas ir saderīgas ar ASV vēsturisko tradīciju. Juridiskie eksperti norāda, ka šī lieta varētu precizēt, kā šis standarts piemērojams likumiem attiecībā uz vardarbības ģimenē vainīgajiem. "Šī ir iespēja tiesnešiem precizēt kritērijus, īpaši attiecībā uz vardarbības ģimenē vainīgajiem un citiem efektīviem vardarbības ar ieročiem novēršanas likumiem," sacīja Kellija Roskama, Šaujamieroču vardarbības risinājumu centra tiesību un politikas direktore.

1994. gada likums prasa, lai tiesneši federālajā un štatu līmenī ierobežojošos rīkojumus ziņotu nacionālajai fona pārbaudes sistēmai, kas tiek izmantota atteikumu pamatošanai šaujamieroču pārdošanā. Kopš 1998. gada FBI ziņo, ka vairāk nekā 77 000 mēģinājumi iegādāties ieročus no aizdomās turamiem vardarbības ģimenē izdarītājiem ir liegti. "Mēs zinām, ka tas nav tikai partneru slepkavības; tas tiek darīts ar šaujamieročiem, un šie likumi neļauj tam notikt," norāda Roskama.

Likumu apstrīd Zākijs Rahimi, Teksasas iedzīvotājs ar vardarbīgas uzvedības pagātni, kurš tika apsūdzēts par nelikumīgu šaujamieroča glabāšanu aizsargājoša rīkojuma laikā, kuru pret viņu bija pieprasījusi draudzene. Rahimi apgalvo, ka šim likumam nav vēsturiska pamata. Piektās apgabala apelācijas tiesa atzina šo likumu par "anomāliju," ko mūsu senči nebūtu akceptējuši. Rahimi atbalsta "Gun Owners of America," kas uzskata, ka šis likums atņem ieročus arī tiem, kas nav bīstami, piemēram, savstarpēju ierobežojošo rīkojumu gadījumos. "Mēs cīnāmies par upuriem, kuri tiek atbruņoti savstarpējo ierobežojošo rīkojumu rezultātā," skaidroja Eidans Džonstons, grupas lobists.

Baidenas administrācija aizstāv šo likumu, uzsverot, ka ASV vēsturiski ir ierobežojusi bīstamu vai uzskatāmu par bezatbildīgiem personu ieroču apriti, pat ja nav tiešas analoģijas ar likumiem pret vardarbības ģimenē izdarītājiem. "Amerikas likumdevēji jau sen ir atbruņojuši tos, kurus uzskatījuši par bīstamiem, bezatbildīgiem vai citādi nederīgiem ieroču turēšanai," pausts valdības tiesas dokumentos.

ASV Augstākajai tiesai ir sešu konservatīvo vairākums, kas bieži noskaņoti paplašināt Otrā grozījuma piemērošanu un pamatīgi pārskata ieroču regulējumu. Tomēr vismaz divi tiesneši ir pauduši atbalstu konkrētiem ierobežojumiem. Tiesnesis Brets Kavanau, papildopinijā lietā "New York State Rifle and Pistol Association v. Bruen", norādīja, ka Otrais grozījums pieļauj "dažādus" ieroču regulējumus. Tiesnese Eimija Konija Bareta agrāk uzsvērusi, ka noteikti ierobežojumi "bīstamām personām" ir piemēroti Konstitūcijai.

Spriedums Rahimi lietā gaidāms līdz 2024. gada jūnijam.

article_content: The White House on Tuesday expressed confidence that the U.S. will ultimately provide additional assistance to Ukraine, regardless of developments in Congress. However, officials warned that, without progress, current funding could be exhausted within "a couple of months." Congress did not approve extra Ukraine aid in the recent government funding bill passed over the weekend. House Speaker Kevin McCarthy's position remains uncertain, but White House national security spokesman John Kirby said he was still hopeful. "All House leadership supports continuing aid to Ukraine, and the majority of House Republicans back this as well," Kirby said. "A small, vocal minority opposes it, but they do not represent their party or its leadership." Without new aid, the U.S. can only continue funding Ukraine at current levels for about "a couple of months," Kirby noted. The precise duration depends on forthcoming battlefield developments and Ukraine's evolving needs. On Monday, the White House indicated it could meet Ukraine's battlefield needs "for a bit longer." Kirby clarified he needed more time to define "a bit," but said that a "couple of months" was likely accurate. On Tuesday morning, President Joe Biden called allies to update them on Congressional developments and reassure them of ongoing bipartisan support for Ukraine. Kirby said none of the foreign leaders expressed concern about continued U.S. assistance, understanding the situation involves only a minority of Congressional Republicans. Funding for Ukraine has been a point of contention in Rep. Matt Gaetz's effort to remove McCarthy as Speaker. Gaetz accused McCarthy of making a secret deal with Biden to secure Democratic support and avoid a government shutdown, but McCarthy has denied these claims. Biden, who has stressed the importance of supporting Ukraine, responded to a reporter's question about trusting McCarthy on future deals by saying, “We just made one about Ukraine. So, we'll find out.” The White House has not clarified which deal Biden meant, instead highlighting McCarthy’s public support for military aid to Kyiv. Kirby told ABC News' Selina Wang that reduced U.S. support could undermine Ukraine’s ability to defend itself and allow Russia to regain momentum in its invasion. He acknowledged Ukraine’s counteroffensive has not met expectations, noting that winter will further challenge their efforts. "Time is not our friend," Kirby said, emphasizing the urgency of supporting Ukraine and sending a strong message to Russian President Vladimir Putin. "Even a short lapse in support could make a significant difference on the battlefield and encourage Putin to believe he can outlast us."

Baidens, vairākkārt uzsverot Ukrainas finansējuma nozīmību, atbildēja žurnālista jautājumam par to, vai iespējams uzticēties Makartijam nākotnes darījumos: “Mēs tieši noslēdzām vienu par Ukrainu. Kērbijs ABC News žurnālistei Selīnai Vanai sacīja: samazināts ASV atbalsts var vājināt Ukrainas aizsardzības spēju un ļaut Krievijai iegūt virsroku iebrukumā. Viņš norādīja, ka pretuzbrukums nav noritējis tik veiksmīgi, kā gaidījuši ukraiņi, un ka ziema to vēl vairāk apgrūtinās. "Laiks nav mūsu pusē," teica Kērbijs, akcentējot atbalsta steidzamību Ukrainai un nepieciešamību skaidri signalizēt Krievijas prezidentam Vladimiram Putinam. article_content: Michel Platini, the UEFA President, has confirmed he will remain in his current role and will not challenge Sepp Blatter for the FIFA Presidency. Platini called a meeting of all 54 European football federations in Monaco to announce his decision to stand for another term as UEFA President next year, despite being seen as UEFA's strongest candidate to oppose Blatter for the FIFA role. Platini emphasized that he wants to continue his work with UEFA, making it clear that he will not run for FIFA President. With Platini out of the race, it is widely expected that Blatter will be re-elected for a further four-year term in 2015, as he already has the backing of five football confederations worldwide. Platini stated: 'This was my choice, based on my passion. Maybe one day I will move on, but not yet. I want to fulfill my contract with UEFA, which still has a few years left. I chose from my heart, from football, and from passion. I am more dedicated than ever to developing football in Europe.' Contrary to expectations from some delegates, Platini took a less confrontational stance toward FIFA and Blatter. Platini said: 'European football has never been stronger. My objective is not to attack FIFA, as some might have expected. My focus is UEFA and only UEFA. I hope someone will oppose Mr. Blatter, but it will not be me.' Previously, Platini had called for a 'breath of fresh air' at the top of FIFA. However, he added: 'I have helped Mr. Blatter in the past, but I will not support him in the next election. It is not about UEFA against FIFA. I still respect Mr. Blatter, but I will not support him in 2015.' Now, having confirmed his commitment to UEFA, Platini urges European unity in FIFA's executive decision-making. He said: 'UEFA's members on FIFA's Executive Committee should bring ideas to the table. They should not simply agree with everything and allow Mr. Blatter to dominate.' In 2007, Platini and Blatter were pictured smiling together while playing in a charity match with Franz Beckenbauer.
translated_content: UEFA prezidents Mišels Platinī ir apstiprinājis, ka paliks savā amatā un neizaicinās Zepu Blateru uz FIFA prezidenta amatu. Platinī sasauca visu 54 Eiropas futbola federāciju pārstāvjus Monako, lai paziņotu, ka nākamgad kandidēs uz vēl vienu termiņu kā UEFA prezidents, lai gan viņš tika uzskatīts par spēcīgāko kandidātu, lai sacenstos ar Blateru FIFA vēlēšanās. Platinī uzsvēra vēlmi turpināt darbu UEFA un skaidri paziņoja, ka nekandidēs uz FIFA prezidenta amatu. Ar Platinī izstāšanos no sacensības tiek plaši uzskatīts, ka Blaters 2015. gadā tiks pārvēlēts uz vēl vienu četru gadu termiņu, jo viņam jau ir piecu futbola konfederāciju atbalsts pasaulē. Platinī sacīja: 'Tā bija mana izvēle, balstīta uz manu aizrautību. Varbūt kādreiz es došos tālāk, bet vēl nē. Es vēlos pabeigt savu līgumu ar UEFA, kuram vēl ir daži gadi atlikušies. Es izvēlējos no sirds, no futbola un no aizrautības. Esmu vēl vairāk apņēmības pilns attīstīt futbolu Eiropā.' Pretēji dažu delegātu gaidītajam, Platinī ieņēma mazāk konfrontējošu nostāju pret FIFA un Blateru. Platinī sacīja: 'Eiropas futbols nekad nav bijis stiprāks. Mans mērķis nav uzbrukt FIFA, kā daži varbūt gaidīja. Mana uzmanība ir vērsta tikai uz UEFA. Ceru, ka kāds izvirzīsies pret Blateru, bet tas nebūšu es.' Iepriekš Platinī bija aicinājis ieviest 'jaunas vēsmas' FIFA vadībā. Tomēr viņš piebilda: 'Esmu palīdzējis Blateram iepriekš, bet nākamajās vēlēšanās viņu neatbalstīšu. Tas nav par UEFA pret FIFA. Es joprojām cienu Blateru, bet 2015. gadā viņu neatbalstīšu.' Tagad, apstiprinājis savu apņēmību palikt UEFA, Platinī aicina Eiropas vienotību FIFA izpildkomitejas lēmumu pieņemšanā. Viņš sacīja: 'UEFA pārstāvji FIFA izpildkomitejā ir jānes idejas galdā. Viņiem nevajadzētu vienkārši visam piekrist un ļaut Blateram dominēt.' 2007. gadā Platinī un Blaters tika attēloti smaidīgi, spēlējot labdarības mačā kopā ar Francu Bekenbaueru.

article_content: Transformative work has begun at Adolf Hitler’s birthplace in Braunau am Inn, Austria, with the intent to repurpose the building as a police facility. This initiative aims to discourage those who idolize the former Nazi leader from gathering at the historic site. The Austrian government finalized the building’s future in 2019, planning to house a police station, the district police headquarters, and a security academy that will deliver human rights training for officers. Monday marked the start of construction, as workers fenced the area and prepared for renovations. Authorities estimate that police will relocate to the address in early 2026. Decades of debate about the house’s ownership ended in 2017 when the country’s highest court allowed the government to seize the property after the owner refused to sell. While demolition was once considered, officials chose renovation instead. The building had served as a rental for charities after being leased by the Interior Ministry since 1972; it has been empty since a center for disabled adults shut down in 2011. A memorial stone at the site—engraved with a message against fascism and commemorating freedom, democracy, and the millions lost—will remain. The government maintains that installing the police, who are tasked with upholding civil liberties, is the most fitting choice for the property. Not everyone agrees: historian Florian Kotanko argues that the renovation lacks important historical context. He believes the plan to erase the building’s recognizability is unrealistic and suggests that an exhibition honoring those who rescued Jews during the Nazi era should become part of the site’s new purpose.
translated_content: Austrijā, Braunau am Inn, vietā, kur dzimis Ādolfs Hitlers, sākta ēkas pārbūve, lai tajā izvietotu policijas iestādes. Šī iniciatīva paredzēta, lai atturētu tos, kuri pielūdz bijušo nacistu līderi, no pulcēšanās vēsturiskajā vietā. Austrijas valdība 2019. gadā pieņēma lēmumu par mājas izmantošanu, iecerot tajā izvietot policijas iecirkni, apgabala policijas štābu un drošības akadēmiju, kas nodrošinās cilvēktiesību apmācības policistiem. Darbi sākti pirmdien, uzstādot žogus un sākot sagatavošanās darbus. Tiek lēsts, ka policija pārcelsies uz šo adresi 2026. gada sākumā. Pēc vairāku desmitu gadu diskusijām par mājas īpašumtiesībām 2017. gadā Austrijas Augstākā tiesa lēma par labu valdības īpašuma atsavināšanai, jo īpašnieks atteicās to pārdot. Demontāžas plāni tika atmesti, izvēloties renovāciju. Kopš 1972. gada ēku īrēja Iekšlietu ministrija un tā tika iznomāta labdarības organizācijām; kopš 2011. gada, kad tika slēgts centrs cilvēkiem ar invaliditāti, tā stāvēja tukša. Pie ēkas saglabās piemiņas akmeni ar uzrakstu, kas vēršas pret fašismu, aicina sargāt brīvību, demokrātiju un piemin miljoniem bojāgājušo. Valdība uzskata, ka policijas izvietošana, kas sargā pilsoņu brīvības, ir piemērotākais risinājums šai ēkai. Tomēr visi nepiekrit: vēsturnieks Florians Kotanko uzskata, ka rekonstrukcijai trūkst būtiska vēsturiskā konteksta. Viņš apgalvo, ka ēkas atpazīstamības izskaušana nav reāli iespējama, un ierosina, lai šajā vietā izveidotu izstādi par tiem, kas nacisma laikos izglāba ebrejus.

article_content: Army Private First Class Kelli Bordeaux, a 23-year-old soldier stationed at Fort Bragg in North Carolina, has been reported missing and may be in danger, according to police. Bordeaux was last seen early Saturday after leaving Froggy Bottoms, a bar in Fayetteville. She had been drinking and reportedly accepted a ride home from a bar employee, a U.S. Army official told CNN on condition of anonymity. At some point after leaving the bar, Bordeaux sent two text messages, one of which said, 'got home safely.' It is not clear to whom the message was sent, nor is the content of the second text known. Police searched Bordeaux’s apartment and vehicle; details about where her vehicle was found remain unknown. She was declared missing on Monday after failing to report for duty. Bordeaux’s older sister, Olivia Cox, described her as a dedicated soldier who would not miss work nor go AWOL. Cox declined to comment on Bordeaux’s visit to the bar but expressed uncertainty about anyone wanting to harm her sister. Their mother, Johnna Henson, stated that police informed her Bordeaux received a ride to the bar and participated in karaoke. According to Henson, Bordeaux felt uneasy during the drive home and asked the driver to let her out before arriving at her apartment. Henson does not believe her daughter made it home. Bordeaux is described as 5 feet tall, 99 pounds, with blond hair and brown eyes. She was last seen wearing a pink halter top and black shorts, police said. Living off-post, Bordeaux is originally from St. Cloud, Florida, and joined the Army in April 2011. She serves as a health service specialist with the 601st Area Support Medical Company, 261st Multifunctional Medical Battalion, 44th Medical Brigade. Her family emphasized Bordeaux’s determination to make her family proud through her military service. Bordeaux has been married to her civilian husband for two years, with the sisters last exchanging happy messages on Friday. Authorities urge anyone with information about Bordeaux’s whereabouts to contact Fayetteville police at (910) 433-1856 or CrimeStoppers at (910) 483-TIPS (8477).
translated_content: Armijas kareive, pirmās klases privātkareive Kelli Bordo (23), kas dislocējas Fort Bragg bāzē Ziemeļkarolīnā, ir pazudusi un, iespējams, atrodas briesmās, ziņo policija. Bordo pēdējo reizi redzēta agrā sestdienas rītā, kad viņa pameta bāru “Froggy Bottoms” Fejetvilā. Viņa bija lietojusi alkoholu un, kā ziņoja ASV armijas amatpersona CNN, pieņēma bāra darbinieka piedāvājumu aizvest viņu mājās. Pēc bāra atstāšanas Bordo nosūtīja divas īsziņas, no kurām vienā bija rakstīts: “Tiku mājās droši.” Nav zināms, kam šī ziņa tika sūtīta, un otra ziņas saturs nav zināms. Policija pārmeklēja Bordo dzīvokli un automašīnu, taču precīza informācija par to, kur auto atrasts, nav zināma. Viņu paziņoja par pazudušu pirmdien, kad viņa neieradās dienestā. Bordo vecākā māsa Olīvija Koksa raksturoja viņu kā centīgu kareivi, kura neizlaistu darbu un neizietu no dienesta bez atļaujas. Koksa atteicās komentēt māsas apmeklējumu bārā, taču pauda, ka nezina nevienu, kas vēlētos viņai kaitēt. Māte Džona Hensone norādīja, ka policija informējusi – Bordo tika aizvesta uz bāru un piedalījās karaoke. Pēc Hensones teiktā, Bordo jutās nedaudz satraukta braucienā mājup un palūdza vadītāju izlaist viņu vēl pirms dzīvokļa sasniegšanas. Hensone neuzskata, ka meita būtu nonākusi mājās. Bordo ir 152 cm gara, sver 45 kg, viņai ir blondi mati un brūnas acis. Policija norāda, ka viņa pēdējo reizi redzēta rozā haltera topā un melnos šortos. Bordo dzīvo ārpus bāzes, nākusi no Sentkloudas, Floridas, un armijā iesaistījās 2011. gada aprīlī. Viņa dien kā veselības dienesta speciāliste 601. teritorijas atbalsta medicīnas rotā, 261. daudzfunkcionālajā medicīnas bataljonā, 44. medicīnas brigādē. Ģimene uzsver, ka Bordo militārajam dienestam pievērsās, lai padarītu ģimeni lepnu. Kelli ar savu civilvīru ir precējusies divus gadus, un māsas pēdējo reizi sarakstījās laimīgā noskaņā piektdien. Varasiestādes lūdz ikvienu, kam ir jebkāda informācija par Bordo atrašanās vietu, zvanīt Fejetvilas policijai pa tālruni (910) 433-1856 vai CrimeStoppers pa tālruni (910) 483-TIPS (8477).

article_content: Northern Gaza (CNN) – Mohamed Al-Batsh remembers a premonition he had on the first day Israeli airstrikes began in Gaza. He saw his father's face and sensed something was wrong. 'I went to my room, closed the door, and I knew he would die. I put my head on the pillow and cried for my father and for all those who would be lost,' Al-Batsh recalled. His father, a leader in Hamas' military wing, was killed late Saturday in an Israeli airstrike along with 17 others, making it one of the deadliest single strikes so far. Among the victims was a 10-year-old child. The attack in Shaja'ia, near Gaza City, illustrates how Gaza's residents are trapped by the ongoing conflict, with no safe way out. By Monday, the death toll from almost a week of Israeli airstrikes had reached 186 Palestinians, with at least 1,390 wounded, according to Palestinian health officials. While some militants have been killed, approximately 70% of those killed are civilians, including over 30 children, according to United Nations reports. Israel has stated it will continue its military operations as long as Hamas continues firing rockets into Israeli territory. Hamas, meanwhile, has shown no sign of stopping, having fired nearly 1,000 rockets at Israel. In northern Gaza's Jabalya area, destruction is widespread: the contents of one home litter the street after an Israeli airstrike. No one in that house was hurt, but the house next door was partially destroyed, possibly the intended target. The Israeli military says it has struck 1,470 'terror targets' in Gaza, and accuses Hamas of hiding weapons in civilian buildings such as hospitals and homes. Mohamed Abu Hassan, a neighbor, questioned why his family is suffering from the attacks. 'Is my wife fighting Israel?' he asked. 'This is tyranny.'
translated_content: Ziemeļgaza (CNN) – Mohameds Al-Batšs atceras priekšnojautu, kas viņam bija pirmajā dienā, kad Gazā sākās Izraēlas gaisa triecieni. Viņš redzēja tēva seju un juta, ka kaut kas nav kārtībā. 'Es aizgāju uz savu istabu, aizvēru durvis un zināju, ka viņš mirs. Es uzliku galvu uz spilvena un raudāju par savu tēvu un visiem, kas tiks zaudēti,' atceras Al-Batšs. Viņa tēvs, Hamas militārā spārna līderis, tika nogalināts vēlās sestdienas stundās Izraēlas gaisa triecienā kopā ar vēl 17 cilvēkiem. Šis bija viens no asiņainākajiem triecieniem līdz šim. Starp upuriem bija arī 10 gadus vecs bērns. Uzbrukums Šadžaijā, netālu no Gazas pilsētas, parāda, cik ļoti Gazas iedzīvotāji ir iesprostoti konfliktā, bez drošas izkļūšanas iespējām. Līdz pirmdienai pēc gandrīz nedēļu ilgušiem Izraēlas gaisa triecieniem bojāgājušo skaits bija sasniedzis 186 palestīniešus, vismaz 1390 bija ievainoti, ziņo Palestīnas veselības iestādes. Saskaņā ar Apvienoto Nāciju datiem apmēram 70% bojāgājušo ir civiliedzīvotāji, to vidū vairāk nekā 30 bērni. Izraēla ir paziņojusi, ka operāciju turpinās, kamēr Hamas turpinās raķešu apšaudes Izraēlas teritorijā. Hamas nav izrādījusi vēlmi apšaudes apturēt, jau izšaujot gandrīz 1000 raķešu uz Izraēlu. Ziemeļgazas Džabalijā pēc Izraēlas gaisa trieciena sekas ir redzamas: kādas mājas saturs ir izmests uz ielas. Šajā mājā neviens necieta, bet blakus māja tika daļēji iznīcināta – iespējams, tā bija mērķis. Izraēlas armija ziņo, ka ir uzbrukusi 1470 'terorisma mērķiem' Gazā un apsūdz Hamas par ieroču slēpšanu civilajās ēkās, piemēram, slimnīcās un mājās. Kaimiņš Mohameds Abu Hasans jautāja, kāpēc viņa ģimenei jācieš šie uzbrukumi. 'Vai mana sieva cīnās pret Izraēlu?' viņš jautā. 'Tā ir tirānija.'

article_content: Procter & Gamble (P&G), the world’s top consumer goods company, is on the verge of reaching $2 billion in Indian sales after over three decades in the country. In the 2023 fiscal year, P&G India’s revenue climbed 15% and net profit rose 26%, despite rising manufacturing costs and price hikes. Its four Indian branches—P&G Health, Gillette, P&G Health & Hygiene, and P&G Home Products—generated a combined ₹16,089 crore in sales and ₹1,682 crore in net profit. P&G Home Products, the division behind well-known brands like Tide, Pantene, and Pampers, was the biggest performer, achieving a 27% increase in sales (₹8,464 crore) and a 51% jump in profit (₹419 crore), as per official filings. Managing Director LV Vaidyanathan credited this success to a mix of more consumers buying P&G products, a push for premium items, and improved operational efficiency. He said these results come from strategies focused on daily essentials, product excellence, innovation in packaging, targeted marketing, better value, and adaptability—helping P&G keep growing even in tough economic times. P&G has invested over ₹20,000 crore in India in the past 20 years, making it one of the company’s top ten global markets. Still, it faces steep competition from Hindustan Unilever (HUL), which is nearly four times larger. Despite this, P&G holds the top spot in sanitary napkins and shaving razors, increasing its share as the biggest player. Though mainly known for pricier, urban-focused goods, P&G has outperformed in some rural areas—like Kerala and Tamil Nadu—and brands such as Vicks and Gillette Guard have shown strong sales in villages. In a recent investor update, Vaidyanathan shared that P&G is investing heavily in a new initiative called ‘Supply 3.0’ to modernize its supply chain using data analytics. The aim: create a more resilient, adaptable, and synchronized network to support shifting demand and boost efficiency. Elsewhere, Ahmedabad saw hotel and airline prices soar due to the cricket World Cup final between India and Australia. OpenAI ousted CEO Sam Altman after a string of disagreements. Meanwhile, India’s government cleared IT hardware investments from 27 companies—global names like Dell, HP, and Lenovo included—totaling ₹3,000 crore over the coming six years.

Četri Indijas meitasuzņēmumi—P&G Health, Gillette, P&G Health & Hygiene un P&G Home Products—kopā radīja 16 089 crore rūpiju apgrozījumu un 1 682 crore tīro peļņu. P&G Home Products, kas ražo tādus populārus zīmolus kā Tide, Pantene un Pampers, uzrādīja vislabākos rezultātus: pārdošanas pieaugums par 27% (8 464 crore rūpiju) un peļņas pieaugums par 51% (419 crore rūpiju), liecina oficiālie dati. Uzņēmuma ģenerāldirektors LV Vaidyanathan šo panākumu skaidro ar to, ka vairāk patērētāju izvēlas P&G produktus, ir veiksmīgi attīstīti augstākas klases preču segmenti un uzlabota darbības efektivitāte. Viņš uzsver, ka šādus rezultātus sniegušas stratēģijas, kas vērstas uz ikdienas vajadzībām, produktu izcilību, inovācijām iepakošanā, mērķtiecīgu mārketingu, lielāku vērtību un pielāgošanās spēju—tas palīdz P&G augt arī sarežģītā ekonomikā. Pēdējo 20 gadu laikā P&G Indijā ieguldījis vairāk nekā 20 000 crore rūpiju, padarot šo valsti par vienu no desmit svarīgākajiem tirgiem uzņēmuma pasaulē. Tomēr uzņēmumam ir nopietna konkurence ar Hindustan Unilever (HUL), kas ir gandrīz četras reizes lielāks. Neskatoties uz to, P&G saglabā līdera pozīcijas sieviešu higiēnas produktu un skūšanās asmeņu tirgū un turpina palielināt savu tirgus daļu. Lai gan uzņēmums galvenokārt pazīstams ar dārgākiem, pilsētām raksturīgiem produktiem, dažos lauku reģionos, piemēram, Keralā un Tamil Nadu, P&G līdzīgi izceļas, un tādi zīmoli kā Vicks un Gillette Guard laukos uzrāda labus rezultātus. Nesenā paziņojumā investoriem Vaidyanathan pastāstīja, ka P&G ievērojami iegulda jaunā iniciatīvā 'Supply 3.0', lai modernizētu piegādes ķēdi un izmantotu datu analītiku. Mērķis ir radīt izturīgāku, pielāgojamāku un sinhronizētāku tīklu, kas varētu apmierināt mainīgas tirgus prasības un paaugstinātu efektivitāti. Indijas valdība apstiprināja IT tehnikas ražošanas investīcijas no 27 uzņēmumiem, tostarp 'Dell', 'HP' un 'Lenovo', kopumā 3 000 crore rūpiju apjomā nākamo sešu gadu laikā.

article_content: Premier League tickets are not just the most expensive in the world in absolute terms—with an average 'cheap' adult seat costing £28.80—but also take up a larger share of the average fan’s wages than almost any other league globally. An exclusive Mail on Sunday study of football leagues worldwide reveals that only in Brazil and China do fans spend a slightly higher proportion of their weekly income to watch top-flight football. The study examines the average price of a ‘typical’ top-flight ticket in 34 countries, comparing it to local income data. Using the latest statistics, it finds that a supporter in England, earning an average weekly wage of £411, could buy just 14.3 tickets. In Brazil, with an average seat costing £12.73, a week's wage buys 14.2 tickets. In China, a week's pay of £140 affords just 14 tickets at £10 each. The data highlights a striking variance in the affordability of football worldwide, showing where the sport remains accessible. Algeria offers the most affordable tickets in terms of average income: with a seat at £1.40, the typical fan can afford up to 118 tickets with a week’s pay. Tickets are also relatively affordable in Nigeria, Ukraine, Poland, Chile, South Africa, and Sweden. Although Germany’s Bundesliga is seen as a good value, 22 leagues offer greater affordability when local wages are considered. A standard Bundesliga ticket costs £19.17, allowing fans to buy 27 tickets with weekly pay. Ticket prices vary widely within each country and club. The averages cited are either official league figures or derived from the lowest-priced adult tickets at selected clubs. ‘At top clubs, ticket pricing is the leading concern for fans by a wide margin,’ says Malcolm Clarke of the Football Supporters’ Federation. ‘This is a league flush with TV money—clubs could give every seat away for free and still be wealthier than before the most recent broadcast deal. The lack of progress on ticket affordability is scandalous.’ While the Premier League is the priciest to watch live, it maintains enormous popularity both domestically and internationally. The Mail on Sunday’s study analyzed multiple aspects in all 34 leagues, including income and wages, star quality, goals, attendance figures, talent development, trophy records, managerial calibre, competitive balance, and contributions to their national football scenes. Premier League clubs have the world’s highest average revenues—about £155 million each—and the highest average player wages at £2.3 million per year. In comparison, Germany’s Bundesliga averages £90 million per club and £1.46 million per player annually. Spain’s La Liga, although home to such stars as Ronaldo and Messi, had 112 Premier League-based players at the recent World Cup—more than any other league. The Bundesliga leads in average match attendance at 42,609 (13 million total), but the Premier League had a greater overall attendance last year (13.94 million, with an average of 36,695 per match). French clubs top the charts for developing ‘top-class’ players for Europe’s ‘Big 5’ leagues, producing 193 such talents when factoring in both exported and domestic players. Spain follows, with La Liga delivering the most continental trophies in the last decade (four Champions League and five Europa League/UEFA Cup titles), trailed by the Premier League. England ranks highest for high-profile managers, credited to the trophies accumulated by figures like Jose Mourinho, Louis Van Gaal, Arsene Wenger, and Manuel Pellegrini. The Bundesliga comes second, powered by the likes of Pep Guardiola and Jurgen Klopp. Surprisingly, China’s Super League ranks fourth, highlighting the growing presence of top managers there in 2014. The Premier League performs poorly on competitive balance, with only three champions in a decade and just five teams featuring in the top three over that span. In contrast, Sweden, Japan, and some American leagues have seen up to seven different champions in ten years. The Bundesliga is notable for aiding the German national team and promoting fan ownership and stable finances, making it the top league for its contribution to the national game. When all these criteria are considered, and points are awarded proportionally, the Premier League narrowly edges out the Bundesliga as the world’s leading league—by the slimmest of margins.
translated_content: Premjerlīgas biļetes ir ne tikai dārgākās pasaulē absolūtos skaitļos—vidēji 'lētākā' pieaugušo vieta maksā £28,80—bet arī aizņem lielāku daļu vidējā līdzjutēja ienākumu nekā gandrīz jebkurā citā līgā. Mail on Sunday ekskluzīvs pētījums par futbola līgām visā pasaulē atklāj, ka tikai Brazīlijā un Ķīnā līdzjutēji tērē nedaudz lielāku savas nedēļas algu daļu, lai vērotu augstākās līgas futbolu. Pētījumā aplūkotas 'tipiskas' augstākās līgas biļešu cenas 34 valstīs, salīdzinot tās ar vietējo algu datiem. Jaunākā statistika liecina, ka Anglijas līdzjutējs ar vidējo nedēļas algu £411 var atļauties tikai 14,3 biļetes. Brazīlijā vidējā vieta maksā £12,73, nedēļas alga ļauj iegādāties 14,2 biļetes. Ķīnā ar £140 nedēļas algu iespējams nopirkt tikai 14 biļetes, ja katra maksā £10. Dati izgaismo milzīgas atšķirības futbola pieejamībā pasaulē, parādot, kur futbols ir īpaši pieejams. Alžīrijā biļetes ir vispieejamākās attiecībā pret vidējo algu: vieta maksā £1,40, un tipisks līdzjutējs var atļauties līdz pat 118 biļetēm par nedēļas algu. Biļetes ir salīdzinoši pieejamas arī Nigērijā, Ukrainā, Polijā, Čīlē, Dienvidāfrikā un Zviedrijā. Lai gan Vācijas Bundeslīga tiek uzskatīta par labu vērtību, 22 līgas ir pieejamākas, ja ņem vērā vietējās algas. Standarta Bundeslīgas biļete maksā £19,17, ļaujot faniem nopirkt 27 biļetes ar nedēļas algu. Biļešu cenas būtiski atšķiras gan starp valstīm, gan klubiem. Norādītie vidējie rādītāji ir oficiālie līgas dati vai aprēķināti no lētākajām pieaugušo biļetēm atlasītiem klubiem. 'Augstākajā līgā biļešu cenas ir galvenā līdzjutēju baža,' saka Fanu asociācijas pārstāvis Malkolms Klarks. 'Šī ir līga ar milzīgiem TV ienākumiem—klubi varētu dot biļetes bez maksas un tomēr būt bagātāki nekā pirms pēdējā TV līguma. Nekāds progress biļešu pieejamībā nav panākts, un tas ir apkaunojoši.' Lai arī Premjerlīga ir dārgākā tiešraides skatīšanās ziņā, tā joprojām ir ļoti populāra gan mājās, gan ārvalstīs. Mail on Sunday pētījumā analizēti daudzi aspekti visās 34 līgās: ienākumi, algas, zvaigžņu kvalitāte, vārtu skaits, apmeklējuma rādītāji, talantu attīstība, trofeju statistika, treneru kalibrs, konkurētspēja un ieguldījums valstiskajā futbolā. Premjerlīgas klubiem ir vislielākie vidējie ieņēmumi pasaulē—apmēram £155 miljoni katram—un visaugstākās vidējās spēlētāju algas—£2,3 miljoni gadā. Salīdzinājumā, Bundeslīgas klubiem vidēji £90 miljoni, spēlētājiem—£1,46 miljoni gadā. Lai gan Spānijas La Liga ir mājvieta tādām zvaigznēm kā Ronaldu un Mesi, pie pēdējā Pasaules kausa Premjerlīgā spēlēja 112 futbolisti—vairāk nekā jebkurā citā līgā. Bundeslīga ir līdere vidējā spēles apmeklējuma ziņā—42 609 (kopā 13 miljoni)—taču Premjerlīga pagājušogad bija līdere kopējā apmeklējuma ziņā—13,94 miljoni (vidēji spēlē 36 695). Francijas klubi ir izcilākie 'top' futbolistu sagatavošanā Eiropas lielajām 5 līgām, kopā 193 spēlētāji, ņemot vērā eksportētos un vietējos. Spānija seko, un La Liga pēdējā desmitgadē ieguvusi visvairāk kontinenta trofeju (četri Čempionu līgas un pieci Eiropas līgas/UEFA kausi), Premjerlīga atrodas otrajā vietā. Anglija ir līdere augstākā līmeņa treneru ziņā—pateicoties trofejām, ko guvuši Žuzē Mourinju, Luī van Gāls, Arsēns Vengers un Manuels Pelegrīni. Bundeslīga ir otrā, pateicoties Pepam Gvardiolam un Jirgenam Klopam. Pārsteidzoši, Ķīnas Superlīga ir ceturtajā vietā, uzsverot augsta līmeņa treneru pieplūdumu 2014. gadā. Premjerlīgai neveicas konkurētspējas ziņā—trīs čempioni desmit gados un tikai piecas komandas bijušas labāko trijniekā šajā periodā. Salīdzinājumam, Zviedrijā, Japānā un vairākās Amerikāņu līgās desmit gadu laikā uzvarējušas līdz pat septiņām dažādām komandām. Bundeslīga izceļas ar ieguldījumu Vācijas nacionālajā izlasē, fanu īpašumtiesībām un stabilām finansēm—tāpēc tā ir līdere nacionālajā ieguldījumā. Ņemot vērā visus šos kritērijus un attiecīgi sadalot punktus, Premjerlīga tikai nedaudz pārspēj Bundeslīgu kā pasaules vadošā futbola līga—ar vismazāko iespējamo pārsvaru.

article_content: Two people were arrested on Thursday evening after police reported they had taken some of the nearly HK$15.23 million that spilled onto a Hong Kong street from a cash transport van on Christmas Eve. Authorities stated that a 43-year-old man was detained in Kowloon and a 36-year-old woman was taken into custody in Tseung Kwan O. Both are accused of picking up banknotes from the street and hiding the money in their homes. Police said that 29 people have voluntarily returned money, amounting to HK$5.7 million. Those who hand the money back voluntarily will likely not be charged, police added. The incident created remarkable scenes as last-minute shoppers in Hong Kong witnessed banknotes spilling onto Gloucester Road in the city's Wan Chai district around lunchtime. Motorists and pedestrians were seen on camera collecting the scattered bills before police arrived and secured the area. According to police, three cash boxes fell from the van, resulting in a loss of an estimated HK$15.23 million (nearly US$2 million). G4S, the security company that operates the cash transport van, said in a statement that most of the money was recovered at the scene. G4S also said its vehicles are equipped with systems to prevent such incidents and that an immediate investigation into the cause has begun. The company pledged to take urgent measures to avoid similar events in the future.
translated_content: Divi cilvēki tika arestēti ceturtdienas vakarā pēc tam, kad policija paziņoja, ka viņi paņēmuši daļu no gandrīz 15,23 miljoniem Honkongas dolāru, kas Ziemassvētku vakarā izbira uz Honkongas ielas no naudas pārvadāšanas furgona. Varas iestādes norādīja, ka 43 gadus vecs vīrietis tika aizturēts Kowloon, un 36 gadus veca sieviete tika aizturēta Tseung Kwan O. Abi tiek apsūdzēti par banknošu pacelšanu no ielas un naudas slēpšanu mājās. Policija norādīja, ka 29 cilvēki labprātīgi ir atdevuši naudu, kopā atgriežot 5,7 miljonus HKD. Tie, kas naudu atdod labprātīgi, visticamāk netiks saukti pie atbildības, piebilda policija. Šis incidents radīja ievērojamu ainu, jo pēdējā brīža iepircēji Honkongā vēroja, kā pusdienlaikā uz Gloucester Road Wan Chai rajonā izbira banknotes. Autovadītāji un gājēji tika fiksēti kamerās, kā viņi vāca izkliedētās naudaszīmes, līdz ieradās policija un nodrošināja teritoriju. Pēc policijas teiktā, no furgona izkrita trīs naudas kastes, kā rezultātā tika zaudēti aptuveni 15,23 miljoni HKD (gandrīz 2 miljoni ASV dolāru). G4S – drošības kompānija, kas vada naudas pārvadāšanas furgonu, norādīja, ka lielākā daļa naudas tika atgūta uz vietas.
